/* =====================================================================
 * 垂线布设引擎  HS_LAYOUT
 *  闭环：大断面 → 垂线布设(分高/中/低水位级定固定垂线) → 垂线转移(岸边线分档)
 *  规范：GB 50179-2015
 *   B.2.1 测速垂线大致均匀分布，控制断面地形和流速沿河宽分布主要转折点
 *   B.2.2 大于断面流量1%的独股分流、串沟应布设测速垂线
 *   B.2.3 断面形状或流速横向分布随水位级明显变化的测站，应分高、中、低水位级分别布设
 *   B.2.4 垂线位置宜固定，岸边垂线距岸边太远/太近时应随时调整补充（垂线转移依据）
 *   B.12.9-2 常测法相邻垂线间距占水面宽：一类7%~10%、二类8%~11%、三类9%~12%
 *   B.12.9-3 宽深比特别大或漫滩严重的测站垂线数应适当增加
 *   B.12.9-4 水情紧急且无精简分析资料时可减线，但水面宽小于50m时不宜少于5条
 *   表B.12.13注5 m=5插控方案系统误差过大，正常测验条件下不宜采用
 * ===================================================================== */
window.HS_LAYOUT = {
  normNote: 'GB 50179-2015 B.2/B.12：按水面宽与宽深比定最少测速垂线数；间距比宜≤10%(一类)/11%(二类)/12%(三类)；5线插控方案系统误差过大，正常测验不宜采用',
  // 断面点[{dist,elev}] + 水位 z → 水面宽/面积/平均水深
  geo: function(points, z){
    try{
      var pts = (points||[]).map(function(p){
        return {x:parseFloat(p.dist!=null?p.dist:p.x), h:parseFloat(p.elev!=null?p.elev:(p.h!=null?p.h:p.z))};
      }).filter(function(p){return isFinite(p.x)&&isFinite(p.h);})
        .sort(function(a,b){return a.x-b.x;});
      if(pts.length < 2 || !(isFinite(z)&&z>-10000)) return null;
      var xL = null, xR = null, area = 0;
      function wet(x){ if(xL===null||x<xL) xL=x; if(xR===null||x>xR) xR=x; }
      for(var i=0;i<pts.length;i++){ if(pts[i].h < z) wet(pts[i].x); else if(Math.abs(pts[i].h-z)<1e-9) wet(pts[i].x); }
      for(var k=0;k<pts.length-1;k++){
        var a=pts[k], b=pts[k+1], dx=b.x-a.x;
        if(!(dx>0)) continue;
        var wa=(a.h<z), wb=(b.h<z);
        if(wa&&wb){
          wet(a.x); wet(b.x);
          area += dx*((z-a.h)+(z-b.h))/2;
        }else if(wa&&!wb){
          var r=(z-a.h)/(b.h-a.h); if(!(r>=0&&r<=1)) continue;
          var xc=a.x+r*dx; wet(a.x); wet(xc);
          area += (xc-a.x)*(z-a.h)/2;
        }else if(!wa&&wb){
          var r2=(z-a.h)/(b.h-a.h); if(!(r2>=0&&r2<=1)) continue;
          var xc2=a.x+r2*dx; wet(xc2); wet(b.x);
          area += (b.x-xc2)*(z-b.h)/2;
        }
      }
      if(xL===null||xR===null) return null;
      var B=xR-xL;
      if(!(B>0)) return null;
      var H=area/B;
      return {xL:xL, xR:xR, width:B, area:area, avgDepth:H, ratio:B/(H||1e-9)};
    }catch(e){ return null; }
  },
  // 常测法最少测速垂线数（水文测验手册常测法表 + B.12.9）
  minLines: function(width, avgDepth){
    var B=parseFloat(width), H=parseFloat(avgDepth);
    if(!(B>0)) return {m:5, wide:false, basis:'无水面宽资料，按最少5根估算'};
    var wide = isFinite(H)&&H>0 && (B/H)>=100;
    var m, basis;
    if(B<5){        m=5;                basis='水面宽<5m，规范潮汐河最少3条、小河常测3~5根，取5'; }
    else if(B<50){  m=wide?8:5;         basis='水面宽5~50m，'+(wide?'宽浅(B/H≥100)不少于8根':'窄深不少于5根'); }
    else if(B<100){ m=wide?9:6;         basis='水面宽50~100m，'+(wide?'宽浅不少于9根':'窄深不少于6根'); }
    else if(B<300){ m=wide?11:7;        basis='水面宽100~300m，'+(wide?'宽浅(漫滩)不少于11根':'窄深不少于7根'); }
    else if(B<1000){m=wide?13:8;        basis='水面宽300~1000m，'+(wide?'宽浅不少于13根':'窄深不少于8根'); }
    else {          m=wide?14:8;        basis='水面宽>1000m，不少于8根，宽浅漫滩13根以上'; }
    return {m:m, wide:wide, basis:basis};
  },
  // 在 xL..xR 间均匀布 m 根固定垂线（与测流模块等分法一致：k*B/(m+1)）
  layFixed: function(xL, xR, m){
    var out=[], B=xR-xL;
    if(!(B>0)||!(m>0)) return out;
    for(var k=1;k<=m;k++) out.push(Math.round((xL+k*B/(m+1))*10)/10);
    return out;
  },
  // 断面记录评分：优先基本水尺/测流断面，排除比降/浮标/高洪等专用断面
  sectionScore: function(o){
    var n=String((o&&o.name)||'');
    var s=0;
    if(/比降|浮标|高洪|引水桥|大桥|堰/.test(n)) s-=100;
    if(/基本|水尺/.test(n)) s+=10;
    if(/流速仪|测流/.test(n)) s+=5;
    return s;
  },
  /* 断面有效性：至少2个有限高程点且高程有变化（排除只有起点距、无高程的伪断面） */
  sectionValid: function(o){
    try{
      if(!(o&&o.rows&&o.rows.length>=2)) return false;
      var mn=null,mx=null,c=0;
      for(var i=0;i<o.rows.length;i++){
        var e=parseFloat(o.rows[i]&&o.rows[i].elev);
        if(!isFinite(e)) continue;
        c++; if(mn===null||e<mn)mn=e; if(mx===null||e>mx)mx=e;
      }
      return c>=2 && mx>mn;
    }catch(e){ return false; }
  },
  // 取最新可用大断面：最新年份优先；年内取最高分；负分专用断面（比降/浮标/高洪）不作主断面
  // 本站实测大断面（hsDB 大断面记录，取最新一条）：无档案断面时布设/转移引擎同源使用
  measSection: function(name){
    try{
      var bu=((window._bureau||(localStorage.getItem('ylt_bureau')||'')).trim());
      var keys=['hsDB'];if(bu)keys.push('hsDB_'+bu);
      var stMap={},recs=[];
      keys.forEach(function(dk){
        var db=null;try{db=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(dk)||'null');}catch(e){}
        if(!db)return;
        (db.stations||[]).forEach(function(st){if(st&&st.id)stMap[st.id]=st.name;});
        (db.records||[]).forEach(function(r){if(r)recs.push(r);});
      });
      var best=null;
      for(var i=0;i<recs.length;i++){
        var r=recs[i];
        if((r.type||'').indexOf('大断面')<0)continue;
        var sn=stMap[r.stationId]||r.stationName||'';
        if(sn!==name)continue;
        var pts=[];
        (r.secBank||[]).forEach(function(b){if(b&&b.dist!=null&&b.h!=null&&isFinite(b.dist)&&isFinite(b.h))pts.push({dist:+b.dist,elev:+b.h});});
        (r.secWater||[]).forEach(function(w){if(!w||w.dist==null||!isFinite(w.dist))return;var h=(w.hb!=null&&isFinite(w.hb))?w.hb:((r.level!=null&&w.depth!=null)?(r.level-w.depth):null);if(h!=null&&isFinite(h))pts.push({dist:+w.dist,elev:h});});
        if(pts.length<2)continue;
        pts.sort(function(a,b){return a.dist-b.dist;});
        var uniq=[pts[0]];for(var j=1;j<pts.length;j++){if(Math.abs(pts[j].dist-uniq[uniq.length-1].dist)<1e-9)uniq[uniq.length-1].elev=pts[j].elev;else uniq.push(pts[j]);}
        if(uniq.length<2)continue;
        var t=String(r.time||'');
        if(!best||t>best._t)best={rows:uniq,wlevel:parseFloat(r.level),date:t.slice(0,10),year:t.slice(0,4),name:r.secName||r.route||'实测大断面',_src:'hsDB',_t:t};
      }
      if(best){delete best._t;return best;}
    }catch(e){}
    return null;
  },
  latestSection: function(st){
    try{
      var sm=(st&&st.hist&&st.hist.sections)||{};
      var ys=Object.keys(sm).sort(function(a,b){return (parseInt(a,10)||0)-(parseInt(b,10)||0);});
      for(var i=ys.length-1;i>=0;i--){
        var list=sm[ys[i]];
        if(!Array.isArray(list)) continue;
        var best=null;
        for(var j=0;j<list.length;j++){
          var o=list[j];
          if(!this.sectionValid(o)) continue;
          var sc=this.sectionScore(o);
          if(sc<0) continue;
          if(!best || sc>=best._sc){ best={rows:o.rows, wlevel:o.wlevel, date:o.date||'', year:ys[i], name:o.name||'', _sc:sc}; }
        }
        if(best){ delete best._sc; return best; }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return null;
  },
  // 水位级统一取值：st.wl 优先 → 最新年份 hist.basic 任务书识别值(zH/zM/zL) → 任务书转移方案字段；供布设引擎与布设页显示同源使用
  wlOf: function(st, plan){
    var wl={};
    try{
      var w=(st&&st.wl)||{};
      if(w.low!=null&&w.low!=='')wl.low=w.low;
      if(w.mid!=null&&w.mid!=='')wl.mid=w.mid;
      if(w.high!=null&&w.high!=='')wl.high=w.high;
    }catch(e){}
    try{
      var bm=(st&&st.hist&&st.hist.basic)||{};
      var ys=Object.keys(bm).sort(), bb=null;
      for(var i=ys.length-1;i>=0;i--){ var t=bm[ys[i]]; if(t&&(t.zH!=null||t.zM!=null||t.zL!=null)){ bb=t; break; } }
      if(bb){
        /* 任务书水位级常为 ">21.57"/"20.61~21.57"/"<19.90" 等写法：取其中数字的均值作为该级代表水位 */
        var pn=function(s){ if(s==null||s==='')return null; var m=String(s).match(/\d+(\.\d+)?/g); if(!m||!m.length)return null; var a=m.map(Number),v=0; for(var k=0;k<a.length;k++)v+=a[k]; return Math.round(v/a.length*100)/100; };
        if(wl.high==null){ var h=pn(bb.zH); if(h!=null)wl.high=h; }
        if(wl.mid==null){ var m2=pn(bb.zM); if(m2!=null)wl.mid=m2; }
        if(wl.low==null){ var l=pn(bb.zL); if(l!=null)wl.low=l; }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    if(plan){
      if(wl.low==null&&plan.lowZStart!=null)wl.low=plan.lowZStart;
      if(wl.mid==null&&plan.zL!=null)wl.mid=plan.zL;
      if(wl.high==null&&plan.zMax!=null)wl.high=plan.zMax;
    }
    return wl;
  },
  // 当前局数据中心站对象（跨所有 ylt_data* 库检索，同名记录取资料最完整的一条）
  yltStation: function(name){
    var bu=((window._bureau||(localStorage.getItem('ylt_bureau')||'')).trim());
    var keys=[];
    for(var ki=0;ki<localStorage.length;ki++){var k=localStorage.key(ki);if(k&&k.indexOf('ylt_data')===0)keys.push(k);}
    keys.sort(function(a,b){
      var pa=(bu&&a==='ylt_data_'+bu)?0:(a==='ylt_data'?1:2);
      var pb=(bu&&b==='ylt_data_'+bu)?0:(b==='ylt_data'?1:2);
      return pa-pb;
    });
    var best=null,bestSc=-1;
    for(var kk=0;kk<keys.length;kk++){
      var yd=null;
      try{yd=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(keys[kk])||'null');}catch(e){}
      if(!yd||!Array.isArray(yd.stations))continue;
      for(var i=0;i<yd.stations.length;i++){
        var st=yd.stations[i];
        if(st.name!==name)continue;
        var sc=0;
        try{
          var secs=(st.hist&&st.hist.sections)||{};
          var hasSec=Object.keys(secs).some(function(y){return (secs[y]||[]).some(function(o){return o&&o.rows&&o.rows.length>=2;});});
          if(hasSec)sc+=4;
        }catch(e){}
        var wl=st.wl||{};
        if(wl.mid!=null&&wl.mid!=='')sc+=2;
        if(wl.high!=null&&wl.high!=='')sc+=1;
        if(bu&&keys[kk]==='ylt_data_'+bu)sc+=0.5;
        if(sc>bestSc){bestSc=sc;best=st;}
      }
    }
    return best;
  },
  // 主入口：按站生成三级布设方案；opts.levels 可覆盖水位 [{key,name,z}]
  genForStation: function(name, opts){
    opts=opts||{};
    var st=this.yltStation(name);
    var sec=this.latestSection(st);
    if(!sec)sec=this.measSection(name);
    var plan=window.HS_TRANSFER_PLANS[name]||(st&&st.vplanTb)||null;
    // 断面点：数据中心最新断面 → 内置 HS_SECTIONS
    var rows=null, secDate='', secYear='';
    if(sec){ rows=sec.rows; secDate=sec.date||''; secYear=sec.year||''; }
    if(!rows && window.HS_SECTIONS && HS_SECTIONS[name] && HS_SECTIONS[name].sections){
      try{
        var ss=HS_SECTIONS[name].sections, sy=Object.keys(ss).sort();
        var so=ss[sy[sy.length-1]];
        var mp={};
        (so.bank||[]).concat(so.water||[]).forEach(function(p){
          var d=p[0], e=p[1];
          if(mp[d]===undefined || e<mp[d]) mp[d]=e; /* 同里程取最低点为地面线，合并水上bank与水下water */
        });
        rows=Object.keys(mp).sort(function(a,b){return a-b;}).map(function(d){return {dist:parseFloat(d), elev:mp[d]};});
        secYear=sy[sy.length-1]; secDate='内置断面';
      }catch(e){}
    }
    // 水位级：统一走 wlOf（档案 wl → hist.basic 任务书识别值 → 任务书方案字段），仍缺时按断面几何自动推定
    var wl=this.wlOf(st,plan);
    var _secWL=parseFloat(sec&&sec.wlevel);
    var _gMin=null,_gMax=null;
    if(rows&&rows.length){rows.forEach(function(r){var e=parseFloat(r.elev);if(!isFinite(e))return;if(_gMin===null||e<_gMin)_gMin=e;if(_gMax===null||e>_gMax)_gMax=e;});}
    var _est=function(key){
      if(_gMin===null) return null;
      var lo=isFinite(_secWL)?_secWL:(_gMin+(_gMax-_gMin)*0.15);
      var hi=_gMax-0.05;
      var v=(key==='low')?lo:((key==='high')?hi:(lo+hi)/2);
      return Math.round(v*100)/100;
    };
    var _hasLow=(wl.low!=null&&wl.low!=='');
    var _hasMid=(wl.mid!=null&&wl.mid!=='');
    var _hasHigh=(wl.high!=null&&wl.high!=='');
    var lvls=opts.levels||[
      {key:'low',  name:'低水', z:(_hasLow?wl.low:_est('low')), est:!_hasLow},
      {key:'mid',  name:'中水', z:(_hasMid?wl.mid:_est('mid')), est:!_hasMid},
      {key:'high', name:'高水', z:(_hasHigh?wl.high:_est('high')), est:!_hasHigh}
    ];
    // 水位级单调修正：低水≤中水≤高水；未设低水的站（低水≥中水）低水取中水值（中水以下即低水）
    (function(){
      function num(o){ var v=parseFloat(o&&o.z); return isFinite(v)?v:null; }
      var lo=num(lvls[0]), mi=num(lvls[1]), hi=num(lvls[2]);
      if(mi!=null&&hi!=null&&mi>hi){ lvls[1].z=hi; mi=hi; }
      if(lo!=null&&mi!=null&&lo>=mi){ lvls[0].z=mi; lo=mi; }
      if(lo!=null&&hi!=null&&lo>hi){ lvls[0].z=hi; }
    })();
    var outLevels=[];
    lvls.forEach(function(lv){
      var z=parseFloat(lv.z);
      var item={key:lv.key, name:lv.name, z:isFinite(z)?z:null};
      if(!isFinite(z)){ item.miss=true; item.note='档案缺该水位级水位，无法计算'; outLevels.push(item); return; }
      var g=window.HS_LAYOUT.geo(rows,z);
      if(!g){ item.miss=true; item.note='该水位高于现有大断面最高点或断面无过水部分，需补测断面至该水位以上（大断面应测至历史最高水位以上）'; outLevels.push(item); return; }
      var ml=window.HS_LAYOUT.minLines(g.width,g.avgDepth);
      item.width=Math.round(g.width*100)/100;
      item.area=Math.round(g.area*100)/100;
      item.avgDepth=Math.round(g.avgDepth*100)/100;
      item.ratio=Math.round(g.ratio*10)/10;
      item.riverType=ml.wide?'宽浅/漫滩':'窄深';
      item.minLines=ml.m;
      item.minBasis=ml.basis;
      // 任务书真值优先，仅做规范校核；无任务书按规范最少线数均匀布设
      var tb=null;
      if(plan&&plan.mode==='taskbook'){
        if(lv.key==='low'&&plan.lowFixed&&plan.lowFixed.length) tb=plan.lowFixed.slice();
        else if(lv.key==='high'&&plan.highFixed&&plan.highFixed.length) tb=plan.highFixed.slice();
        else if(plan.fixed&&plan.fixed.length) tb=plan.fixed.slice();
      }
      if(tb&&tb.length){
        item.fixed=tb;
        item.source='taskbook';
        /* 两岸转移垂线：任一水位档左/右岸各有 1 根岸边垂线参与施测，应计入总线数 */
        var tfCnt=0;
        if(lv.key!=='low'&&plan){
          if(plan.right&&plan.right.length)tfCnt++;
          if(plan.left&&plan.left.length)tfCnt++;
        }
        var total=tb.length+tfCnt;
        var tfDesc=tfCnt?('（含两岸转移垂线 '+tfCnt+' 根，合计 '+total+' 根）'):'';
        if(total<ml.m){
          item.check='warn';
          item.note='任务书 '+tb.length+' 根'+tfDesc+'，少于规范建议 '+ml.m+' 根（'+ml.basis+'）；须有本站精简分析资料支撑，否则该水位级应加线（规范B.2.6：主流摆动/漫滩严重宜选较多垂线方案）';
        }else{
          item.check='ok';
          item.note='任务书 '+tb.length+' 根'+tfDesc+'，满足规范下限'+ml.m+'根要求';
        }
        item.transferCount=tfCnt;
        item.totalLines=total;
      }else{
        var fixed=window.HS_LAYOUT.layFixed(g.xL,g.xR,ml.m);
        item.fixed=fixed;
        item.source='auto';
        item.spaceRatio=Math.round((100/(ml.m+1))*10)/10;
        item.check='plan?'
        item.note='无任务书，按规范最少 '+ml.m+' 根均匀布设（估算），主槽应较河滩为密、控制地形转折点；经本站精简分析或比测试验后可调整为常测方案';
      }
      if(lv.est && !item.miss){ item.est=true; item.note='【水位按断面几何推定：低水=断面实测水位，高水=断面最高岸顶，中水=二者均值，特征水位入库后自动更新】'+item.note; }
      outLevels.push(item);
    });
    var usable=outLevels.filter(function(l){return !l.miss;});
    return {
      station:name,
      id:'seed_lo_'+name,
      name:'垂线布设方案（'+(plan&&plan.mode==='taskbook'?'任务书+规范校核':'断面自动布设·估算')+'）',
      date:secDate, year:secYear||String(new Date().getFullYear()),
      source:(plan&&plan.mode==='taskbook')?'taskbook+norm':'autolayout',
      sectionYear:secYear, sectionDate:secDate,
      levels:outLevels,
      norm:window.HS_LAYOUT.normNote,
      remark:(plan&&plan.remark)||'',
      ok: usable.length>0
    };
  }
};

/* =====================================================================
 * 统一垂线选线引擎  HS_PLANKIT（任务书真值唯一入口）
 *  - 任务书站：固定线按水位级选取 + 左右岸转移档按当前水位选档，不依赖任何算法成果
 *  - 方向：起点距零点可能在左岸或右岸，一律以任务书 dir/档位几何位置判定，不假设 x小=左岸
 *  - 同时供 垂线设置(layout) / 垂线转移(transfer) / 测流方案(plan) 三模块共用
 * ===================================================================== */
window.HS_PLANKIT = {
  /* 取本站任务书：内置 HS_TRANSFER_PLANS（随版本更新）优先，站点 vplanTb / hist.transfers 兜底 */
  getTaskPlan: function(name){
    var p=(window.HS_TRANSFER_PLANS||{})[name];
    if(p&&p.mode==='taskbook')return p;
    try{
      var st=window.HS_LAYOUT.yltStation(name);
      if(st){
        if(st.vplanTb&&st.vplanTb.mode==='taskbook')return st.vplanTb;
        var tm=(st.hist&&st.hist.transfers)||{};
        var ys=Object.keys(tm).sort();
        for(var i=ys.length-1;i>=0;i--){
          var arr=tm[ys[i]]||[];
          for(var j=arr.length-1;j>=0;j--){
            var r=arr[j];
            if(r&&r.mode==='taskbook'&&r.fixed&&r.fixed.length)return r;
          }
        }
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return p||null;
  },
  latestSec: function(name){
    try{
      var st=window.HS_LAYOUT.yltStation(name);
      var sec=window.HS_LAYOUT.latestSection(st);
      if(!sec)sec=window.HS_LAYOUT.measSection(name);
      if(sec&&sec.rows&&sec.rows.length>=2){
        var rows=sec.rows.map(function(r){return{x:parseFloat(r.dist),z:parseFloat(r.elev)};})
          .filter(function(p){return isFinite(p.x)&&isFinite(p.z);})
          .sort(function(a,b){return a.x-b.x;});
        var out=[rows[0]];
        for(var i=1;i<rows.length;i++){if(Math.abs(rows[i].x-out[out.length-1].x)>1e-9)out.push(rows[i]);else out[out.length-1].z=rows[i].z;}
        if(out.length>=2)return{rows:out,wlevel:parseFloat(sec.wlevel),date:sec.date||'',year:sec.year||'',name:sec.name||''};
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return null;
  },
  bedAt: function(rows,x){
    if(!rows||!rows.length||x<rows[0].x||x>rows[rows.length-1].x)return null;
    for(var i=0;i<rows.length-1;i++){
      if(x>=rows[i].x&&x<=rows[i+1].x){
        var dx=rows[i+1].x-rows[i].x;
        return dx>0?rows[i].z+(x-rows[i].x)/dx*(rows[i+1].z-rows[i].z):rows[i].z;
      }
    }
    return null;
  },
  edgesAt: function(rows,z){
    if(!rows||rows.length<2)return null;
    var xs=[];
    for(var i=0;i<rows.length-1;i++){
      var z1=rows[i].z,z2=rows[i+1].z,x1=rows[i].x,x2=rows[i+1].x;
      if(z1===z2){if(z1===z){xs.push(x1);xs.push(x2);}continue;}
      if((z1-z)*(z2-z)<0)xs.push(x1+(z-z1)*(x2-x1)/(z2-z1));
      else if(z1===z)xs.push(x1);else if(z2===z)xs.push(x2);
    }
    if(xs.length<2)return null;
    var mn=xs[0],mx=xs[0];
    for(var j=1;j<xs.length;j++){if(xs[j]<mn)mn=xs[j];if(xs[j]>mx)mx=xs[j];}
    return{smallX:mn,bigX:mx,L:mn,R:mx};
  },
  /* 起点距小端是哪一岸：'right'=零点在右岸(右→左) / 'left'=零点在左岸 / null=未知 */
  direction: function(plan){
    if(!plan)return null;
    if(plan.dir==='right-to-left')return 'right';
    if(plan.dir==='left-to-right')return 'left';
    try{
      var fx=(plan.fixed||[]).slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
      if(!fx.length)return null;
      if(plan.right&&plan.right.length){
        var rmin=Math.min.apply(null,plan.right.map(function(s){return +s.x;}));
        var rmax=Math.max.apply(null,plan.right.map(function(s){return +s.x;}));
        if(rmax<fx[0]-1e-6)return 'right';
        if(rmin>fx[fx.length-1]+1e-6)return 'left';
      }
      if(plan.left&&plan.left.length){
        var lmin=Math.min.apply(null,plan.left.map(function(s){return +s.x;}));
        var lmax=Math.max.apply(null,plan.left.map(function(s){return +s.x;}));
        if(lmin>fx[fx.length-1]+1e-6)return 'right';
        if(lmax<fx[0]-1e-6)return 'left';
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return null;
  },
  /* 某一岸（任务书名 right/left）的档位是否位于起点距小端 */
  bankAtSmall: function(plan,bank){
    var dir=this.direction(plan);
    if(dir==='right')return bank==='right';   /* 零点在右岸：右岸=小端 */
    if(dir==='left')return bank==='left';     /* 零点在左岸：左岸=小端 */
    try{
      var fx=(plan.fixed||[]).slice().sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
      var arr=plan[bank];
      if(fx.length&&arr&&arr.length){
        var mn=Math.min.apply(null,arr.map(function(s){return +s.x;}));
        var mx=Math.max.apply(null,arr.map(function(s){return +s.x;}));
        if(mx<fx[0]-1e-6)return true;
        if(mn>fx[fx.length-1]+1e-6)return false;
      }
    }catch(e){}
    return bank==='left'; /* 无证据时的惯例兜底 */
  },
  /* 任务书选档：命中 lo<=z<=hi；多档命中（重叠带）取更靠岸的一档（涨水外移规则） */
  pickSeg: function(segs,z,toSmall){
    if(!segs||!segs.length)return null;
    var hit=segs.filter(function(s){return z>=(+s.lo)-1e-9&&z<=(+s.hi)+1e-9;});
    if(!hit.length)return null;
    hit.sort(function(a,b){return toSmall?(+a.x)-(+b.x):(+b.x)-(+a.x);});
    return hit[0];
  },
  overlapInfo: function(segs){
    if(!segs||!segs.length)return[];
    var ov=[];
    for(var i=0;i<segs.length-1;i++){
      var a=segs[i],b=segs[i+1];
      var lo=Math.max(+a.lo,+b.lo),hi=Math.min(+a.hi,+b.hi);
      if(lo<=hi+1e-9)ov.push({lo:lo,hi:hi,x1:+a.x,x2:+b.x});
    }
    return ov;
  },
  /* 无任务书站：HS_LAYOUT 三级规范布设成果 → 统一方案包装（供转移/方案两模块共用） */
  autoPlan: function(name){
    var auto = window.HS_LAYOUT.genForStation(name);
    if(!auto || !auto.ok) return null;
    function lv(k){ var f=null; (auto.levels||[]).forEach(function(l){ if(l.key===k) f=l; }); return f; }
    var lo=lv('low'), mi=lv('mid'), hi=lv('high');
    if(!mi || !isFinite(mi.z)) return null;
    function fx(l){ return (l && isFinite(l.z) && l.fixed && l.fixed.length)?l.fixed.slice():[]; }
    var midFx=fx(mi), loFx=fx(lo), hiFx=fx(hi);
    /* 级别切换边界：中水起始=中水级水位，高水起始=高水级水位；
       档案识别的水位级若为“20.61~21.57 / >21.57”等区间写法，取其下界作为切换边界，
       避免用区间均值做阈值导致低水误判为中水（此前误把低水代表水位当中水起始的缺陷）。 */
    var midZ=mi.z, hiZ=(hi&&isFinite(hi.z))?hi.z:null;
    try{
      var _st=window.HS_LAYOUT.yltStation(name), _bm=(_st&&_st.hist&&_st.hist.basic)||{};
      var _ys=Object.keys(_bm).sort(), _bb=null;
      for(var _i=_ys.length-1;_i>=0;_i--){ var _t=_bm[_ys[_i]]; if(_t&&(_t.zM!=null||_t.zH!=null||_t.zL!=null)){ _bb=_t; break; } }
      function _firstNum(s){ if(s==null||s==='')return null; var m=String(s).match(/-?\d+(\.\d+)?/); return m?parseFloat(m[0]):null; }
      if(_bb){
        var _mb=_firstNum(_bb.zM), _hb=_firstNum(_bb.zH);
        if(isFinite(_mb)) midZ=_mb;
        if(isFinite(_hb)) hiZ=_hb;
      }
    }catch(e){}
    if(hiZ!=null&&hiZ<=midZ) hiZ=null;          /* 高水边界不高于中水时放弃高水分级 */
    var useLo=loFx.length?loFx:midFx;           /* 低水固定线缺失时回退中水线，保证低水期有线 */
    return { mode:'taskbook', source:'auto', _auto:true,
      fixed:midFx, lowFixed:useLo, highFixed:hiFx,
      zL:midZ, zR:midZ, zMax:(hiZ!=null?hiZ:midZ),
      lowZStart:midZ, highZStart:(hiFx.length?hiZ:null),
      remark:'【无任务书·按规范与大断面自动估算】'+((mi&&mi.note)||''), _autoData:auto };
  },
  /* 无任务书站几何岸边垂线：岸边线取水边与相邻固定线中点（约半间距），
     水位涨落时随水边实时内移（即自动转移）；中点露滩则按0.1m向主槽回退至入水 */
  autoEdges: function(rows,fixedWet,water,z){
    var out=[];
    if(!rows||!water||!fixedWet||!fixedWet.length) return out;
    var wet=fixedWet.slice().sort(function(a,b){return a.x-b.x;});
    var self=this;
    function mk(side){
      var near=side<0?wet[0]:wet[wet.length-1];
      var wx=side<0?water.smallX:water.bigX;
      if(!near) return null;
      var x=(wx+near.x)/2, b=self.bedAt(rows,x), guard=0;
      while((b==null||z-b<=0.001)&&guard++<120){
        x += side<0?0.1:-0.1;                      /* 小端岸向内=x增大；大端岸向内=x减小 */
        if((side<0&&x>=near.x)||(side>0&&x<=near.x)){ x=near.x; b=self.bedAt(rows,x); break; }
        b=self.bedAt(rows,x);
      }
      if(b==null||z-b<=0.001) return null;
      x=Math.round(x*10)/10;
      return {bank:side<0?'autoS':'autoB',active:true,x:x,lo:+z.toFixed(2),hi:+z.toFixed(2),
        bed:b,h:Math.round((z-b)*100)/100,atSmall:side<0,index:0,n:1,overlap:0,fallback:null,
        planned:{x:x,lo:+z.toFixed(2),hi:+z.toFixed(2),bed:b,h:z-b},auto:true,near:near.x,
        label:(side<0?'起点距小端岸边线':'起点距大端岸边线')+'（估算·随水位自动转移）',
        shortLabel:side<0?'小端岸边线':'大端岸边线'};
    }
    var e1=mk(-1), e2=mk(1);
    if(e1)out.push(e1); if(e2)out.push(e2);
    return out;
  },
  /* 核心：按站+水位给出本次施测垂线全集 */
  linesAt: function(name,z){
    var plan=this.getTaskPlan(name);
    var isAuto = !plan || plan.mode !== 'taskbook';
    if(isAuto){
      plan=this.autoPlan(name);
      if(!plan) return {ok:false, reason:'no-taskbook', plan:null};
    }
    if(!plan) return {ok:false, reason:'no-taskbook', plan:null};
    if(!isFinite(+z))return{ok:false,reason:'no-z',plan:plan};
    z=+z;
    var sec=this.latestSec(name),rows=sec?sec.rows:null;
    var self=this;
    var fx0=plan.fixed||[];
    var lowZ=plan.lowZStart!=null?+plan.lowZStart:Math.min(+plan.zL,+plan.zR);
    var highZ=plan.highZStart!=null?+plan.highZStart:null;
    var fixedArr,level,levelName;
    if(z<lowZ-1e-9&&plan.lowFixed&&plan.lowFixed.length){fixedArr=plan.lowFixed.slice();level='low';levelName='低水';}
    else if(highZ!=null&&z>=highZ-1e-9&&plan.highFixed&&plan.highFixed.length){fixedArr=plan.highFixed.slice();level='high';levelName='高水';}
    else{fixedArr=fx0.slice();level='mid';levelName=(z<lowZ-1e-9)?'低水(按中水固定线)':'中水';}
    var fixedWet=[],fixedDry=[];
    fixedArr.forEach(function(x){
      var b=rows?self.bedAt(rows,x):null;
      var h=(b==null)?null:(z-b);
      var o={x:x,bed:b,h:h};
      if(rows&&(b==null||h<=0.001))fixedDry.push(o);else fixedWet.push(o);
    });
    var edges=[];
    ['right','left'].forEach(function(bank){
      var segs=plan[bank];
      var zStart=bank==='right'?+plan.zL:+plan.zR;
      if(!segs||!segs.length){edges.push({bank:bank,active:false,segs:0});return;}
      var atSmall=self.bankAtSmall(plan,bank);
      if(!(z>=zStart-1e-9)){edges.push({bank:bank,active:false,lowWater:true,zStart:zStart,n:segs.length,atSmall:atSmall});return;}
      var seg=self.pickSeg(segs,z,atSmall);
      if(!seg){edges.push({bank:bank,active:false,gap:true,zStart:zStart,n:segs.length,atSmall:atSmall});return;}
      var b=rows?self.bedAt(rows,+seg.x):null;
      var h0=(b==null)?null:(z-b);
      var fallback=null;
      /* 任务书档线因断面冲淤当前露滩时：自动向内（向主槽方向）回退到最近的入水档，保证岸边线在水中；
         小端岸向内=x 增大方向，大端岸向内=x 减小方向。无需人工选择，仅透明标注并提示复测断面。 */
      if(rows&&b!=null&&h0<=0.001){
        var cands=segs.filter(function(s){
          if(s===seg)return false;
          return atSmall?(+s.x>+seg.x):(+s.x<+seg.x);
        }).sort(function(a,c){return atSmall?(+a.x)-(+c.x):(+c.x)-(+a.x);});
        for(var ci=0;ci<cands.length;ci++){
          var cb=self.bedAt(rows,+cands[ci].x);
          if(cb!=null&&z-cb>0.001){fallback={seg:cands[ci],bed:cb,h:z-cb};break;}
        }
      }
      var useSeg=seg,useBed=b,useH=h0;
      if(fallback){useSeg=fallback.seg;useBed=fallback.bed;useH=fallback.h;}
      edges.push({bank:bank,active:true,x:+useSeg.x,lo:+useSeg.lo,hi:+useSeg.hi,bed:useBed,h:useH,
        atSmall:atSmall,index:segs.indexOf(useSeg),n:segs.length,overlap:self.overlapInfo(segs).length,
        fallback:fallback,
        planned:{x:+seg.x,lo:+seg.lo,hi:+seg.hi,bed:b,h:h0}});
    });
    var water=rows?this.edgesAt(rows,z):null;
    if(isAuto){
      /* 无任务书：岸边转移线自“中水起始水位 lowZ”起按当前水面几何实时生成（随水位自动转移）；
         低于中水起始的低水期按低水固定线施测，不设岸边转移线，仅标注低水状态 */
      if(z>=lowZ-1e-9){
        edges=this.autoEdges(rows,fixedWet,water,z);
      }else{
        edges=[
          {bank:'autoS',active:false,lowWater:true,zStart:lowZ,n:0,atSmall:true},
          {bank:'autoB',active:false,lowWater:true,zStart:lowZ,n:0,atSmall:false}
        ];
      }
    }
    return{ok:true,source:isAuto?'auto':'taskbook',auto:!!isAuto,name:name,plan:plan,z:z,sec:sec,rows:rows,
      dir:this.direction(plan),level:level,levelName:levelName,lowZ:lowZ,highZ:highZ,
      fixedWet:fixedWet,fixedDry:fixedDry,edges:edges,water:water,
      totalWet:fixedWet.length+edges.filter(function(e){return e.active;}).length};
  },
  /* 历史最大流速：相近水位(±0.3m)实测断面平均流速最大值；点流速按经验系数1.3估算 */
  histVmax: function(name,z){
    try{
      var st=window.HS_LAYOUT.yltStation(name);if(!st||!st.years)return null;
      var recs=[];
      Object.keys(st.years).forEach(function(y){
        (st.years[y]||[]).forEach(function(r){
          var v=parseFloat(r.v),zz=parseFloat(r.z);
          if(isFinite(v)&&v>0)recs.push({y:y,z:zz,v:v,q:r.q});
        });
      });
      if(!recs.length)return null;
      var near=isFinite(z)?recs.filter(function(r){return isFinite(r.z)&&Math.abs(r.z-z)<=0.3;}):[];
      var pool=near.length?near:recs;
      var mx=pool[0];pool.forEach(function(r){if(r.v>mx.v)mx=r;});
      var ys=recs.map(function(r){return r.y;}).filter(function(v,i,a){return a.indexOf(v)===i;}).sort();
      return{vAvgMax:Math.round(mx.v*1000)/1000,vPoint:Math.round(mx.v*1.3*100)/100,
        n:pool.length,total:recs.length,years:ys,nearOnly:near.length>0,at:mx};
    }catch(e){return null;}
  }
};

/* 预置转移方案注入数据中心（仅该站无任何 transfers 记录时注入，不覆盖用户成果） */
window.ensureTransferSeed = function(name){
  var plan = window.HS_TRANSFER_PLANS[name];
  if(!plan){ try{ var _st0=null, _yd0=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ylt_data_'+(window._bureau||localStorage.getItem('ylt_bureau')||''))||localStorage.getItem('ylt_data')||'null'); if(_yd0&&_yd0.stations){ for(var _i0=0;_i0<_yd0.stations.length;_i0++){ if(_yd0.stations[_i0].name===name){ _st0=_yd0.stations[_i0]; break; } } } if(_st0&&_st0.vplanTb) plan=_st0.vplanTb; }catch(e){} }
  if(!plan) return;
  var bu = (window._bureau || (localStorage.getItem('ylt_bureau')||'')).trim();
  var keys = bu ? ['ylt_data_'+bu,'ylt_data'] : ['ylt_data'];
  keys.forEach(function(k){
    try{
      var yd = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||'null');
      if(!yd || !Array.isArray(yd.stations)) return;
      var st = null;
      for(var i=0;i<yd.stations.length;i++){ if(yd.stations[i].name===name){ st=yd.stations[i]; break; } }
      if(!st) return;
      if(!st.hist) st.hist = {};
      var tm = st.hist.transfers || {};
      if(Object.keys(tm).length) return;
      var yr = String(plan.year || new Date().getFullYear());
      var rec = {
        id: 'seed_tf_'+name,
        name: (plan.mode==='taskbook'?'任务书垂线转移方案（预置）':'垂线转移方案（系统预置·待布设）'),
        date: '', bank:'', wlevel:'', source:'preset',
        mode: plan.mode, fixed: plan.fixed ? plan.fixed.slice() : [],
        zMax: (plan.zMax!=null?plan.zMax:''), zL:(plan.zL!=null?plan.zL:''), zR:(plan.zR!=null?plan.zR:''),
        right: plan.right ? plan.right : [], left: plan.left ? plan.left : [],
        remark: plan.remark || ''
      };
      st.hist.transfers = {}; st.hist.transfers[yr] = [rec];
      localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(yd));
    }catch(e){}
  });
};

/* 自动布设方案注入：该站有大断面且无任何 layouts 记录时，按规范生成一条（可在数据中心重建/覆盖） */
window.ensureLayoutSeed = function(name){
  try{
    if(!window.HS_TRANSFER_PLANS[name]) return;
    var bu = (window._bureau || (localStorage.getItem('ylt_bureau')||'')).trim();
    var keys = bu ? ['ylt_data_'+bu,'ylt_data'] : ['ylt_data'];
    keys.forEach(function(k){
      try{
        var yd = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)||'null');
        if(!yd || !Array.isArray(yd.stations)) return;
        var st = null;
        for(var i=0;i<yd.stations.length;i++){ if(yd.stations[i].name===name){ st=yd.stations[i]; break; } }
        if(!st) return;
        if(!st.hist) st.hist = {};
        var lm = st.hist.layouts || {};
        var rec = window.HS_LAYOUT.genForStation(name);
        if(!rec || !rec.ok) return;
        /* 已有方案且所用断面未变化则不重复生成；断面有更新则自动重建 */
        var existing = null;
        Object.keys(lm).forEach(function(y){ (lm[y]||[]).forEach(function(r){ if(!existing) existing=r; }); });
        if(existing && String(existing.sectionYear||'')===String(rec.sectionYear||'') && String(existing.sectionDate||'')===String(rec.sectionDate||'')) return;
        st.hist.layouts = {};
        st.hist.layouts[String(rec.year)] = [rec];
        localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(yd));
      }catch(e){}
    });
  }catch(e){}
};
window.syncStationSection = function(name){
  if(!name) return;
  try{ window.ensureTransferSeed(name); window.ensureLayoutSeed(name); }catch(e){}
  var section = null, planCfg = null, clsVal = '';


  /* ---- 1) 读取新数据中心（ylt_data），按站名定位 ---- */
  var yd = null;
  try{
    var bu = ((window._bureau||(localStorage.getItem('ylt_bureau')||'')).trim());
    var keys = bu ? ['ylt_data_'+bu,'ylt_data'] : ['ylt_data'];
    for(var ki=0;ki<keys.length;ki++){
      yd = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(keys[ki]) || 'null');
      if(yd && yd.stations) break;
    }
  }catch(e){ yd = null; }
  var stn = null;
  /* 统一用 HS_LAYOUT.yltStation：跨所有 ylt_data* 库，取资料最完整的同名记录 */
  try{ if(window.HS_LAYOUT && window.HS_LAYOUT.yltStation) stn = window.HS_LAYOUT.yltStation(name); }catch(e){ stn = null; }
  if(!stn && yd && yd.stations){
    for(var i = 0; i < yd.stations.length; i++){
      if(String(yd.stations[i].name || '') === name){ stn = yd.stations[i]; break; }
    }
  }

  if(stn){
    var hist = stn.hist || {};

    /* ---- 2) 大断面翻译为子应用格式 ---- */
    var secMap = hist.sections || {};
    var secYears = Object.keys(secMap).sort();
    if(secYears.length){
      /* 智能选断面：优先基本水尺/测流断面，排除比降/浮标等专用断面 */
      var secObj = null;
      try{ if(window.HS_LAYOUT && window.HS_LAYOUT.latestSection) secObj = window.HS_LAYOUT.latestSection(stn); }catch(e){ secObj = null; }
      if(!secObj){
        var secList = secMap[secYears[secYears.length - 1]];
        if(Array.isArray(secList)){
          for(var k = 0; k < secList.length; k++){ if(secList[k] && secList[k].rows && secList[k].rows.length){ secObj = secList[k]; break; } }
        }
      }
      if(secObj){
        var level = parseFloat(secObj.wlevel);
        var wRows = [], bRows = [];
        secObj.rows.forEach(function(r){
          var d = parseFloat(r.dist), e = parseFloat(r.elev);
          if(isNaN(d) || isNaN(e)) return;
          var t = String(r.type || '');
          var isB;
          if(t) isB = (t.indexOf('岸') >= 0 || t.toLowerCase() === 'bank');
          else isB = (!isNaN(level) && e >= level + 0.001);
          if(isB) bRows.push({dist:d, h:e});
          else wRows.push({dist:d, elev:e});
        });
        if(isNaN(level) && wRows.length){
          var maxE = -Infinity;
          wRows.forEach(function(r){ if(r.elev > maxE) maxE = r.elev; });
          level = maxE;
        }
        if(isNaN(level)) level = 0;
        var waterPts = wRows.map(function(r){ return {dist:r.dist, depth:+(level - r.elev).toFixed(2), hb:r.elev}; });
        var allPts = bRows.map(function(r){ return {dist:r.dist, h:r.h}; })
          .concat(waterPts.map(function(r){ return {dist:r.dist, h:r.hb}; }))
          .sort(function(a,b){ return a.dist - b.dist; });
        section = {
          name: secObj.name || '基本断面',
          waterLevel: level,
          bank: bRows, water: waterPts, points: allPts,
          year: secObj.year || '', date: secObj.date || '', secSource: '数据中心断面柜',
          updatedAt: new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)
        };
      }
    }

    /* ---- 3) 任务书翻译为测流方案配置 ---- */
    var tbMap = hist.taskbook || {};
    var tbYears = Object.keys(tbMap).sort();
    if(tbYears.length){
      var tb = tbMap[tbYears[tbYears.length - 1]];
      var clsMap = {'一':'1','二':'2','三':'3'};
      var clsNum = clsMap[String(tb.cls || '').charAt(0)] || '';
      var modeStr = String(tb.mode || '');
      var tmode = modeStr.indexOf('精测') >= 0 ? 'precise' : (modeStr.indexOf('简测') >= 0 ? 'simple' : 'normal');
      var vfix = String(tb.vfix || '').replace(/[\/／，；;、\s]+/g, ',').replace(/^,|,$/g, '');
      planCfg = {};
      if(clsNum) planCfg.t_cls = clsNum;
      planCfg.t_mode = tmode;
      if(tb.dur) planCfg.t_dur = String(tb.dur).replace(/[^\d.]/g, '');
      if(tb.kb) planCfg.t_kb = String(tb.kb).replace(/[^\d.]/g, '');
      if(vfix) planCfg.v_fix = vfix;
      var edgeAt = function(ed){
        var s = String(ed || '').trim();
        if(!s) return '';
        if(s.indexOf(':') >= 0) return s;
        var d = parseFloat(s);
        if(isNaN(d) || !section) return s;
        var best = null, bd = Infinity;
        section.points.forEach(function(p){ var dd = Math.abs(p.dist - d); if(dd < bd){ bd = dd; best = p; } });
        return best ? d + ':' + best.h : s;
      };
      var eL = edgeAt(tb.edL), eR = edgeAt(tb.edR);
      if(eL) planCfg.v_edL = eL;
      if(eR) planCfg.v_edR = eR;
      if(clsNum) clsVal = String(tb.cls);
      if(!Object.keys(planCfg).length) planCfg = null;
    }

    /* ---- 4) 精度等级（测站基本信息优先于任务书） ---- */
    var basicMap = hist.basic || {};
    var bys = Object.keys(basicMap).sort();
    for(var bi = bys.length - 1; bi >= 0; bi--){
      var b = basicMap[bys[bi]];
      if(b && b.cls){ clsVal = String(b.cls); break; }
    }
  }

  /* ---- 5) 兼容旧世界：HS_SECTIONS 硬编码数据（如清水）作为补充/回退 ---- */
  var legacy = window.HS_SECTIONS[name];
  if(legacy){
    if(legacy.plan && !planCfg) planCfg = Object.assign({}, legacy.plan);
    if(!section){
      var lsecs = legacy.sections || {};
      var lys = Object.keys(lsecs).sort();
      if(lys.length){
        var ls = lsecs[lys[lys.length - 1]];
        var lbPts = (ls.bank || []).map(function(p){ return {dist:p[0], h:p[1]}; });
        var lwPts = (ls.water || []).map(function(p){ return {dist:p[0], depth:(ls.level || 0) - p[1], hb:p[1]}; });
        var lpAll = lbPts.concat(lwPts.map(function(w){ return {dist:w.dist, h:w.hb}; })).sort(function(a,b){ return a.dist - b.dist; });
        section = {name:'基本断面', waterLevel:ls.level || 0, bank:lbPts, water:lwPts, points:lpAll, year:lys[lys.length-1]||'', date:'', secSource:'系统内置断面', updatedAt:new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)};
      }
    }
  }

  /* ---- 6) 精度等级 / 仪器设备 / 任务书配置 写入各模块专用键 ---- */
  if(clsVal){ try{ localStorage.setItem('hs_cls_' + name, clsVal); }catch(e){} }
  try{
    var dcEq = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('dc_equipments') || 'null');
    if(dcEq && dcEq.length) localStorage.setItem('hs_equip_' + name, JSON.stringify(dcEq));
  }catch(e){}
  if(planCfg){ try{ localStorage.setItem('hs_plan_' + name, JSON.stringify(planCfg)); }catch(e){} }

  /* ---- 7) 写入 hs_shared，供测流方案/垂线转移等子应用读取 ----
     lockSec＝全链路唯一断面：只有平台替第一模块（垂线设置）从数据中心调取时写入，
     垂线转移/测流方案/流量计算一律只读这一份，不再各自找断面 */
  var bureau = window._bureau || '';
  var lockSec = null;
  if(section && section.points && section.points.length >= 2){
    lockSec = {
      station: name,
      points: section.points.map(function(p){ return {dist:+p.dist, h:+p.h}; }),
      waterLevel: parseFloat(section.waterLevel),
      name: section.name || '基本断面',
      source: section.secSource || '数据中心断面柜',
      year: section.year || '', date: section.date || '',
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
  }
  ['hs_shared_default', 'hs_shared_' + bureau].forEach(function(key){
    var s = {};
    try{ s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '{}'); }catch(e){}
    if(section) s.section = section;
    if(lockSec) s.lockSec = lockSec;
    if(planCfg) s.plan = planCfg;
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(s));
  });
};

/* 全链路唯一断面：读取（下游模块专用，站名不符视为没有）与锁存（仅第一模块/测量保存/切站调用） */
window.hsGetLockSec = function(name){
  try{
    var bu = ((window._bureau || (localStorage.getItem('ylt_bureau') || ''))).trim();
    var keys = bu ? ['hs_shared_' + bu, 'hs_shared_default'] : ['hs_shared_default'];
    for(var i=0;i<keys.length;i++){
      var s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(keys[i]) || '{}');
      var lk = s && s.lockSec;
      if(lk && lk.points && lk.points.length >= 2 && (!name || lk.station === name)) return lk;
    }
  }catch(e){}
  return null;
};
window.hsSetLockSec = function(name, points, meta){
  try{
    if(!name || !points || points.length < 2) return false;
    var bu = ((window._bureau || (localStorage.getItem('ylt_bureau') || ''))).trim();
    var keys = bu ? ['hs_shared_' + bu, 'hs_shared_default'] : ['hs_shared_default'];
    var lk = {
      station: name,
      points: points.map(function(p){ return {dist:+p.dist, h:+p.h}; }),
      waterLevel: meta && meta.waterLevel != null ? +meta.waterLevel : null,
      name: (meta && meta.name) || '基本断面',
      source: (meta && meta.source) || '数据中心断面柜',
      year: (meta && meta.year) || '', date: (meta && meta.date) || '',
      at: new Date().toISOString()
    };
    keys.forEach(function(key){
      var s = {};
      try{ s = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key) || '{}'); }catch(e){}
      s.lockSec = lk;
      localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(s));
    });
    return true;
  }catch(e){ return false; }
};

/* 登录页回车确认：姓名→密码→登录；研发(超管)窗口同理 */
document.addEventListener('keydown', function(e){
  if (e.key !== 'Enter') return;
  var el = document.activeElement;
  if (!el) return;
  try {
    if (el.id === 'loginUser') { e.preventDefault(); var p1 = document.getElementById('loginPwd'); if (p1) p1.focus(); }
    else if (el.id === 'loginPwd') { e.preventDefault(); doLogin(); }
    else if (el.id === 'superName') { e.preventDefault(); var s1 = document.getElementById('superPwd'); if (s1) s1.focus(); }
    else if (el.id === 'superPwd') { e.preventDefault(); doSuperLogin(); }
  } catch(err) {}
});

/* =====================================================================
 * 注册（选部门 → 待认证）
 * ===================================================================== */
function renderRegPage(pid) {
  showPage('regPage');
  if (!pid) pid = defaultProvince();
  currentProvince = pid;
  var p = provinceById(pid);
  $('regProvince').textContent = p ? p.name : '';
  $('regMsg').textContent = '';
  var prov = $('regProv');
  prov.innerHTML = sys.provinces.map(function(x){ return '<option value="'+x.id+'">'+esc(x.name)+'</option>'; }).join('');
  prov.value = String(pid);
  prov.onchange = function(){ currentProvince = +prov.value; renderRegCity(+prov.value); };
  renderRegCity(pid);
  renderRegDeptByCity();
  orgPick.prov = pid; orgPick.kind = ''; orgPick.org = 0; orgPick.sub = 0;
  renderOrgFilter('reg');
}
function renderRegCity(pid) {
  var c = $('regCity');
  c.innerHTML = '';
  var pn = provinceById(pid) ? provinceById(pid).name : '';
  c.innerHTML += '<option value="-1">省级（'+esc(pn)+'）</option>';
  childrenOf(0).filter(function(o){ return o.province===pid && o.type==='bureau'; }).forEach(function(b){ c.innerHTML += '<option value="'+b.id+'">'+esc(b.name)+'</option>'; });
  c.onchange = renderRegDeptByCity;
  renderRegDeptByCity();
}
function renderRegDeptByCity() {
  var d = $('regDept');
  d.innerHTML = '';
  var city = +$('regCity').value;
  if (city === -1) {
    childrenOf(0).filter(function(o){ return o.province===currentProvince && o.type==='dept'; }).forEach(function(o){ d.innerHTML += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'（省局科室）</option>'; });
  } else if (city) {
    childrenOf(city).forEach(function(o){ if (o.type==='dept') d.innerHTML += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'（市局科室）</option>'; if (o.type==='county') d.innerHTML += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'（县域局）</option>'; });
  }
  if (!d.options.length) d.innerHTML = '<option value="">暂无部门</option>';
}
// 按组织树生成部门下拉（省→地市→科室/县域局）
function buildRegOrgTree(pid, sel) {
  sel.innerHTML = '';
  // 省的科室
  childrenOf(0).filter(function(o){ return o.province===pid && o.type==='dept'; }).forEach(function(o){
    sel.innerHTML += '<option value="'+o.id+'">　↳ ' + esc(o.name) + '（省局科室）</option>';
  });
  // 地市局及其下级
  childrenOf(0).filter(function(o){ return o.province===pid && o.type==='bureau'; }).forEach(function(b){
    sel.innerHTML += '<option value="'+b.id+'">' + esc(b.name) + '（地市局）</option>';
    childrenOf(b.id).forEach(function(o){
      if (o.type==='dept') sel.innerHTML += '<option value="'+o.id+'">　　↳ ' + esc(o.name) + '（市局科室）</option>';
      if (o.type==='county') sel.innerHTML += '<option value="'+o.id+'">　　↳ ' + esc(o.name) + '（县域局）</option>';
    });
  });
}
function doRegister() {
  var pid = currentProvince;
  var orgId = orgPick.sub || (orgPick.kind ? orgPick.org : 0);
  if (orgPick.kind === 'bureau' && !orgPick.sub) { $('regMsg').textContent = '请先选择地市局科室或县域局'; return; }
  var name = $('regName').value.trim();
  var title = '';
  var dept = '';
  var pwd = $('regPwd').value;
  var pwd2 = $('regPwd2').value;
  $('regMsg').textContent = '';
  if (!orgId) { $('regMsg').textContent = '请选择注册部门'; return; }
  if (!name) { $('regMsg').textContent = '请填写姓名'; return; }
  if (!pwd || pwd.length < 4) { $('regMsg').textContent = '密码至少4位'; return; }
  if (pwd !== pwd2) { $('regMsg').textContent = '两次密码不一致'; return; }
  // 姓名在该部门唯一（在职）
  var dup = sys.users.some(function(u){ return u.orgId===orgId && u.name===name; });
  if (dup) { $('regMsg').textContent = '该部门已有同名账号'; return; }
  var o = orgById(orgId);
  sys.users.push({ id: sys.seq++, orgId: orgId, name: name, role: 'user', title: title, dept: dept, pwd: pwd, status: 'pending', fromOrgId: 0, province: pid });
  saveSys();
  try{ pushSysSafe(); }catch(e){}
  $('regMsg').style.color = 'var(--c-green)';
  $('regMsg').textContent = '注册申请已提交，请等待部门管理员认证后登录。';
  setTimeout(function(){ renderLoginPage(); }, 2000);
}

/* =====================================================================
 * 部门管理员认证审核
 * ===================================================================== */
function renderAuthPage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u || !canAuth(u)) { renderLoginPage(); return; }
    if (!canPerm((typeof u!=='undefined'?u.role:''), '注册认证')) { alert('该功能已被管理员关闭，当前角色无权使用'); return; }  showPage('authPage');  setTopTitle('注册认证');
  var list = [];
  sys.users.forEach(function(x){
    if (x.status !== 'pending') return;
    if (canAuthUser(u, x)) list.push(x);
  });
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>注册认证待办（' + list.length + '）</h3>';
  if (!list.length) h += '<div class="empty">暂无待认证申请</div>';
  list.forEach(function(x){
    var o = orgById(x.orgId);
    h += '<div style="background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px;">'
      + '<b>' + esc(x.name) + '</b>（' + esc(o?o.name:'?') + '）　职务：' + esc(x.title||'—') + '　科室：' + esc(x.dept||'—')
      + ' <button class="btn" style="margin-top:6px" onclick="authPass('+x.id+')">✓ 认证通过</button> '
      + '<button class="btn del" onclick="authReject('+x.id+')">✕ 拒绝</button></div>';
  });
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  $('authPageBody').innerHTML = h;
}function canAuth(u) {
  if (isSuper(u)) return true;
  var scope = manageScope(u);
  if (!scope) return false;
  return !!(scope.province || scope.bureau || scope.county || scope.dept);
}
// 该申请是否由当前用户认证：申请人在其管辖范围内
function canAuthUser(u, x) {
  if (isSuper(u)) return true;
  var o = orgById(x.orgId);
  if (!o) return false;
  var scope = manageScope(u);
  if (!scope) return false;
  // 省局总管理：审批省局部室（部）的注册申请
  if (scope.province) return o.type === 'dept' && !o.pid;
  // 地市局总管理：审批本局科室（科）的注册申请
  if (scope.bureau) return o.type === 'dept' && o.pid === scope.bureau.id;
  // 县局总管理：审批本县局的注册申请
  if (scope.county) return x.orgId === scope.county.id;
  // 科室管理员：审批本科室的注册申请
  if (scope.dept) return x.orgId === scope.dept.id;
  return false;
}
function isDescendant(oId, ancId) {
  var o = orgById(oId);
  while (o && o.pid) {
    if (o.pid === ancId) return true;
    o = orgById(o.pid);
  }
  return oId === ancId;
}
function authPass(uid) {
  var x = userById(uid);
  if (!x) return;
  x.status = 'active';
  saveSys();
  try{ pushSysSafe(); }catch(e){}
  renderAuthPage();
  toast('已认证：' + x.name);
}
function authReject(uid) {
  var x = userById(uid);
  if (!x) return;
  if (!confirm('拒绝该注册申请？')) return;
  sys.users = sys.users.filter(function(z){ return z.id !== uid; });
  saveSys();
  try{ pushSysSafe(); }catch(e){}
  renderAuthPage();
}

/* =====================================================================
 * 机构管理（超管 / 省级 / 地市管理员）
 * ===================================================================== */
function renderOrgPage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u) { renderLoginPage(); return; }
    if (!canPerm((typeof u!=='undefined'?u.role:''), '机构设置')) { alert('该功能已被管理员关闭，当前角色无权使用'); return; }  showPage('orgPage');  setTopTitle('机构设置');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var roleLabel = ({ super:'系统超管', provinceAdmin:'省级总管理员', bureauAdmin:'地市局总管理员', countyAdmin:'县局管理员', deptAdmin:'科室管理员' }[u.role] || u.role);
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>机构设置</h3><p class="mut">当前角色：' + esc(roleLabel) + '<br>管理各级机构：可对机构改名、删除、新增下级机构，以及把人员调到其他机构。</p></div>';
  if (isSuper(u)) {
    h += '<div class="card"><h3>各级机构管理</h3><p class="mut">超管可管理省局科室、各地市局、市局科室与县域局（含新增下级）。</p><div id="allOrgTree"></div></div>';
  } else {
    h += quickOrgCard(u);
  }
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>更多操作</h3><p class="mut">人员调动：选择人员 → 选择调入部门 → 调动，人员岗位随之迁移。</p>' + moreOpsCard(u) + '</div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
  if (isSuper(u)) renderAllOrgTree(); else renderQuickOrgLists(u);
  renderOrgTransfer(u);
}

/* 机构设置：当前机构的科室 + 下级机构，简洁维护（改名/删除/新增） */function orgBasePid(u) {
  var scope = manageScope(u);
  if (scope && scope.bureau) return scope.bureau.id;
  if (scope && scope.county) return scope.county.id;
  return 0; // 省局/超管：下级挂 pid=0（省局科室 + 地市局）
}
function orgSubType(u) {
  var scope = manageScope(u);
  if (scope && scope.bureau) return 'county';      // 市局→县域局
  if (scope && scope.province) return 'bureau';    // 省局→地市局
  return 'county';
}
function orgSubLabel(u) {
  var scope = manageScope(u);
  if (scope && scope.bureau) return '下辖县域局';
  if (scope && scope.province) return '下辖地市局';
  return '';
}
function quickOrgCard(u) {
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>本科室</h3><div id="qDeptList"></div>'
    + '<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><input id="qDeptName" placeholder="新增科室名称" style="flex:1"><button class="btn" onclick="doQuickAdd(\'' + orgBasePid(u) + '\',\'dept\')">新增科室</button></div></div>';
  var sl = orgSubLabel(u);
  if (sl) h += '<div class="card"><h3>' + sl + '</h3><div id="qSubList"></div>'
    + '<div class="row" style="margin-top:8px"><input id="qSubName" placeholder="新增' + sl + '名称" style="flex:1"><button class="btn" onclick="doQuickAdd(\'' + orgBasePid(u) + '\',\'' + orgSubType(u) + '\')">新增</button></div></div>';
  return h;
}
function orgRow(o) {
  return '<div class="row" style="align-items:center"><span style="flex:1">' + esc(o.name) + '</span>'
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="doRenameOrg(' + o.id + ')">改名</button> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="doDelOrg(' + o.id + ')">删除</button></div>';
}
function renderQuickOrgLists(u) {
  var basePid = orgBasePid(u);
  var kids = childrenOf(basePid);
  var scope = manageScope(u);
  if (scope && scope.province) kids = kids.filter(function(o){ return o.province===scope.province.id; });
  var depts = kids.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='dept'; });
  var subs = kids.filter(function(o){ return o.type!=='dept'; });
  var dl = $('qDeptList');
  if (dl) dl.innerHTML = depts.length ? depts.map(orgRow).join('') : '<div class="mut">暂无科室</div>';
  var sl = $('qSubList');
  if (sl) sl.innerHTML = subs.length ? subs.map(orgRow).join('') : '<div class="mut">暂无</div>';
}
function moreOpsCard(u) {
  var h = '<div style="line-height:2"><b>人员调动</b></div><div id="orgTransfer"></div>';
  if (u.role==='countyAdmin') h += '<button class="btn" style="margin-top:6px" onclick="openBizTab()">进入站点管理（本县测站）</button>';
  if (isSuper(u)) h += '<div id="orgTrial" style="margin-top:8px"></div>';
  return h;
}
function doQuickAdd(basePid, type) {
  var el = $(type==='dept' ? 'qDeptName' : 'qSubName');
  var name = (el ? el.value : '').trim();
  if (!name) { alert('请填写名称'); return; }
  var province = 0, u = currentUser(), scope = manageScope(u);
  if (scope && scope.province) province = scope.province.id;
  if (basePid) { var po = orgById(basePid); province = po ? po.province : province; }
  sys.orgs.push({ id: sys.seq++, province: province, pid: basePid, type: type, name: name, adminId: 0, fullName: name });
  saveSys(); renderOrgPage(); toast('已新增：' + name);
}
function renderAllOrgTree(){
  var el=$('allOrgTree'); if(!el) return;
  var provDept=sys.orgs.filter(function(o){return o.type==='dept'&&o.pid===0;});
  var bureaus=sys.orgs.filter(function(o){return o.type==='bureau';});
  var opts='<option value="0">全部机构</option>';
  if(provDept.length) opts+='<option value="prov">省局直属</option>';
  bureaus.forEach(function(o){ opts+='<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; });
  // 默认选中非全部，避免一上来超长列表
  var def = provDept.length ? 'prov' : (bureaus.length ? String(bureaus[0].id) : '0');
  var h='<div style="margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px"><b>选择分级：</b>'
    + '<select id="allOrgSel" onchange="renderAllOrgSub()">'+opts+'</select> '
    + '<span class="mut">先选省局直属或地市局，再显示该级机构列表</span></div>'
    + '<div id="allOrgSub"></div>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
  document.getElementById('allOrgSel').value=def;
  renderAllOrgSub();
}
function renderAllOrgSub(){
  var el=$('allOrgSub'); if(!el) return;
  var sel=document.getElementById('allOrgSel'); var v=sel?sel.value:'0';
  var badge={bureau:'地市局',county:'县局',dept:'科室',province:'省'};
  var h='';
  function row(o,depth){
    var canSub=(o.type==='bureau'||o.type==='county');
    return '<div class="row" style="align-items:center">'
      + '<span style="flex:1">'+(depth?'└ ':'')+'<b>'+esc(o.name)+'</b>'
      + ' <span style="color:var(--t3);font-size:11px">'+(badge[o.type]||'')+'</span>'
      + (isSuper(currentUser())?' <span style="color:var(--t3);font-size:11px">（'+countStaff(o.id)+'人）</span>':'')
      + '</span>'
      + (canSub?'<button class="btn gray" onclick="addSubOrg('+o.id+')">新增下级</button> ':'')
      + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="doRenameOrg('+o.id+')">改名</button> '
      + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="doDelOrg('+o.id+')">删除</button></div>';
  }
  if (v==='0') {
    (function walk(pid,depth){
      childrenOf(pid).forEach(function(o){
        h+=row(o,depth);
        if(o.type==='bureau'||o.type==='county') walk(o.id, depth+1);
      });
    })(0,0);
    h+='<div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" onclick="addSubOrg(0)">新增根级机构（地市局 / 省局科室）</button></div>';
  } else if (v==='prov') {
    sys.orgs.filter(function(o){return o.type==='dept'&&o.pid===0;}).forEach(function(o){ h+=row(o,0); });
  } else {
    var bid=+v;
    var bo=orgById(bid);
    if(bo) h+=row(bo,0);
    sys.orgs.filter(function(o){return o.pid===bid;}).forEach(function(o){ h+=row(o,1); });
    h+='<div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" onclick="addSubOrg('+bid+')">在该市局下新增</button></div>';
  }
  el.innerHTML=h || '<div class="mut">暂无机构</div>';
}
function countStaff(orgId){ return sys.users.filter(function(x){return x.orgId===orgId && x.status==='active' && x.role!=='super';}).length; }
function addSubOrg(pid){
  var po = pid ? orgById(pid) : null;
  var canDept=false, canBureau=false, canCounty=false;
  if(!po){ canDept=true; canBureau=true; }
  else if(po.type==='bureau'){ canDept=true; canCounty=true; }
  else if(po.type==='county'){ canDept=true; }
  else if(po.type==='dept'){ alert('科室无下级，不可新增下级'); return; }
  var opts=[];
  if(canBureau) opts.push('地市局(bureau)');
  if(canDept) opts.push('科室(dept)');
  if(canCounty) opts.push('县局(county)');
  if(!opts.length){ alert('该机构无下级可新增'); return; }
  var type=prompt('选择新增类型：'+opts.join('、')+'（可直接输入类型名）', opts[0]);
  if(!type) return;
  var name=prompt('输入名称：',''); if(!name) return;
  name=name.trim(); if(!name) return;
  type = type.indexOf('地市局')>=0?'bureau':(type.indexOf('县局')>=0?'county':'dept');
  var province = po ? po.province : 0;
  sys.orgs.push({ id: sys.seq++, province: province, pid: pid, type: type, name: name, adminId: 0, fullName: name });
  saveSys(); renderOrgPage(); recordAudit('机构设置','新增'+(({bureau:'地市局',county:'县局',dept:'科室'})[type]||type)+'：'+name,'admin'); toast('已新增：'+name);
}
function doRenameOrg(id) {
  var o = orgById(id); if (!o) return;
  var nn = prompt('新名称：', o.name); if (nn === null) return;
  nn = nn.trim(); if (!nn) return;
  o.name = nn; o.fullName = nn;
  saveSys(); renderOrgPage(); toast('已改名：' + nn);
}
function doDelOrg(id) {
  var o = orgById(id); if (!o) return;
  var kids = childrenOf(id);
  var users = sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.orgId === id; });
  if (o.pid === 0 && (kids.length || users.length)) { alert('该机构下还有人员或子机构，请先调整后再删除。'); return; }
  if (!confirm('确定删除「' + o.name + '」？其下人员与子机构将并入上级机构。')) return;
  var pid = o.pid;
  kids.forEach(function(k){ k.pid = pid; });
  users.forEach(function(x){ x.orgId = pid ? pid : x.orgId; });
  // 删除该机构专属管理员账号（机构已不存在）
  sys.users = sys.users.filter(function(x){ return !(x.orgId === id && (x.role==='countyAdmin'||x.role==='bureauAdmin'||x.role==='provinceAdmin')); });
  sys.orgs = sys.orgs.filter(function(x){ return x.id !== id; });
  saveSys(); renderOrgPage(); toast('已删除：' + o.name);
}
function renderOrgTree() {
  var u = currentUser();
  var tree = buildTreeHTML(0, visibleOrgs(u), 0);
  $('orgTree').innerHTML = tree;
}
function buildTreeHTML(pid, vis, depth) {
  var h = '';
  childrenOf(pid).forEach(function(o){
    if (!vis.some(function(v){ return v.id===o.id; })) return;
    h += '<div style="padding-left:' + (depth*18) + 'px;line-height:1.9;">';
    var typeLabel = { province:'省', bureau:'地市局', dept:'科室', county:'县域局' }[o.type] || o.type;
    h += (depth?'└ ':'') + '<b>' + esc(o.name) + '</b> <span style="color:var(--t3);font-size:11px">(' + typeLabel + ')</span>';
    var adm = o.adminId ? userById(o.adminId) : null;
    if (adm) h += ' <span style="color:var(--c-green);font-size:11px">管理员：' + esc(displayName(adm)) + '</span>';
    h += '</div>';
    h += buildTreeHTML(o.id, vis, depth+1);
  });
  return h;
}
function renderOrgAdd(u) {
  var h = '<div class="row"><label>父级部门</label><select id="addParent"></select></div>'
        + '<div class="row"><label>类型</label><select id="addType"><option value="bureau">地市局</option><option value="dept">科室</option><option value="county">县域局</option></select></div>'
        + '<div class="row"><label>名称</label><input id="addName" placeholder="部门名称"></div>'
        + '<button class="btn" onclick="doAddOrg()">新建部门</button>';
  $('orgAdd').innerHTML = h;
  // 父级选项：当前可新增的父级（按角色）
  var parentOpts = [];
  if (isSuper(u)) {
    parentOpts.push({id:0, name:'（作为顶级：省）'});
  }
  var scope = manageScope(u);
  if (scope.province) {
    // 省管可加：省局科室(pid=0, province=湖南)、地市局(pid=0)
    sys.orgs.filter(function(o){ return o.province===scope.province.id && o.pid===0; }).forEach(function(o){ parentOpts.push({id:o.id,name:o.name}); });
    parentOpts.push({id:0,name:'（省下直属）'}); // pid=0 表示省份下（省局科室/地市局）
  }
  if (scope.bureau) {
    parentOpts.push({id:scope.bureau.id, name:scope.bureau.name});
  }
  var sel = $('addParent');
  sel.innerHTML = parentOpts.map(function(o){ return '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; }).join('');
  if (!parentOpts.length) sel.innerHTML = '<option value="">无可用父级</option>';
}
function doAddOrg() {
  var u = currentUser();
  var pid = +$('addParent').value;
  var type = $('addType').value;
  var name = $('addName').value.trim();
  if (!pid && !isSuper(u) && u.role!=='provinceAdmin') { alert('请选择父级部门'); return; }
  if (!name) { alert('请填写名称'); return; }
  var province = 0;
  var scope = manageScope(u);
  if (scope && scope.province) province = scope.province.id;
  if (pid) { var po = orgById(pid); province = po ? po.province : province; }
  if (isSuper(u) && pid === 0) { alert('添加省份请在省管理页操作'); return; }
  sys.orgs.push({ id: sys.seq++, province: province, pid: pid, type: type, name: name, adminId: 0 });
  saveSys();
  renderOrgPage();
  toast('已新建部门：' + name);
}
function renderOrgAdmin(u) {
  var h = '<div class="row"><label>机构</label><select id="admOrg"></select></div>'
        + '<div class="row"><label>账号</label><select id="admUser"></select></div>'
        + '<button class="btn" onclick="doSetAdmin()">设为本部门管理员</button>';
  $('orgAdmin').innerHTML = h;
  var orgs = visibleOrgs(u);
  var so = $('admOrg');
  so.innerHTML = orgs.map(function(o){ return '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; }).join('');
  // 账号：该机构在职用户（非总管理员）
  refreshAdmUser();
}
function refreshAdmUser() {
  var orgId = +$('admOrg').value;
  var su = $('admUser');
  var list = sys.users.filter(function(u2){ return u2.orgId===orgId && u2.status==='active' && u2.role!=='super'; });
  su.innerHTML = list.map(function(u2){ return '<option value="'+u2.id+'">'+esc(u2.name)+'（'+esc(u2.title||'职工')+'）</option>'; }).join('');
  if (!list.length) su.innerHTML = '<option value="">该机构暂无普通账号</option>';
}
function doSetAdmin() {
  var orgId = +$('admOrg').value;
  var uid = +$('admUser').value;
  if (!uid) { alert('请选择账号'); return; }
  var u2 = userById(uid);
  u2.admin = true;
  var o = orgById(orgId);
  o.adminId = uid;
  saveSys();
  renderOrgPage();
  toast('已设 ' + u2.name + ' 为 ' + o.name + ' 管理员');
}
function renderOrgTransfer(u) {
  var h = '<div class="row"><label>选择机构</label><select id="trOrgF" onchange="filterTransUsers()"></select></div>'
        + '<div class="row"><label>人员</label><select id="trFrom"></select></div>'
        + '<div class="row"><label>调入部门</label><select id="trTo"></select></div>'
        + '<button class="btn" onclick="doTransfer()">调动</button>';
  $('orgTransfer').innerHTML = h;
  var orgs = visibleOrgs(u);
  // 机构下拉按一二三级分组：一级省局科室 / 二级地市局+市局科室 / 三级县局+县局科室
  var g1='',g2='',g3='';
  orgs.forEach(function(o){
    var lbl = esc(o.name) + '（' + countStaff(o.id) + '人）';
    var pid = o.pid;
    var po = pid ? orgById(pid) : null;
    if (o.type==='dept' && pid===0) g1 += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+lbl+'</option>';
    else if (o.type==='bureau') g2 += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+lbl+'</option>';
    else if (o.type==='dept' && po && po.type==='bureau') g2 += '<option value="'+o.id+'">└ '+lbl+'</option>';
    else if (o.type==='county') g3 += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+lbl+'</option>';
    else if (o.type==='dept' && po && po.type==='county') g3 += '<option value="'+o.id+'">└ '+lbl+'</option>';
  });
  var totalStaff = orgs.reduce(function(n,o){ return n + sys.users.filter(function(x){return x.orgId===o.id&&x.status==='active'&&x.role!=='super';}).length; },0);
  $('trOrgF').innerHTML = '<option value="0">全部机构（'+totalStaff+'人）</option>'
    + (g1?'<optgroup label="一级 · 省局科室">'+g1+'</optgroup>':'')
    + (g2?'<optgroup label="二级 · 地市局及科室">'+g2+'</optgroup>':'')
    + (g3?'<optgroup label="三级 · 县局及科室">'+g3+'</optgroup>':'');
  // 调入部门同样按三级分组
  var ts = $('trTo');
  ts.innerHTML = '<option value="0">请选择调入部门</option>'
    + (g1?'<optgroup label="一级 · 省局科室">'+g1.replace(/（\d+人）/g,'')+'</optgroup>':'')
    + (g2?'<optgroup label="二级 · 地市局及科室">'+g2.replace(/（\d+人）/g,'')+'</optgroup>':'')
    + (g3?'<optgroup label="三级 · 县局及科室">'+g3.replace(/（\d+人）/g,'')+'</optgroup>':'');
  filterTransUsers();
}
function filterTransUsers(){
  var fs = $('trFrom'); if(!fs) return;
  var oid = +($('trOrgF') ? $('trOrgF').value : 0);
  var orgs = visibleOrgs(currentUser());
  var users = [];
  orgs.forEach(function(o){
    if (oid && o.id !== oid) return;
    sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.orgId===o.id && x.status==='active' && x.role!=='super'; }).forEach(function(x){ users.push(x); });
  });
  fs.innerHTML = users.length
    ? users.map(function(x){ var o=orgById(x.orgId); return '<option value="'+x.id+'">'+esc(x.name)+'（'+esc(o?o.name:'?')+'）</option>'; }).join('')
    : '<option value="">该机构暂无人员</option>';
}
function doTransfer() {
  var uid = +$('trFrom').value;
  var toOrg = +$('trTo').value;
  if (!uid || !toOrg) { alert('请选择人员和调入部门'); return; }
  var x = userById(uid);
  var from = x.orgId;
  if (from === toOrg) { alert('已在同一部门'); return; }
  // 在职状态只在新部门，保留原部门档案（fromOrgId 记录来源）
  x.fromOrgId = from;
  x.orgId = toOrg;
  saveSys();
  renderOrgPage();
  toast('已将 ' + x.name + ' 调至 ' + orgById(toOrg).name);
}

/* 试用期限设置（超管/省管可为可见机构设置/修改） */
function renderOrgTrial(u) {
  var t = $('orgTrial');
  var canSet = isSuper(u) || u.role === 'provinceAdmin' || u.role === 'bureauAdmin';
  if (!canSet) { t.innerHTML = '<p class="mut">仅超管可设置机构使用期限。</p>'; return; }
  var orgs = visibleOrgs(u);
  var h = '<p class="mut">默认期限：' + esc((sys.trial && sys.trial.end) || '2027-07-01')
        + '　<button class="btn gray" onclick="setDefaultTrial()">修改默认期限</button></p>';
  h += '<table><tr><th>机构</th><th>有效至</th><th>操作</th></tr>';
  orgs.forEach(function(o){
    var end = trialEffectiveEnd(o.id);
    h += '<tr><td>' + esc(o.name) + '</td>'
       + '<td id="trialEnd_' + o.id + '">' + esc(end) + '</td>'
       + '<td><button class="btn gray" onclick="setOrgTrial(' + o.id + ')">设置</button>'
       + (sys.trial.overrides[o.id] ? ' <button class="btn del" onclick="clearOrgTrial(' + o.id + ')">恢复默认</button>' : '')
       + '</td></tr>';
  });
  h += '</table>';
  t.innerHTML = h;
}
function setDefaultTrial() {
  pickDate((sys.trial && sys.trial.end) || '2027-07-01', function(v){
    if (!v || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) { alert('请选择日期'); return; }
    if (!sys.trial) sys.trial = { end: '2027-07-01', overrides: {} };
    sys.trial.end = v;
    saveSys();
    renderTrialPage();
    recordAudit('期限设置','默认期限改为 '+v,'admin');
    toast('默认期限已改为 ' + v);
  });
}
function setOrgTrial(orgId) {
  var cur = trialEffectiveEnd(orgId);
  var v = prompt('设置该机构试用截止日期（YYYY-MM-DD）', cur);
  if (!v || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) { alert('日期格式应为 YYYY-MM-DD'); return; }
  if (!sys.trial) sys.trial = { end: '2027-07-01', overrides: {} };
  sys.trial.overrides[orgId] = v;
  saveSys();
  renderOrgPage();
  toast('已设置 ' + orgById(orgId).name + ' 期限至 ' + v);
}
function clearOrgTrial(orgId) {
  if (!sys.trial || !sys.trial.overrides) return;
  delete sys.trial.overrides[orgId];
  saveSys();
  renderOrgPage();
  toast('已恢复默认期限');
}


/* ---- 统一返回导航（所有页面顶部统一返回栏） ---- */
function bkBar(target, label){
  var b=document.createElement('button'); b.className='bk-rt'; b.textContent='返回';
  b.onclick=function(){ try{ backTo(target); }catch(e){} };
  setTimeout(function(){
    // 统一：返回按钮放入当前可见管理容器的第一个卡片右上角
    var op=document.getElementById('orgPage');
    var ap=document.getElementById('authPage');
    var body=null;
    if(op && op.style.display!=='none'){ body=document.getElementById('orgPageBody'); }
    else if(ap && ap.style.display!=='none'){ body=document.getElementById('authPageBody'); }
    else { var ph=document.getElementById('paneHome'); if(ph && ph.style.display!=='none') body=ph; }
    if(!body) body=document.getElementById('orgPageBody')||document.getElementById('authPageBody')||document.getElementById('paneHome');
    if(body){
      var c=body.querySelector('.card');
      if(c){ c.style.position='relative'; c.appendChild(b); }
      else { body.appendChild(b); }
    }
  },0);
  return '';
}
function backTo(target){
  var f = window[target];
  if (typeof f === 'function') { try { f(); } catch(e){ console.error(e); } }
  else { alert('无上级页面可返回'); }
}
function bkTarget(){ var u=currentUser(); if (isSuper(u)) return 'renderSuperManage'; if (u && u.role==='countyAdmin') return 'renderCountyManagePage'; if (u && (u.role==='provinceAdmin'||u.role==='bureauAdmin')) return 'renderAdminHome'; return 'openMineTab'; }
function bkLabel(){ return '管理'; } // 返回文字统一为 返回管理
/* ---- 超管管理首页（登录后直接进入） ---- */
function renderSuperManage() {
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u) { renderLoginPage(); return; }
  adminView='super';
  showPage('orgPage');  setTopTitle('超级管理');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var abtn = function(k,n,col){ var bg=col?"background:"+col+";color:#fff":"background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--t1)"; return '<a style="display:inline-block;padding:4px 12px;margin:3px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;'+bg+'" onclick="'+k+'">'+n+'</a>'; };
  var h = bkBar('backFromManage','管理') + '<div class="card"><h3>超级管理</h3><p class="mut">超管：' + esc(u.name) + '，可管理全省机构、权限、期限与登录情况。</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>系统设置</h3><div style="line-height:2">'
    + abtn('renderStaffManage()','人员账号管理') + abtn('renderOrgPage()','机构设置') + abtn('renderPermManage()','权限设置')
    + abtn('renderTrialPage()','期限设置') + abtn('renderProvinceManage()','省份管理') + abtn('renderGlobalConfigPage()','全局配置')
    + abtn('renderDataExport()','数据导出/导入') + abtn('renderPwdResetPage()','密码重置') + abtn('renderNoticePage()','系统通知')
    + abtn('renderLinkedSetting()','关联账号设置')
    + '</div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>账号与机构管理</h3><div style="line-height:2">'
    + abtn('renderEnterOrgPage()','进入各级机构查看') + abtn('renderAuthPage()','注册认证')
    + '</div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>统计与审计</h3><div style="line-height:2">'
    + abtn('renderLoginLogPage()','登录日志与统计') + abtn('renderUsagePage()','功能使用统计') + abtn('renderAuditLogPage()','操作审计') + abtn('renderSysFuncsPage()','系统新功能')
    + '</div></div>';
  body.innerHTML = h;
  /* 第二层标题栏已移除：超管页只保留顶部系统标题栏（右侧用户名/退出由 fillOrgTop 填充） */
}
function renderLinkedSetting() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!isManage(u)) { alert('无权限'); return; }
  showPage('orgPage'); setTopTitle('关联账号设置');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var scope = isSuper(u) ? null : u.orgId;
  var staffs = sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.role==='user' && x.status==='active' && (scope==null || x.orgId===scope); });
  var cur = linkedUserOf(u);
  var opts = '';
  if (scope==null) {
    var byOrg = {};
    staffs.forEach(function(x){ var k=x.orgId; (byOrg[k]=byOrg[k]||[]).push(x); });
    var order = Object.keys(byOrg).sort(function(a,b){ return orgNameOf({orgId:+a}).localeCompare(orgNameOf({orgId:+b})); });
    order.forEach(function(k){
      opts += '<optgroup label="'+esc(orgNameOf({orgId:+k}))+'">';
      byOrg[k].forEach(function(x){ opts += '<option value="'+x.id+'"'+(cur&&cur.id===x.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(x.name)+'</option>'; });
      opts += '</optgroup>';
    });
  } else {
    staffs.forEach(function(x){ opts += '<option value="'+x.id+'"'+(cur&&cur.id===x.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(x.name)+'</option>'; });
  }
  var h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel());
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>关联账号设置</h3><p class="mut">指定一名内部职工作为本管理账号的关联账号。被指定的职工日常首页将显示「进入管理账号」入口，可通过该入口进入本管理页面；本管理页面的返回箭头将回到该职工的日常首页。</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>当前关联账号</h3><div class="row">职工 <select id="linkSel"><option value="">— 未指定 —</option>'+opts+'</select></div>';
  h += '<div class="row"><button class="btn soft" onclick="saveLinkedSetting()">保存关联账号</button></div></div>';
  body.innerHTML = h;
}
function saveLinkedSetting() {
  var u=currentUser(); if(!u) return;
  var sel=document.getElementById('linkSel'); if(!sel) return;
  var val=sel.value;
  var ad=findUser(u.id);
  if (ad) { ad.linked = val ? parseInt(val) : null; saveSys(); toast('已保存关联账号'); }
}
