  var abtn = function(k,n,col){ var bg=col?"background:"+col+";color:#fff":"background:var(--bg-hover);color:var(--t1)"; return '<a style="display:inline-block;padding:4px 12px;margin:3px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:4px;font-size:13px;cursor:pointer;'+bg+'" onclick="'+k+'">'+n+'</a>'; };
  var h = bkBar('backFromManage','管理') + '<div style="text-align:right;padding:2px 8px 6px"><a style="color:#2563eb;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;text-decoration:underline" onclick="doLogout()">退出</a></div>' + '<div class="card"><h3>'+roleLabel+'</h3><p class="mut">'+esc(displayName(u))+' · 管理范围：'+rangeDesc+'</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>系统设置</h3><div style="line-height:2">'
    + abtn('renderStaffManage()','人员账号管理') + abtn('renderOrgPage()','机构设置') + abtn('renderPermManage()','权限设置')
    + abtn('renderDataExport()','数据导出/导入') + abtn('renderPwdResetPage()','密码重置') + abtn('renderNoticePage()','系统通知')
    + abtn('renderLinkedSetting()','关联账号设置')
    + '</div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>账号与机构管理</h3><div style="line-height:2">'
    + abtn('renderAuthPage()','注册认证') + abtn('renderLoginLogPage()','登录日志')
    + (u.role==='bureauAdmin'?abtn('renderSummaryPage()','县域局汇总查看'):'')
    + '</div></div>';
  body.innerHTML = h;
}
function renderPermManage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!isSuper(u) && !(u && (u.role==='provinceAdmin'||u.role==='bureauAdmin'||u.role==='countyAdmin'))) { alert('无权限'); return; }
    if (!canPerm((typeof u!=='undefined'?u.role:''), '权限设置')) { alert('该功能已被管理员关闭，当前角色无权使用'); return; }  showPage('orgPage');  setTopTitle('权限设置');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>权限设置</h3><p class="mut">指定各级机构负责人（管理员），并可逐人设定管理员 / 普通职工权限。</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>各级管理员权限一览</h3><div id="permDesc"></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>权限开关（配置各级管理员可用功能）</h3><div id="permSwitch"></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>机构筛选</h3><select id="permOrgSel" onchange="renderPermLists()"></select> <span class="mut">先选省局直属或地市局，再显示该级管理员与职工权限</span></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>① 指定管理员（各级机构负责人）</h3><div id="permList"></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>② 职工权限（管理员 / 普通职工）</h3><div id="staffPermList"></div></div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
  $('permDesc').innerHTML = permDescHtml();
  renderPermSwitch();
  renderPermOrgSel();
  renderPermLists();
}
function renderPermOrgSel(){
  var s = document.getElementById('permOrgSel'); if (!s) return;
  var u = currentUser(); var vis = visibleOrgs(u);
  var provDept = vis.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='dept' && o.pid===0; });
  var bureaus = vis.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='bureau'; });
  var opts = '<option value="0">全部机构</option>';
  if (provDept.length) opts += '<option value="prov">省局直属</option>';
  bureaus.forEach(function(o){ opts += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; });
  s.innerHTML = opts;
  var def = window.PERM_ORG || (provDept.length ? 'prov' : (bureaus.length ? String(bureaus[0].id) : '0'));
  s.value = def; window.PERM_ORG = def;
}
function renderPermLists(){
  var u = currentUser();
  var s = document.getElementById('permOrgSel');
  var v = s ? s.value : (window.PERM_ORG || '0');
  window.PERM_ORG = v;
  var vis = visibleOrgs(u);
  var visIds = {}; vis.forEach(function(o){ visIds[o.id]=1; });
  var pl = $('permList');
  var hh = '<table style="table-layout:fixed;width:100%"><colgroup><col style="width:55%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:25%"></colgroup><tr><th>机构</th><th>管理员</th><th>操作</th></tr>';
  function add(o, depth){ if (visIds[o.id]) hh += admRow(o, depth, true); }
  if (v === '0') {
    childrenOf(0).forEach(function(o){ if (o.type==='dept') add(o,0); });
    childrenOf(0).filter(function(o){ return o.type==='bureau'; }).forEach(function(b){
      if (!visIds[b.id]) return;
      hh += '<tr><td colspan="3" style="background:#eef3fb;font-weight:700;padding:6px">' + esc(b.name) + '（地市局）</td></tr>';
      add(b,1);
      childrenOf(b.id).forEach(function(o){ add(o,2); });
    });
  } else if (v === 'prov') {
    childrenOf(0).filter(function(o){ return o.type==='dept'; }).forEach(function(o){ add(o,0); });
  } else {
    var bid = +v; var b = orgById(bid);
    if (b) {
      hh += '<tr><td colspan="3" style="background:#eef3fb;font-weight:700;padding:6px">' + esc(b.name) + '（地市局）</td></tr>';
      add(b,1);
      childrenOf(bid).forEach(function(o){ add(o,2); });
    }
  }
  hh += '</table>';
  pl.innerHTML = hh;
  renderStaffPerm(u);
}function admRow(o, depth, showType){
  var adm = o.adminId ? userById(o.adminId) : null;
  var badge = {bureau:'地市局',dept:depth===0?'省科室':'科室',county:'县局'}[o.type]||'';
  return '<tr><td style="padding-left:'+(depth*16)+'px">' + (depth?'└ ':'') + '<b>' + esc(o.name) + '</b> <span style="color:var(--t3);font-size:11px">'+badge+'</span></td>'
    + '<td>' + (adm ? esc(displayName(adm)) : '<span style="color:var(--t3)">未指定</span>') + '</td>'
    + '<td><button class="btn gray" onclick="setPermAdmin('+o.id+')">设置管理员</button></td></tr>';
}
function permDescHtml(){
  return '<table style="width:100%;font-size:12px"><tr><th style="width:20%;text-align:left">级别</th><th style="text-align:left">可管理内容与权限</th></tr>'
    + '<tr><td>一级 · 省局总管理</td><td>管理全省机构架构与省局科室；指定市局总管理；全省机构期限；查看全省登录日志/操作审计/使用统计；审批省局科室注册认证</td></tr>'
    + '<tr><td>二级 · 市局总管理</td><td>管理本市局及下属科室；指定县局总管理与科室负责人；本市机构期限；查看本市及下级登录日志/审计；审批本局科室注册认证</td></tr>'
    + '<tr><td>三级 · 县局总管理</td><td>管理本县局人员名单；审批本县局新人注册认证；查看本县局登录日志/审计/使用统计</td></tr>'
    + '<tr><td>科室负责人</td><td>管理本科室人员名单；审批本科室新人注册认证</td></tr>'
    + '</table>';
}

/* ② 职工权限：管理员 / 普通职工 */function renderPermSwitch(){
  var el=$('permSwitch'); if(!el) return;
  if(!isSuper(currentUser())){ el.innerHTML='<p class="mut">仅超管可配置权限开关</p>'; return; }
  var perms = sys.perms || {};
  var def = {
    prov:['机构设置','人员账号管理','权限设置','期限设置','注册认证','登录日志','功能使用统计','操作审计','省份管理'],
    bureau:['机构设置','人员账号管理','权限设置','注册认证','登录日志','功能使用统计','操作审计'],
    county:['人员账号管理','注册认证','登录日志','功能使用统计','操作审计']
  };
  var lvlLbl = { prov:'一级 · 省局总管理', bureau:'二级 · 市局总管理', county:'三级 · 县局总管理' };
  var h='<p class="mut">默认全部功能可用；关闭某项后，对应级别管理员登录后将无法使用该功能。各级可分别配置。</p>';
  Object.keys(def).forEach(function(lvl){
    var cfg = perms[lvl]||{};
    h+='<div style="background:#f4f7fc;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 10px;margin:8px 0">'
      + '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700">'+lvlLbl[lvl]
      + '<span style="flex:1"></span>'
      + '<button class="btn gray" style="font-size:12px" onclick="setPermLevel(\''+lvl+'\',true)">全开</button>'
      + '<button class="btn gray" style="font-size:12px" onclick="setPermLevel(\''+lvl+'\',false)">全关</button></div>'
      + '<div style="margin-top:6px">';
    def[lvl].forEach(function(m){
      var on = cfg[m]!==false;
      h+='<label style="display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:4px;margin:3px 10px 3px 0;font-size:13px">'
        + '<input type="checkbox" '+(on?'checked':'')+' onchange="setPerm('+JSON.stringify(lvl)+','+JSON.stringify(m)+',this.checked)">'+esc(m)+'</label>';
    });
    h+='</div></div>';
  });
  h+='<button class="btn gray" onclick="resetPerms()">恢复全部默认</button>';
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function setPerm(lvl,m,on){
  if(!sys.perms) sys.perms={};
  if(!sys.perms[lvl]) sys.perms[lvl]={};
  sys.perms[lvl][m]=on;
  saveSys(); toast((on?'已开启':'已关闭')+'：'+lvl+'/'+m);
  recordAudit('权限设置',(on?'开启':'关闭')+' '+(lvl==='prov'?'省局':lvl==='bureau'?'市局':'县局')+'管理员功能：'+m,'admin');
}
function setPermLevel(lvl,on){
  var def={prov:['机构设置','人员账号管理','权限设置','期限设置','注册认证','登录日志','功能使用统计','操作审计','省份管理'],bureau:['机构设置','人员账号管理','权限设置','注册认证','登录日志','功能使用统计','操作审计'],county:['人员账号管理','注册认证','登录日志','功能使用统计','操作审计']};
  if(!sys.perms) sys.perms={};
  if(!sys.perms[lvl]) sys.perms[lvl]={};
  def[lvl].forEach(function(m){ sys.perms[lvl][m]=on; });
  saveSys(); renderPermSwitch(); recordAudit('权限设置',(on?'开启':'关闭')+' '+(lvl==='prov'?'省局':lvl==='bureau'?'市局':'县局')+'管理员全部功能','admin'); toast((on?'已全部开启':'已全部关闭'));
}
function resetPerms(){
  if(!confirm('恢复全部权限开关为默认（全部可用）？')) return;
  sys.perms={}; saveSys(); renderPermSwitch(); recordAudit('权限设置','恢复全部权限开关默认','admin'); toast('已恢复默认');
}
function canPerm(role,module){
  try{
    var p=sys.perms||{}; var lvl=role==='provinceAdmin'?'prov':(role==='bureauAdmin'?'bureau':(role==='countyAdmin'?'county':null));
    if(!lvl) return true;
    var cfg=p[lvl]; if(!cfg) return true;
    return cfg[module]!==false;
  }catch(e){ return true; }
}

function renderStaffPerm(u) {
  var el = $('staffPermList'); if (!el) return;
  var vis = visibleOrgs(u);
  var visIds = {}; vis.forEach(function(o){ visIds[o.id]=1; });
  var v = window.PERM_ORG || '0';
  var scopeIds = [];
  if (v === '0') scopeIds = vis.map(function(o){ return o.id; });
  else if (v === 'prov') vis.forEach(function(o){ if (o.type==='dept' && o.pid===0) scopeIds.push(o.id); });
  else { var bid = +v; scopeIds.push(bid); vis.forEach(function(o){ if (o.pid===bid) scopeIds.push(o.id); }); }
  var staff = sys.users.filter(function(x){
    if (x.status !== 'active' || x.role === 'super') return false;
    if (scopeIds.indexOf(x.orgId) < 0) return false;
    if (x.role==='countyAdmin' || x.role==='bureauAdmin' || x.role==='provinceAdmin') return false;
    return true;
  });
  if (!staff.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="mut">本机构暂无普通职工</div>'; return; }
  // 按机构分组
  var groups = {};
  staff.forEach(function(x){ var k=x.orgId; (groups[k]=groups[k]||[]).push(x); });
  var h = '';
  Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(k){
    var list = groups[k].sort(function(a,b){ return (a.name||'').localeCompare(b.name||'','zh'); });
    var o = orgById(+k);
    h += '<div style="background:#f2f6fd;border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin:8px 0;font-weight:700;font-size:13px">' + esc(o?o.name:'机构'+k) + '（'+list.length+'人）</div>';
    h += '<table style="table-layout:fixed;width:100%"><colgroup><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:26%"><col style="width:30%"></colgroup><tr><th>姓名</th><th>当前权限</th><th colspan="2">操作</th></tr>';
    list.forEach(function(x){
      var isAdm = !!(x.admin) || x.role === 'deptAdmin';
      var roleLbl = x.role==='deptAdmin' ? '科室管理员' : (isAdm ? '管理员' : '普通职工');
      h += '<tr><td>' + esc(displayName(x)) + '</td><td>' + roleLbl + '</td><td colspan="2">'
        + (isAdm
            ? '<button class="btn gray" onclick="setStaffPerm(' + x.id + ',false)">设为普通职工</button>'
            : '<button class="btn gray" onclick="setStaffPerm(' + x.id + ',true)">设为管理员</button>')
        + '</td></tr>';
    });
    h += '</table>';
  });
  el.innerHTML = h;
}

function setStaffPerm(uid, on) {
  var x = userById(uid); if (!x) return;
  x.admin = !!on;
  if (on) { if (x.role === 'user') { x.role = 'deptAdmin'; x.title = '科室管理员'; } }
  else { x.admin = false; if (x.role === 'deptAdmin') { x.role = 'user'; x.title = ''; } }
  saveSys();
  recordAudit('权限设置', (on ? '设置 ' : '取消 ') + (x.name || '') + ' 的管理员权限', 'admin');
  renderPermManage();
  toast((on ? '已设 ' : '已设 ') + (x.name || '') + (on ? ' 为管理员' : ' 为普通职工'));
}

/* ===== 人员账号管理（入职/离职状态流转） ===== */
function renderStaffManage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!(isSuper(u) || (u && (u.role==='provinceAdmin'||u.role==='bureauAdmin'||u.role==='countyAdmin'||u.role==='deptAdmin')))) { alert('无权限'); return; }
    if (!canPerm((typeof u!=='undefined'?u.role:''), '人员账号管理')) { alert('该功能已被管理员关闭，当前角色无权使用'); return; }  showPage('orgPage');  setTopTitle('人员账号管理');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>人员账号管理</h3><p class="mut">批量录入/维护人员名单，自动生成账号（默认密码 123456）。<br>入职 = 建号在职；离职 = 停用账号但保留档案（考勤、排班、分工等历史不丢），账号无法再登录。</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>① 选择机构</h3><div id="staffOrgPick"></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>② 批量入职（一行一个姓名）</h3><textarea id="staffBatch" rows="6" placeholder="每行输入一个姓名，例如：&#10;张三&#10;李四&#10;王五"></textarea><div style="margin-top:6px"><button class="btn" onclick="staffBatchAdd()">批量创建账号（入职）</button></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>③ 逐条入职</h3><div class="row"><input id="staffName" placeholder="姓名" style="flex:1"><button class="btn" onclick="staffAddOne()">新增入职</button></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>④ 人员名单</h3><input id="staffSearch" placeholder="输入姓名关键字，实时筛选" oninput="renderStaffList()" style="width:100%;margin-bottom:8px;padding:8px 10px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:8px;font-size:14px;background:var(--bg-input);color:var(--t1)"><div id="staffList"></div></div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
  renderStaffOrgPick(u);
  renderStaffList();
}function staffSelOrg() {
  var sel = $('staffOrgSel');
  if (sel) return +sel.value;
  var u = currentUser(), sc = manageScope(u);
  if (sc && sc.county) return sc.county.id;
  if (sc && sc.dept) return sc.dept.id;
  if (sc && sc.bureau) return sc.bureau.id;
  return 0;
}
function renderStaffOrgPick(u) {
  var el = $('staffOrgPick'); if (!el) return;
  var sc = manageScope(u);
  var self = (sc && (sc.bureau || sc.county || sc.dept)) || null;
  var all = visibleOrgs(u);
  var h = '<select id="staffOrgA" onchange="fillStaffOrgB()"></select> '
        + '<select id="staffOrgSel" onchange="renderStaffList()"><option value="">请选择机构</option></select> '
        + '<span class="mut">先选归属（省局直属 / 地市局），再选具体机构</span>';
  el.innerHTML = h;
  var provDept = all.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='dept' && o.pid===0; });
  var bureaus = all.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='bureau'; });
  var a = $('staffOrgA');
  var optA = '<option value="0">请选择归属</option>';
  if (provDept.length) optA += '<option value="prov">省局直属</option>';
  bureaus.forEach(function(o){ optA += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; });
  a.innerHTML = optA;
  if (self) {
    if (self.type==='dept' && self.pid===0) a.value='prov';
    else if (self.type==='bureau') a.value=String(self.id);
    else if (self.type==='county') { var p=orgById(self.pid); if (p && p.type==='bureau') a.value=String(p.id); }
    else if (self.type==='dept') { var po=orgById(self.pid); if (po && po.type==='bureau') a.value=String(po.id); else a.value='prov'; }
    fillStaffOrgB();
    var b=$('staffOrgSel');
    var has=Array.prototype.some.call(b.options, function(o){ return o.value===String(self.id); });
    if (has) b.value=String(self.id);
    renderStaffList();
  }
}
function fillStaffOrgB(){
  var a=$('staffOrgA'), b=$('staffOrgSel'); if (!a || !b) return;
  var v=a.value;
  var opts='<option value="">请选择机构</option>';
  if (v==='prov') {
    sys.orgs.filter(function(o){return o.type==='dept'&&o.pid===0;}).forEach(function(o){ opts+='<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; });
  } else if (v && v!=='0') {
    var bid=+v;
    sys.orgs.filter(function(o){return o.pid===bid;}).forEach(function(o){ opts+='<option value="'+o.id+'">'+(o.type==='county'?'[县局] ':'[科室] ')+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; });
  }
  b.innerHTML=opts;
}
function renderStaffList() {
  var el = $('staffList'); if (!el) return;
  var oid = staffSelOrg();
  var o = orgById(oid);
  if (!o) { el.innerHTML = ''; return; }
  var total = sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.orgId===oid && x.role!=='super'; });
  var kw = (($('staffSearch')||{}).value||'').trim().toLowerCase();
  var people = total;
  if (kw) people = total.filter(function(x){ return x.name.toLowerCase().indexOf(kw)>=0; });
  var h = '<div class="mut">'+esc(o.name)+' 共 '+total.length+' 人'+(kw?'（匹配 '+people.length+' 人）':'')+'</div>';
  if (!total.length) { el.innerHTML = h + '<div class="mut">暂无人员</div>'; return; }
  if (!people.length) { el.innerHTML = h + '<div class="mut">未找到匹配人员</div>'; return; }
  h += '<table><tr><th>姓名</th><th>身份</th><th>状态</th><th>操作</th></tr>';
  people.forEach(function(x){
    h += '<tr><td>'+esc(x.name)+'</td><td>'+staffRoleLbl(x)+'</td><td>'+staffStatusLbl(x.status)+'</td><td>'
      + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="staffRename('+x.id+')">改名</button> '
      + (x.status==='left' || x.status==='disabled'
          ? '<button class="btn gray" onclick="staffSetStatus('+x.id+',\'active\')">恢复在职</button>'
          : '<button class="btn gray" onclick="staffSetStatus('+x.id+',\'left\')">离职</button> '
            + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="staffSetStatus('+x.id+',\'disabled\')">停用</button> ')
      + '</td></tr>';
  });
  h += '</table>';
  el.innerHTML = h;
}
function staffBatchAdd() {
  var u = currentUser(); if (!u) return;
  var oid = staffSelOrg(); var o = orgById(oid);
  if (!o) { alert('请先选择机构'); return; }
  var ta = $('staffBatch'); var names = (ta ? ta.value : '').split(/\r?\n/);
  var add = [], skip = [];
  names.forEach(function(n){
    n = (n||'').trim(); if (!n) return;
    if (sys.users.some(function(x){ return x.orgId===oid && x.name===n; })) { skip.push(n); return; }
    add.push(n);
  });
  add.forEach(function(n){
    sys.users.push({ id: sys.seq++, orgId: oid, name: n, role: 'user', title: '', dept: '', pwd: '123456', status: 'active', fromOrgId: 0, province: o.province, pwdCount: 0 });
  });
  saveSys();
  syncPeopleToDaily(oid);
  var msg = '已入职 ' + add.length + ' 人（账号已建）';
  if (skip.length) msg += '；跳过已存在 ' + skip.length + ' 个';
  toast(msg);
  if (ta) ta.value = '';
  renderStaffList();
  recordAudit('人员账号管理', '批量入职 ' + o.name + ' ' + add.length + ' 人', 'admin');
}
function staffAddOne() {
  var u = currentUser(); if (!u) return;
  var oid = staffSelOrg(); var o = orgById(oid);
  if (!o) { alert('请先选择机构'); return; }
  var n = (($('staffName') || {}).value || '').trim();
  if (!n) { alert('请输入姓名'); return; }
  if (sys.users.some(function(x){ return x.orgId===oid && x.name===n; })) { alert('该机构下已存在此人'); return; }
  sys.users.push({ id: sys.seq++, orgId: oid, name: n, role: 'user', title: '', dept: '', pwd: '123456', status: 'active', fromOrgId: 0, province: o.province, pwdCount: 0 });
  saveSys();
  syncPeopleToDaily(oid);
  $('staffName').value = '';
  renderStaffList();
  toast('已入职 ' + n);
  recordAudit('人员账号管理', '入职 ' + o.name + ' ' + n, 'admin');
}
function staffRename(uid) {
  var x = userById(uid); if (!x) return;
  var nn = prompt('新姓名：', x.name); if (nn === null) return;
  nn = nn.trim(); if (!nn) return;
  x.name = nn; saveSys(); renderStaffList(); toast('已改名：' + nn);
}
function staffSetStatus(uid, st) {
  var x = userById(uid); if (!x) return;
  if (st === 'left' && !confirm('确认 ' + x.name + ' 离职？账号将停用，其考勤、排班、分工等历史记录保留。')) return;
  if (st === 'disabled' && !confirm('确认停用 ' + x.name + ' 的账号？')) return;
  x.status = st; saveSys(); syncDailyLeave(x, st); renderStaffList();
  recordAudit('人员账号管理', (x.name||'') + ' -> ' + staffStatusLbl(st), 'admin');
  toast((x.name||'') + ' 已' + staffStatusLbl(st));
}
function isoToday() { var d = new Date(); return d.getFullYear() + '-' + ('0'+(d.getMonth()+1)).slice(-2) + '-' + ('0'+d.getDate()).slice(-2); }
// 入职/离职联动：离职/停用→日常数据标 leave(排班/野外选人自动排除)+active=false；恢复→清空重新纳入；日常无此人则补入

function syncPeopleToDaily(oid){
  try{
    var k='hydro_v19_'+oid;
    var d=null; try{ d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)); }catch(e){}
    if(!d || !Array.isArray(d.people)) return;
    var active=sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.orgId===oid && x.status!=='left' && x.status!=='disabled' && x.role==='user'; });
    active.forEach(function(x){
      var p=null; for(var i=0;i<d.people.length;i++){ if(d.people[i].name===x.name){ p=d.people[i]; break; } }
      if(p){ if(!p.role||p.role==='') p.role=x.title||'职工'; if(!p.dept) p.dept=x.dept||''; p.leave=''; }
      else { d.people.push({ id:(d.seq++), name:x.name, role:x.title||'职工', type:'正式', post:x.dept||'', wx:'', join:'', leave:'', admin:false, duties:[], car:'', phone:'', idCard:'' }); }
    });
    localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(d));
  }catch(e){}
}
function syncDailyLeave(x, st) {
  try {
    var key = 'hydro_v19_' + (x.orgId || 0);
    var s = localStorage.getItem(key);
    var db = s ? JSON.parse(s) : null;
    if (!db || !db.people) return;
    var p = db.people.find(function(m){ return m.name === x.name; });
    if (st === 'left' || st === 'disabled') {
      if (p) { p.leave = isoToday(); p.active = false; }
    } else if (st === 'active') {
      if (p) { p.leave = ''; p.active = true; }
      else {
        db.people.push({ id: db.seq++, name: x.name, role: x.title || '职工', type: '正式', post: x.dept || '', wx: false, admin: false, duties: [], car: '', phone: '', idCard: '', join: '', leave: '', active: true });
      }
    }
    localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(db));
  } catch(e) {}
}

function setPermAdmin(orgId) {
  var o = orgById(orgId);
  var name = prompt('输入该机构总管理员账号名（默认与机构同名）', o.name);
  if (!name) return;
  var x = sys.users.filter(function(u2){ return u2.orgId===orgId && u2.name===name && u2.role!=='super'; })[0];
  if (!x) {
    var r = o.type==='county' ? 'countyAdmin' : (o.type==='bureau' ? 'bureauAdmin' : 'deptAdmin');
    x = { id: sys.seq++, orgId: orgId, name: name, role: r, title: '总管理员', dept: '', pwd: '123456', status: 'active', fromOrgId: 0, province: o.province };
    sys.users.push(x);
  }
  x.admin = true;
  o.adminId = x.id;
  saveSys();
  recordAudit('权限设置', '设置 ' + name + ' 为 ' + o.name + ' 机构管理员', 'admin');
  renderPermManage();
  toast('已设置 ' + name + ' 为 ' + o.name + ' 管理员');
}
function renderTrialPage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u || u.role!=='super') { alert('仅超管可进行期限设置'); return; }
  showPage('orgPage'); setTopTitle('期限设置');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  if (!sys.trial) sys.trial = { end:'2027-07-01', overrides:{}, enabled:true, orgEnabled:{} };
  var tr = sys.trial;
  if (tr.orgEnabled === undefined) tr.orgEnabled = {};
  if (tr.enabled === undefined) tr.enabled = true;
  var defEnd = tr.end || '2027-07-01';
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>期限设置</h3><p class="mut">机构使用期限管理：总开关控制全局 / 分级是否启用期限，各机构可单独设置启用状态与截止日期。</p>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:8px">默认期限：<b>' + esc(defEnd) + '</b> <button class="btn gray" onclick="setDefaultTrial()">修改默认期限</button> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="resetAllTrial()">全部恢复默认</button> <button class="btn gray" onclick="setAllTrial()">统一设置期限</button></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>全省总开关</h3>'
    + '<label style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px"><input type="checkbox" id="trialAllSwitch" ' + (tr.enabled!==false?'checked':'') + ' onchange="toggleAllTrial(this.checked)"> <b>' + (tr.enabled!==false?'全省期限启用中':'全省期限已停用') + '</b></label>'
    + '<p class="mut">关闭后全省所有机构不受使用期限限制；开启后按各级开关与各机构期限生效。</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>分级总开关</h3><div id="trialLevels"></div><p class="mut">省级机关与各地市局整体开关，关闭则其下属都不限期限。</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>县域局 / 科室开关与期限</h3>'
    + '<div style="margin-bottom:6px">选择地市局：<select id="trialBureauSel" onchange="renderTrialBureauDetail()"></select> '
    + '<span class="mut">查看并设置该市下各县域局、市局科室的开关与期限</span></div>'
    + '<div id="trialBureauDetail"></div></div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
  renderTrialLevels();
  fillTrialBureauSel();
  renderTrialBureauDetail();
}
function collectSubIds(pid){ var ids=[]; childrenOf(pid).forEach(function(o){ ids.push(o.id); ids=ids.concat(collectSubIds(o.id)); }); return ids; }
function renderTrialLevels(){
  var el=$('trialLevels'); if(!el) return;
  var tr=sys.trial;
  var vis=visibleOrgs(currentUser());
  var provOrgs=vis.filter(function(o){return o.type==='dept'&&o.pid===0;});
  var provOn = provOrgs.length && provOrgs.every(function(o){return tr.orgEnabled[o.id]!==false;});
  var h='';
  if(provOrgs.length) h+='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:5px 0"><b>省级机关（省局科室）</b> <input type="checkbox" '+(provOn?'checked':'')+' onchange="toggleLevelTrial(\'prov\',this.checked)"> <span class="mut">'+provOrgs.length+'个科室</span></div>';
  var bureaus=vis.filter(function(o){return o.type==='bureau';});
  bureaus.forEach(function(o){
    var subs=collectSubIds(o.id);
    var on = subs.length && subs.every(function(id){return tr.orgEnabled[id]!==false;});
    h+='<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin:5px 0"><b>'+esc(o.name)+'</b> <input type="checkbox" '+(on?'checked':'')+' onchange="toggleBureauTrial('+o.id+',this.checked)"> <span class="mut">'+subs.length+'个下属</span></div>';
  });
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function fillTrialBureauSel(){
  var s=$('trialBureauSel'); if(!s) return;
  var bureaus=visibleOrgs(currentUser()).filter(function(o){return o.type==='bureau';});
  s.innerHTML='<option value="0">全部县域局 / 科室</option>' + bureaus.map(function(o){return '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>';}).join('');
}
function renderTrialBureauDetail(){
  var el=$('trialBureauDetail'); if(!el) return;
  var sel=$('trialBureauSel'); var bid=+(sel?sel.value:0);
  var ids=[];
  if(bid){ ids=collectSubIds(bid); }
  else { ids=visibleOrgs(currentUser()).filter(function(o){return o.type==='county'||o.type==='dept';}).map(function(o){return o.id;}); }
  var h='<table style="table-layout:fixed;width:100%"><colgroup><col style="width:38%"><col style="width:16%"><col style="width:20%"><col style="width:26%"></colgroup>'
    +'<tr><th>机构</th><th>启用期限</th><th>有效至</th><th>操作</th></tr>';
  ids.forEach(function(id){
    var o=orgById(id); if(!o) return;
    var on=sys.trial.orgEnabled[id]!==false;
    var isOver=sys.trial.overrides && sys.trial.overrides[id];
    h+='<tr><td>'+esc(o.name)+' <span style="color:var(--t3);font-size:11px">'+({county:'县局',dept:'科室'}[o.type]||'')+'</span></td>'
      +'<td><input type="checkbox" '+(on?'checked':'')+' onchange="toggleOrgTrial('+id+',this.checked)"></td>'
      +'<td>'+esc(trialEffectiveEnd(id))+'</td>'
      +'<td><button class="btn gray" onclick="setOrgTrial2('+id+')">设置期限</button> '+(isOver?'<button class="btn del" onclick="clearOrgTrial2('+id+')">恢复默认</button>':'')+'</td></tr>';
  });
  el.innerHTML=ids.length ? h : '<div class="mut">暂无下属机构</div>';
}
function toggleAllTrial(on){
  sys.trial.enabled=on;
  saveSys(); renderTrialPage(); recordAudit('期限设置','全省期限总开关：'+(on?'启用':'停用'),'admin'); toast(on?'全省期限已启用':'全省期限已停用');
}
function toggleLevelTrial(lvl,on){
  if(lvl==='prov') sys.orgs.filter(function(o){return o.type==='dept'&&o.pid===0;}).forEach(function(o){sys.trial.orgEnabled[o.id]=on;});
  saveSys(); renderTrialPage(); recordAudit('期限设置','省级机关期限总开关：'+(on?'启用':'停用'),'admin'); toast(on?'省级机关期限已启用':'省级机关期限已停用');
}
function toggleBureauTrial(bid,on){
  collectSubIds(bid).forEach(function(id){sys.trial.orgEnabled[id]=on;});
  saveSys(); renderTrialPage(); recordAudit('期限设置','地市局('+(orgById(bid)?orgById(bid).name:'')+')期限总开关：'+(on?'启用':'停用'),'admin'); toast(on?'该市局下属期限已启用':'该市局下属期限已停用');
}
function toggleOrgTrial(oid,on){
  sys.trial.orgEnabled[oid]=on;
  saveSys(); renderTrialBureauDetail(); recordAudit('期限设置','机构('+(orgById(oid)?orgById(oid).name:'')+')期限'+(on?'启用':'停用'),'admin'); toast(on?'已启用该机构期限':'已停用该机构期限');
}
function clearOrgTrial2(orgId){
  if(!sys.trial||!sys.trial.overrides) return;
  delete sys.trial.overrides[orgId];
  saveSys(); renderTrialBureauDetail(); toast('已恢复默认期限');
}

function resetAllTrial(){
  if (!confirm('确认全部机构恢复默认期限？')) return;
  if (!sys.trial) sys.trial = { end: '2027-07-01', overrides: {} };
  sys.trial.overrides = {};
  saveSys(); renderTrialPage(); recordAudit('期限设置','全部机构恢复默认期限','admin'); toast('已恢复全部机构默认期限');
}
function setAllTrial(){
  if (!sys.trial) sys.trial = { end: '2027-07-01', overrides: {} };
  pickDate('', function(v){
    if (!v || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) { alert('请选择日期'); return; }
    var ids=[]; (function walk(pid){ childrenOf(pid).forEach(function(o){ ids.push(o.id); walk(o.id); }); })(0);
    ids.forEach(function(id){ sys.trial.overrides[id]=v; });
    saveSys(); renderTrialPage(); recordAudit('期限设置','统一设置全部机构期限至 '+v,'admin'); toast('已统一设置 '+ids.length+' 个机构期限至 '+v);
  });
}

function setOrgTrial2(orgId) {
  var cur = trialEffectiveEnd(orgId);
  pickDate(cur, function(v){
    if (!v || !/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(v)) { alert('请选择日期'); return; }
    if (!sys.trial) sys.trial = { end: '2027-07-01', overrides: {} };
    sys.trial.overrides[orgId] = v;
    saveSys();
    renderTrialPage();
    recordAudit('期限设置', '设置 ' + (orgById(orgId)?orgById(orgId).name:'') + ' 试用期至 ' + v, 'admin');
    toast('已设置 ' + (orgById(orgId)?orgById(orgId).name:'') + ' 期限至 ' + v);
  });
}
function clearOrgTrial2(orgId) {
  if (!sys.trial || !sys.trial.overrides) return;
  delete sys.trial.overrides[orgId];
  saveSys();
  renderTrialPage();
  recordAudit('期限设置', '恢复 ' + orgById(orgId).name + ' 默认试用期', 'admin');
  toast('已恢复默认期限');
}
/* =====================================================================
 * 省份管理（超管）
 * ===================================================================== */
function renderProvinceManage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!isSuper(u)) { alert('仅超管可管理省份'); return; }
  showPage('provinceManagePage');  setTopTitle('省份管理');
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>省份管理</h3><p class="mut">新增省份后即可为该省指定总管理员（省管）——输入姓名将直接创建该省管理员账号（默认密码 123456），无需该省先设立机构或有人注册。管理员登录后即可组建机构、录入人员。</p>';
  h += '<div class="row"><label>新省份</label><input id="newProvName" placeholder="如：湖北"></div>'
     + '<button class="btn" onclick="doAddProvince()">添加省份</button></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>现有省份</h3><div id="provList"></div></div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  $('provinceManageBody').innerHTML = h;
  var pl = $('provList');
  pl.innerHTML = '';
  sys.provinces.forEach(function(p){
    var adm = sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.province===p.id && x.role==='provinceAdmin'; })[0];
    pl.innerHTML += '<div style="background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;">'
      + '<b>' + esc(p.name) + '</b>　省管：' + (adm ? esc(displayName(adm)) : '未设置')
      + ' ' + (adm ? '' : '<button class="btn" style="margin-top:6px" onclick="setProvAdmin('+p.id+')">指定省管</button>')
      + ' <button class="btn del" onclick="delProvince('+p.id+')">删除</button></div>';
  });
}function doAddProvince() {
  var name = $('newProvName').value.trim();
  if (!name) { alert('请填写省份名'); return; }
  if (sys.provinces.some(function(p){ return p.name===name; })) { alert('省份已存在'); return; }
  sys.provinces.push({ id: sys.seq++, name: name, adminId: 0 });
  saveSys();
  renderProvinceManage();
  recordAudit('省份管理', '添加省份：' + name, 'admin');
  toast('已添加省份：' + name);
}
function setProvAdmin(pid) {
  var name = prompt('输入该省省级总管理员姓名（将直接创建账号，默认密码 123456）：', provinceById(pid).name);
  if (!name) return;
  var adm = sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.province===pid && x.role==='provinceAdmin'; })[0];
  if (adm) { adm.name = name; }
  else { sys.users.push({ id: sys.seq++, orgId: 0, name: name, role: 'provinceAdmin', title: '省管', dept: '', pwd: '123456', status: 'active', fromOrgId: 0, province: pid }); }
  saveSys();
  renderProvinceManage();
  recordAudit('省份管理', '设置 ' + provinceById(pid).name + ' 省管：' + name, 'admin');
  toast('省管已设置：' + name);
}
function delProvince(pid) {
  if (!confirm('删除省份及其全部机构/账号？')) return;
  sys.orgs = sys.orgs.filter(function(o){ return o.province !== pid; });
  sys.users = sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.province !== pid; });
  sys.provinces = sys.provinces.filter(function(p){ return p.id !== pid; });
  saveSys();
  renderProvinceManage();
  recordAudit('省份管理', '删除省份：' + provinceById(pid).name, 'admin');
  toast('已删除省份');
}

/* 修复办公"单位工作日志"：vALog 引用了未定义的 REC_TYPES/LEDGER_TYPES，包装 vALog 在调用前计算全局版本 */
var ALOG_PATCH = "<script>(function(){var o=window.vALog;window.vALog=function(){var ALL_REC=['\u5c40\u52a1\u4f1a','\u515a\u7ec4\u4f1a','\u5168\u7ad9\u5927\u4f1a','\u4e1a\u52a1\u6280\u672f\u8ba8\u8bba','\u653f\u6cbb\u5b66\u4e60','\u4e1a\u52a1\u5b66\u4e60','\u515a\u98ce\u5ec9\u653f\u5b66\u4e60','\u4e09\u4f1a\u4e00\u8bfe','\u4e3b\u9898\u515a\u65e5','\u7ec4\u7ec7\u751f\u6d3b\u4f1a','\u9632\u6c5b\u503c\u73ed','\u5e94\u6025\u6f14\u7ec3','\u6c34\u60c5\u65e5\u62a5','\u6d4b\u6d41\u53d6\u6c99','\u8d44\u6599\u6574\u7f16','\u6545\u969c\u62a5\u4fee','\u4fe1\u8bbf\u63a5\u5f85','\u9886\u5bfc\u89c6\u5bdf','\u4eba\u5458\u53d8\u52a8'];var ALL_LEDGER=['\u5b89\u5168\u751f\u4ea7\u68c0\u67e5','\u6c5b\u524d\u68c0\u67e5','\u6c5b\u4e2d\u68c0\u67e5','\u6c5b\u540e\u68c0\u67e5','\u8bbe\u5907\u5de1\u68c0','\u6536\u53d1\u6587\u767b\u8bb0','\u7528\u5370\u767b\u8bb0','\u8f66\u8f86\u4f7f\u7528','\u7269\u8d44\u51fa\u5165\u5e93','\u5e72\u90e8\u57f9\u8bad'];db.recOn=db.recOn||{};ALL_REC.forEach(function(t){if(db.recOn[t]===undefined)db.recOn[t]=1});ALL_LEDGER.forEach(function(t){if(db.recOn[t]===undefined)db.recOn[t]=1});window.REC_TYPES=ALL_REC.filter(function(t){return db.recOn[t]});window.LEDGER_TYPES=ALL_LEDGER.filter(function(t){return db.recOn[t]});if(o)return o.apply(this,arguments);};})();</scr" + "ipt>";
/* 通用回车确认：输入框回车跳下一个输入框；无下一个则触发容器内确认按钮 */
var ENTER_PATCH = "<scr"+"ipt>(function(){try{function navEnter(){document.addEventListener('keydown',function(e){if(e.key!=='Enter')return;var t=e.target;if(!t)return;var tag=(t.tagName||'').toUpperCase();var isText=tag==='INPUT'&&['text','number','password','date','time','search','tel','url','email'].indexOf((t.type||'text').toLowerCase())>=0;if(!isText)return;var box=t.closest('.page,.panel,.card,.modal,.box,form')||document.body;var vis=[];try{box.querySelectorAll('input,select,textarea').forEach(function(i){if(i.offsetParent!==null&&!i.disabled)vis.push(i);});}catch(err){}var idx=vis.indexOf(t);if(idx>=0&&idx<vis.length-1){e.preventDefault();vis[idx+1].focus();return;}var btn=null;try{var sel=box.querySelectorAll('button');for(var k=0;k<sel.length;k++){var b=sel[k];if(b.offsetParent===null||b.disabled)continue;var tx=(b.textContent||'').trim();if(/保存|确定|提交|确认|下一步|开始|计算|添加|登录|生成|查询/.test(tx)){btn=b;break;}}}catch(err){}if(btn){e.preventDefault();btn.click();}});}if(document.readyState==='loading')document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded',navEnter);else navEnter();}catch(e){}})();</scr"+"ipt>";

/* ---- 内核 iframe 加载（按机构注入） ---- */
function bizUserPatch(){
  var _bu = currentUser(), _bm = _bu ? effMgr(_bu) : null, _bv = (_bm && isManage(_bu) && linkedUserOf(_bu)) ? linkedUserOf(_bu) : _bu;
  var _bo = orgById(viewOrgId());
  var _bAdmin = !!(_bm && (isSuper(_bm)||isOrgAdmin(_bm,_bm.orgId)||_bm.role==='provinceAdmin'||_bm.role==='countyAdmin'||_bm.role==='bureauAdmin'));
  return '<scr'+'ipt>window._yltUser=' + JSON.stringify({name:_bv?_bv.name:'',orgName:_bo?_bo.name:'',isAdmin:_bAdmin}) + ';</scr'+'ipt>';
}
function buildHydroSrcdoc() {
  var u = currentUser();
  var v = u;
  var mgr = effMgr(u);
  if (u && isManage(u)) { var _lk = linkedUserOf(u); if (_lk) v = _lk; } /* 管理员与关联号是同一人：日常数据用关联号 */
  var o = orgById(viewOrgId());
  var html = HYDRO_HTML;
  html = html.replace("const K='hydro_mvp_v19'", "const K='" + hydroKey(o) + "'");
  html = html.replace(/浏阳市水文局/g, esc(orgNameOf(u)));
  var _it=(window.__hydroInitTab||''); if(_it){ html = html.replace('<script>', '<script>window.__initTab=' + JSON.stringify(_it) + ';</scr'+'ipt><script>'); }
  var meName = JSON.stringify(v ? v.name : '');
  var __roleKey = mgr ? mgr.role : (v ? v.role : '');
  // 跳过登录（恒 false 走 else render），并在 render 前按当前用户注入 db.me
  html = html.replace(/if\(!sessionStorage\.getItem\('hydro_login'\)\)/g, "if(false)");
  var __roleStr = (mgr && (isSuper(mgr)||isOrgAdmin(mgr,mgr.orgId)||mgr.role==='provinceAdmin'||mgr.role==='countyAdmin'||mgr.role==='bureauAdmin')) ? roleName(mgr.role) : (v ? (v.role||'职工') : '职工');
  var __adminB = !!(mgr && (isSuper(mgr)||isOrgAdmin(mgr,mgr.orgId)||mgr.role==='provinceAdmin'||mgr.role==='countyAdmin'||mgr.role==='bureauAdmin'));
  var __linkedJson = JSON.stringify((function(){ var _lu = v ? v.id : (u ? u.id : 0); return linkedAdminsOf(_lu).map(function(la){ return {id:la.id, name:la.name, role:la.role}; }); })());
var meCode = "window.__linkedAdmins=" + __linkedJson + ";window.__openAdmin=function(p){try{window.parent.postMessage({type:'openAdminPage',page:p},'*')}catch(e){}};var __roleKey=\'" + __roleKey + "\';\n(function(){var __u=" + meName + ";var __role='" + __roleKey + "';var __admin=" + __adminB + ";var __p=db.people.filter(function(p){return p.name===__u;})[0];if(__p){db.me=__p.id;__p.role=__role;__p.admin=__admin;}else{var __np={id:(db.seq++),name:__u||'用户',role:__role,type:'正式',post:'综合',admin:__admin,duties:[]};db.people.push(__np);db.me=__np.id;save();}})();\n";
  html = html.replace(/function render\(\)\{\n    if\(false\)/, '\n' + meCode + '\nfunction render(){\n    if(false)');
  html = html.replace(/<script>/i, '<script>try{window.__openAdmin=function(p){window.parent.postMessage({type:\'openAdminPage\',page:p},\'*\')}}catch(e){}</scr'+'ipt><script>');
  html = html.replace(/<\/style>/i, DARK_OVERRIDE + '</style>');
  html = html.replace(/<html/i, '<html data-theme="' + (currentTheme() ? 'dark' : 'light') + '"');
  var _bi = html.lastIndexOf('</bo'+'dy>'); if (_bi >= 0) { html = html.slice(0, _bi) + ALOG_PATCH + THEME_SCRIPT + ENTER_PATCH + html.slice(_bi); }
  return html;
}
function buildMeasureSrcdoc(station) {
  var o = orgById(viewOrgId());
  var search = '?bureau=' + encodeURIComponent(o ? o.name : '') + (station ? '&station=' + encodeURIComponent(station) : '');
  var searchLit = JSON.stringify(search);
  var html = MEASURE_HTML.replace(
    "location.search.match(/station=([^&]+)/)",
    searchLit + ".match(/station=([^&]+)/)"
  );
  html = html.replace(
    "new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('bureau')",
    "({bureau:" + JSON.stringify(o ? o.name : '') + "}).bureau"
  );
  html = html.replace(/<html/i, '<html data-theme="' + (currentTheme() ? 'dark' : 'light') + '"');
  var _bi = html.lastIndexOf('</bo'+'dy>'); if (_bi >= 0) { html = html.slice(0, _bi) + bizUserPatch() + ALOG_PATCH + THEME_SCRIPT + ENTER_PATCH + html.slice(_bi); }
  return html;
}
function syncBizBridge() {
  try {
    if (!window.Cache || typeof window.Cache !== 'object' || !window.Cache.data) {
      window.Cache = { data: { stations: [], users: [], records: [], feedback: [], settings: {}, natBM: [] } };
    }
    window.Cache.data.stations = ((typeof FULL_STATIONS!=='undefined'&&FULL_STATIONS)? FULL_STATIONS.filter(function(s){var c=String(s.category||'').trim();return c!=='山洪站'&&c!=='国家水准点'&&c!=='管理机构';}).slice() : []);
    var o = orgById(viewOrgId());
    var org = o ? o.name : '';
    if (!org) return;
    var k = 'hsDB_' + org;
    var db;
    try { db = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k) || '{}'); } catch(e){ db = {}; }
    if (!db.stations) db.stations = [];
    try {
      var yd = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('ylt_data_' + org) || '{}');
      if (yd && Array.isArray(yd.stations)) {
        var cats = ['基本站','中小河水文站','中小河水位站','防汛专用站','大江大河站'];
        db.stations = yd.stations.filter(function(s){ return cats.indexOf(String(s.category||'').trim())>=0; });
      }
    } catch(e){}
    localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(db));
    window._bureau = org;
    if (!window.Cache || typeof window.Cache !== 'object' || !window.Cache.data) {
      window.Cache = { data: { stations: [], users: [], records: [], feedback: [], settings: {}, natBM: [] } };
    }
    
window.Cache.data.stations = ((typeof FULL_STATIONS!=='undefined'&&FULL_STATIONS)? FULL_STATIONS.filter(function(s){var c=String(s.category||'').trim();return c!=='山洪站'&&c!=='国家水准点'&&c!=='管理机构';}).slice() : (db.stations||[]).slice());
    if (!window.Cache.saveRecord) window.Cache.saveRecord = function(rec) { try { var d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k) || '{}'); d.records = d.records || []; d.records.push(rec); localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(d)); } catch(e){} };
    if (!window.App || typeof window.App !== 'object') window.App = {};
    if (!('curStationId' in window.App)) window.App.curStationId = '';
    if (!('curStation' in window.App)) window.App.curStation = '未选择';
    if (!window.App._syncRecordToYlt) window.App._syncRecordToYlt = function(rec) { window.Cache.saveRecord(rec); };
    try { var _cs = localStorage.getItem('hs_curStation'); if (_cs && window.syncStationSection) window.syncStationSection(_cs); } catch(e){}
    try { if(window.HS_TRANSFER_PLANS) Object.keys(window.HS_TRANSFER_PLANS).forEach(function(n){ try{ window.ensureTransferSeed(n); window.ensureLayoutSeed(n); }catch(e){} }); } catch(e){}
  } catch(e){}
}
function buildYbtSrcdoc(hashStr) {
  var o = orgById(viewOrgId());
  var html = YBT_HTML.replace(
    "location.hash.replace(/^#/,'')",
    JSON.stringify(hashStr || 'home') + ".replace(/^#/,'')"
  );
  html = html.replace(
    "new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('bureau')",
    "({bureau:" + JSON.stringify(o ? o.name : '') + "}).bureau"
  );
  html = html.replace(/<\/style>/i, DARK_OVERRIDE + '</style>');
  html = html.replace(/<html/i, '<html data-theme="' + (currentTheme() ? 'dark' : 'light') + '"');
  var _bi = html.lastIndexOf('</bo'+'dy>'); if (_bi >= 0) { html = html.slice(0, _bi) + bizUserPatch() + ALOG_PATCH + THEME_SCRIPT + ENTER_PATCH + html.slice(_bi); }
  return html;
}

/* ---- 进入主界面 ---- */
var VIEWORG_KEY = 'hydro_view_org';
function viewOrgId() {
  var u = currentUser();
  if (u && isSuper(u)) {
    var v = +sessionStorage.getItem(VIEWORG_KEY);
    if (v) { var oo = orgById(v); if (oo) return v; }
  }
  return u ? u.orgId : 0;
}
function purgeAdminFromDaily(){
  try{
    if (localStorage.getItem('hydro_purge_admin_daily')) return;
    var adminNames = {};
    (sys.users||[]).forEach(function(x){ if(isManage(x)) adminNames[x.name]=1; });
    var orgIds = {};
    (sys.orgs||[]).forEach(function(o){ orgIds[o.id]=1; });
    orgIds[0] = 1; // 省局本体库（orgs 中无独立记录）
    for (var id in orgIds) {
      var k='hydro_v19_'+id;
      var d=null; try{ d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(k)); }catch(e){}
      if(d && Array.isArray(d.people)){
        var b=d.people.length;
        d.people=d.people.filter(function(p){ return !adminNames[p.name]; });
        if(d.people.length!==b) localStorage.setItem(k, JSON.stringify(d));
      }
    }
    localStorage.setItem('hydro_purge_admin_daily','1');
  }catch(e){}
}
function enterMain() {
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u) { renderLoginPage(); return; }
  try{ purgeAdminFromDaily(); }catch(e){}
  if (trialExpired(viewOrgId()) && !isSuper(u)) { clearSession(); renderLoginPage(); return; }
  if (isSuper(u) && !sessionStorage.getItem(VIEWORG_KEY)) { renderSuperManage(); return; }
  if (u.role==='provinceAdmin' || u.role==='bureauAdmin') { renderAdminHome(); return; }
  // 县级管理员登录后直接进入管理页面（不参与日常/排班分工，无个人日常首页）
  if (u.role==='countyAdmin' && !isSuper(u)) { renderCountyManagePage(); return; }
  // 普通职工：进入办公；若被指定为关联账号，顶部登录名旁增加「进入管理账号」入口
  showPage('mainApp');
  var _las = linkedAdminsOf(u.id);
  if (_las.length) {
    var _lb = _las.map(function(la){ return '<button onclick="enterLinkedAdmin('+la.id+')" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;margin-left:6px">'+linkedEntryLabel(la)+'</button>'; }).join('');
    var _mu0=$('mainUserName'); if(_mu0) _mu0.innerHTML = '<span>'+esc(u.name)+'</span>' + _lb;
  } else {
    var _mu0=$('mainUserName'); if(_mu0) _mu0.textContent = u.name;   // 只显示名字，不显示身份
  }
  try{ showNotices(u); }catch(e){}
  var sv = $('superViewBar');
  if (sv) sv.style.display = (isSuper(u) && sessionStorage.getItem(VIEWORG_KEY)) ? 'block' : 'none';
  openHomeTab();
  try{ applyFont(); }catch(e){}
  // 取消强制改密提示：所有用户默认密码直接登录，不弹框
  var fp = $('forcePwdPage'); if (fp) fp.style.display = 'none';
}
function noticeMatches(u){
  var list=sys.notices||[]; if(!list.length) return [];
  var oid=u.orgId, o=orgById(oid);
  return list.filter(function(n){
    if(!n.scope||n.scope==='0') return true;
    if(n.scope==='prov') return !!(o && o.type==='dept' && o.pid===0);
    if(!o) return false;
    var sid=+n.scope;
    if(oid===sid) return true;
    if(o.pid===sid) return true;
    var po=orgById(o.pid); if(po && po.pid===sid) return true;
    return false;
  });
}
function showNotices(u){
  var list=noticeMatches(u); if(!list.length) return;
  if(sessionStorage.getItem('noticeShown')) return;
  sessionStorage.setItem('noticeShown','1');
  var h='<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px">系统公告（'+list.length+'）</div>'
    + list.slice(0,10).map(function(n){ return '<div style="background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:8px"><b>'+esc(n.title)+'</b> <span class="mut">'+esc(n.time)+'</span><div style="font-size:13px;margin-top:4px;color:#333">'+esc(n.body)+'</div></div>'; }).join('');
  modal(h);
}

function shortOrg(name){ var n=String(name||''); if(n.slice(-1)==='\u5c40'||n.slice(-1)==='\u5e02') return n.slice(0,-1); return n; }
function orgNameOf(u) {
  if (isSuper(u)) {
    var vo = orgById(viewOrgId());
    if (vo) { var vc=vo,g2=0; while(vc && vc.type==='dept' && g2<10){ vc=orgById(vc.pid); g2++; } if (vc) return shortOrg(vc.name); var pr3 = vo.province ? provinceById(vo.province) : null; return pr3 ? shortOrg(pr3.name) : shortOrg(vo.name); }
    return '系统';
  }
  var o = orgById(u ? u.orgId : 0);
  if (o) { var c=o,g=0; while(c && c.type==='dept' && g<10){ c=orgById(c.pid); g++; } if (c) return shortOrg(c.name); var pr2 = o.province ? provinceById(o.province) : null; return pr2 ? shortOrg(pr2.name) : shortOrg(o.name); }
  if (u && u.role === 'provinceAdmin') { var p = provinceById(u.province); return p ? shortOrg(p.name) : '省'; }
  return '?';
}


function setTab(id) {
  ['tabHome','tabBiz','tabMine'].forEach(function(t){ var e=$(t); if(e) e.classList.remove('on'); });
  var e=$(id); if(e) e.classList.add('on');
}
function setPane(id) {
  ['paneHome','paneBiz','paneMine','paneYbt','paneMeasure','paneMap'].forEach(function(p){
    var el=$(p); if(el) el.classList.remove('on');
  });
  var el=$(id); if(el) el.classList.add('on');
}
function nav(title, backTarget) {
  var _pt=$('topPageTitle'); if(_pt) _pt.textContent=title||'';
  nav._back = backTarget;
}
function topNav(k){ try{ if(k==='home'){ openHomeTab(); } else { openBizTab(); } }catch(e){} }
function goBack() {
  if (_curPane==='measure') { var f=document.getElementById('measureFrame'); var cur=(f&&f.contentWindow&&f.contentWindow.Router)?f.contentWindow.Router.current:'home'; if(cur!=='home'&&f){ try{ f.contentWindow.Router.home(); }catch(e){} return; } openBizTab(); return; }
  if (_curPane==='ybt') { openBizTab(); return; }
  else { var t=nav._back; if(t){ t(); return; } try{ var _ops=['orgPage','authPage','provinceManagePage']; for(var i=0;i<_ops.length;i++){ var _pg=document.getElementById(_ops[i]); if(_pg&&_pg.style.display!=='none'){ goManageHome(); return; } } }catch(e){} }
}

/* ---- 功能使用统计 + 管理员看登录/统计 ---- */
var USE_KEY='hydro_usage';
function usageAll(){ try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(USE_KEY))||{}; }catch(e){ return {}; } }
function recordUse(orgId,cat,name){ try{ var u=usageAll(); u[orgId]=u[orgId]||{}; u[orgId][cat]=u[orgId][cat]||{}; u[orgId][cat][name]=(u[orgId][cat][name]||0)+1; localStorage.setItem(USE_KEY,JSON.stringify(u)); }catch(e){} }
function descOrgIds(oid){
  var ids=[oid];
  childrenOf(oid).forEach(function(c){ ids=ids.concat(descOrgIds(c.id)); });
  return ids;
}
function visibleLogIds(u){
  if (isSuper(u) || u.role==='provinceAdmin') return null;
  if (u.role==='bureauAdmin' || u.role==='countyAdmin') return descOrgIds(u.orgId);
  return null;
}
function renderUsagePage(){
  adminView='sub';
  var u=currentUser();
  if (!(isSuper(u)||isOrgAdmin(u,u.orgId)||u.role==='provinceAdmin')){ alert('仅各级机构管理员可查看功能使用统计'); return; }
    if (!canPerm((typeof u!=='undefined'?u.role:''), '功能使用统计')) { alert('该功能已被管理员关闭，当前角色无权使用'); return; }  showPage('orgPage');  setTopTitle('功能使用统计');
  var usage=usageAll();
  var vis=visibleLogIds(u);
  var rows=[];
  Object.keys(usage).forEach(function(oid){
    if(vis && vis.indexOf(+oid)<0) return;
    var o=orgById(+oid);
    var oName=o?o.name:('org'+oid);
    var m=usage[oid];
    ['页面','业务功能','测量','地图'].forEach(function(cat){
      if(!m[cat]) return;
      Object.keys(m[cat]).forEach(function(n){ rows.push({org:oName,cat:cat,name:n,c:m[cat][n]}); });
    });
  });
  var body=$('orgPageBody');
  var total=0; rows.forEach(function(r){ total+=r.c; });
  var scopeTxt = vis ? '本机构及下级机构' : '全省（含超管）';
  var byOrg={}, byCat={};
  rows.forEach(function(r){ byOrg[r.org]=(byOrg[r.org]||0)+r.c; byCat[r.cat]=(byCat[r.cat]||0)+r.c; });
  var f = window.USAGE_FILTER || null;
  var flist = rows;
  if(f){ flist = rows.filter(function(r){ if(f.org && r.org!==f.org) return false; if(f.cat && r.cat!==f.cat) return false; return true; }); }
  var orgS = Object.keys(byOrg).map(function(k){return {k:k,v:byOrg[k]};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.v-a.v;});
  var catS = Object.keys(byCat).map(function(k){return {k:k,v:byCat[k]};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.v-a.v;});
  var chip = function(label,obj){
    return '<span onclick="setUsageFilter(' + JSON.stringify(obj).replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + ')" style="cursor:pointer;background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:12px;padding:3px 10px;margin:2px 4px 2px 0;display:inline-block;">' + label + '</span>';
  };
  var h='<div class="card"><h3>功能使用统计</h3><p class="mut">累计使用 <b>'+total+'</b> 次　统计范围：'+scopeTxt+'<br>点击下方部门或类别，可只看对应使用明细；点「全部」恢复。</p></div>';
  h+='<div class="card"><h3>分项统计（点击查看）</h3>';
  h+='<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:2px"><b>按部门：</b>' + (orgS.length?orgS.map(function(x){return chip(esc(x.k)+'（'+x.v+'次）', {org:x.k});}).join(''):'暂无') + '</div>';
  h+='<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:8px"><b>按功能类别：</b>' + (catS.length?catS.map(function(x){return chip(esc(x.k)+'（'+x.v+'次）', {cat:x.k});}).join(''):'暂无') + '</div>';
  h+='<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn gray" onclick="setUsageFilter(null)">全部明细（'+total+'次）</button></div>';
  h+='</div>';
  h+='<div class="card"><h3>使用明细' + (f?('（筛选：'+((f.org||'')+(f.cat||''))+'）'):'（按次数排序）') + '</h3>';
  var sorted = flist.slice().sort(function(a,b){ return b.c-a.c; });
  if(!sorted.length) h+='<div class="empty">暂无使用记录</div>';
  sorted.forEach(function(r){ h+='<div style="background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px;">'+esc(r.org)+' · <b>'+esc(r.name)+'</b>（'+esc(r.cat)+'）×'+r.c+'</div>'; });
  h=bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel())+h;
  body.innerHTML=h;
}function setUsageFilter(f){ window.USAGE_FILTER = f; renderUsagePage(); }

/* ---- 办公（首页） ---- */
function renderDaily(){ try{ showPage('mainApp'); openHomeTab(); }catch(e){} }
function openHomeTab() {
  recordUse(viewOrgId(),'页面','办公');
  var u = currentUser();
  setTab('tabHome');
  nav('办公', null); try{ var _ao=$('appOrgTitle'); if(_ao) _ao.textContent=appNameOf(u); }catch(e){}   // 品牌名：机构名 + 一表通
  _curPane = 'hydro';
  setPane('paneHome');
  var _cu = currentUser();
  if (_cu) {
    var _las2 = linkedAdminsOf(_cu.id);
    var _mu2 = $('mainUserName');
    if (_mu2) {
      if (_las2.length) { var _lb2 = _las2.map(function(la){ return '<button onclick="enterLinkedAdmin('+la.id+')" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 9px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;margin-left:6px">'+linkedEntryLabel(la)+'</button>'; }).join(''); _mu2.innerHTML = '<span>'+esc(_cu.name)+'</span>' + _lb2; }
      else _mu2.textContent = _cu.name;
    }
  }
  var hf = $('hydroFrame');
  if (!hf) {
    var _ph = document.getElementById('paneHome');
    if (_ph) { var _i = document.createElement('iframe'); _i.id='hydroFrame'; _ph.innerHTML=''; _ph.appendChild(_i); hf=_i; }
  }
  if (hf) hf.srcdoc = buildHydroSrcdoc();
  var _ur = currentUser();
  var _rb='staff';
  if(_ur){ var _em=effMgr(_ur); if(_em) _rb=_em.role; }
  setTimeout(function(){
    var _f = document.getElementById('hydroFrame');
    if (_f && _f.contentWindow) { try{ _f.contentWindow.postMessage({type:'setRole', role:_rb}, '*'); }catch(e){} }
  }, 800);
}

/* ---- 业务 ---- */
function openBizTab() {
  recordUse(viewOrgId(),'页面','业务');
  var u = currentUser();
  setTab('tabBiz');
  // 从管理进入时，业务页需能返回管理
  var fromMgmt = (adminView==='county'||adminView==='admin'||adminView==='super');
  nav('业务', fromMgmt ? renderCountyManagePage : null);
  _curPane = 'biz';
  setPane('paneBiz');
  renderBizGrid(u);
  try{ var _bb=$('bizBrand'); if(_bb) _bb.textContent=appNameOf(u); refreshBizStationBtn(); var _br=$('bizRight'); if(_br){ var _mgr=u?effMgr(u):null, _adm=!!(_mgr&&(isSuper(_mgr)||isOrgAdmin(_mgr,_mgr.orgId)||_mgr.role==='provinceAdmin'||_mgr.role==='countyAdmin'||_mgr.role==='bureauAdmin')); _br.innerHTML=u?((_adm?'<button onclick="goManageHome()" class="g-tag">管理</button>':'')+'<span>'+esc(u.name)+'</span><a onclick="doLogout()" style="color:#fff;cursor:pointer;text-decoration:underline;margin-left:4px">退出</a>'):''; } var _lg=document.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]'); var _sr=_lg?(_lg.getAttribute('href')||''):''; var _bl=$('bizTopbar'); if(_bl){ var _im=_bl.querySelector('img'); if(_im&&_sr) _im.setAttribute('src',_sr); } }catch(e){}
}
function bizList(u) {
  return funcTypesOf(u) === 'all' ? BIZ_ALL : BIZ_DEPT;
}
function refreshBizStationBtn(){
  try{
    var _b=$('bizStationBtn'); if(!_b) return;
    var _nm='';
    ['ybtFrame','measureFrame','hydroFrame'].forEach(function(_fid){ if(!_nm){ var _f=document.getElementById(_fid); if(_f && _f.contentWindow && _f.contentWindow.App){ var _st=((window.Cache&&Cache.data&&Cache.data.stations)||[]).find(function(s){ return String(s.id)===String(_f.contentWindow.App.curStationId); }); if(_st) _nm=_st.name; } } });
    if(!_nm){ try{ _nm=localStorage.getItem('hs_curStation')||''; }catch(e){} }
    _b.innerHTML = '📍 ' + (_nm || '选站');
  }catch(e){}
}
function bizPickStation(){
  try{
    try{ if(typeof syncBizBridge==='function') syncBizBridge(); }catch(e){}
    var _src=null;
    ['ybtFrame','measureFrame','hydroFrame'].forEach(function(_fid){ if(!_src){ var _f=document.getElementById(_fid); if(_f && _f.contentWindow && getComputedStyle(_f).display!=='none') _src=_f.contentWindow; } });
    openStationPicker(_src);
  }catch(e){}
}
function renderBizGrid(u) {
  var grid = $('bizGrid');
  var items = bizList(u);
  var g = '';
  items.forEach(function(it){
    g += '<div class="biz-item" title="'+(BIZ_DESC[it[0]]||'')+'" onclick="openBizApp(\''+it[0]+'\')"><div class="bi-ic">' + bizIcon(it[0]) + '</div><div class="bi-t">' + it[1] + '</div></div>';
  });
  grid.innerHTML = g;
  $('bizCount').textContent = '共 ' + items.length + ' 项';
}
var BIZ_DESC = {
  site:'站点台账与基础信息维护（站点管理主页）',
  obs:'水位、水温、降水、蒸发等日常观测记载，手机速记自动算，成果自动入数据中心年柜',
  measure:'三等/四等水准、水尺零高、大断面等测量计算与成果管理',
  flow:'流量测验计算与成果保存，可进入整编分析实测流量成果表',
  history:'历年水位、流量等历史资料管理',
  kz:'水准点逐年考证、流速仪公式与检定年限考证',
  analy:'实测流量成果整编分析',
  annual:'按年统计水位、流量、降水、蒸发等月年特征值，生成年报表并打印/导出PDF',
  map:'站网分布图与站点导航',
  tools:'比测分析报告、频率曲线、经纬度批量转换、水准闭合差等水文常用计算工具',
  qr:'为单个站点生成基本信息二维码，也可用摄像头扫码读取站点',
  sim:'为新成立站点一键生成各功能模拟数据（可导出修改后导入），也可一键清除恢复空站'
};
function bizIcon(k) {
  return { site:'🗂️', obs:'📟', measure:'📏', flow:'🌊', history:'🗃️', kz:'📜', analy:'📐', annual:'📊', map:'🗺️', tools:'🧰', qr:'🔳', sim:'🧪' }[k] || '📦';
}
function openBizApp(k) {
  recordUse(viewOrgId(),'业务功能',{site:'站点管理',obs:'日常观测',measure:'水文测量',flow:'流量测验',history:'数据中心',kz:'考证',analy:'整编分析',annual:'年报报表',map:'站点导航',tools:'水文工具',qr:'站点二维码',sim:'模拟数据'}[k]||k);
  if (k === 'site') openYbt('home', '站点管理');
  else if (k === 'obs') openObsTab();
  else if (k === 'measure') openMeasure();
  else if (k === 'flow') openYbt('tab=流量测验', '流量测验');
  else if (k === 'history') openYbt('tab=数据中心', '数据中心');
  else if (k === 'kz') openYbt('tab=考证', '考证');
  else if (k === 'analy') openYbt('tab=整编分析', '整编分析');
  else if (k === 'annual') openAnnualTab();
  else if (k === 'map') openMap();
  else if (k === 'tools') openHydToolsTab();
  else if (k === 'qr') openQrTab();
  else if (k === 'sim') openSimTab();
}
function openYbt(hash, title) {
  syncBizBridge();
  _curPane = 'ybt';
  _curYbtTab = (hash||'').indexOf('tab=') >= 0 ? 'sub' : 'home';
  nav(title || '一表通', openBizTab);
  setPane('paneYbt');
  var f = $('ybtFrame');
  if (f) f.srcdoc = buildYbtSrcdoc(hash);
}
function openMeasure() {
  syncBizBridge();
  _curPane = 'measure';
  nav('水文测量', function(){ var f = $('measureFrame'); var cur = (f && f.contentWindow && f.contentWindow.Router) ? f.contentWindow.Router.current : 'home'; if (cur === 'home') { openBizTab(); } else if (f) { f.contentWindow.Router.home(); } });
  setPane('paneMeasure');
  var f = $('measureFrame');
  if (f) f.srcdoc = buildMeasureSrcdoc('');
}
function openMap() {
  syncBizBridge();
  _curPane = 'ybt';
  _curYbtTab = 'sub';

}

function openHydroTab(k){
  try{ if(!document.getElementById('hydroFrame')){ openInnerTab(k); return; } }catch(e){}
  try{ if(typeof openHomeTab==='function') openHomeTab(); }catch(e){}
  var _t=0;
  var _iv=setInterval(function(){
    var f=document.getElementById('hydroFrame');
    if(f&&f.contentWindow){ try{ if(typeof f.contentWindow.setTab==='function'){ f.contentWindow.setTab(k); clearInterval(_iv); } }catch(e){} }
    _t+=300; if(_t>6000) clearInterval(_iv);
  },300);
}
function openHydroModal(fn){
  try{ if(!document.getElementById('hydroFrame')) openInnerTab('home'); else if(typeof openHomeTab==='function') openHomeTab(); }catch(e){}
  var _t=0;
  var _iv=setInterval(function(){
    var f=document.getElementById('hydroFrame');
    if(f&&f.contentWindow){ try{ if(typeof f.contentWindow[fn]==='function'&&typeof f.contentWindow.modal==='function'){ f.contentWindow.modal(f.contentWindow[fn]()); clearInterval(_iv); } }catch(e){} }
    _t+=300; if(_t>8000) clearInterval(_iv);
  },300);
}
function loadExtraAdminTags(){
  try{
    var extra=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('admin_extra_tags')||'[]');
    extra.forEach(function(t){
      if(!t || !t.label) return;
      var dup=ADMIN_TAGS.some(function(x){ return x.label===t.label; });
      if(!dup) ADMIN_TAGS.push({label:t.label, js:t.js||'', g:null});
    });
  }catch(e){}
}

function adminTabOptions(sel){
  var s='<option value="">选择页面…</option>';
  ADMIN_TAGS.forEach(function(t){ if(t.tab) s+='<option value="'+t.tab+'"'+(sel===t.tab?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(t.label)+'</option>'; });
  return s;
}
function adminTplOptions(sel){
  var s='<option value="">选择模板…</option>';
  try{ var sys=getSysTpls(); sys.forEach(function(t){ var id='sys:'+t.name; s+='<option value="'+esc(id)+'"'+(sel===id?' selected':'')+'>[系统] '+esc(t.name)+'</option>'; }); }catch(e){}
  try{ var lib=getTplLib(); lib.forEach(function(t){ s+='<option value="'+esc(t.id)+'"'+(sel===t.id?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(t.name)+'</option>'; }); }catch(e){}
  return s;
}
function adminTagTypeChg(idx, selVal){
  var wrapId = idx<0 ? 'newTagValWrap' : 'editValWrap_'+idx;
  var typeId = idx<0 ? 'newTagType' : 'editType_'+idx;
  var wrap=document.getElementById(wrapId); var ts=document.getElementById(typeId);
  if(!wrap||!ts) return;
  var t=ts.value, vid = idx<0 ? 'newTagVal' : 'editVal_'+idx;
  if(t==='tab') wrap.innerHTML='<select id="'+vid+'" style="padding:5px 6px">'+adminTabOptions(selVal)+'</select>';
  else if(t==='tpl') wrap.innerHTML='<select id="'+vid+'" style="padding:5px 6px;max-width:220px">'+adminTplOptions(selVal)+'</select>';
  else if(t==='js') wrap.innerHTML='<input id="'+vid+'" value="'+esc(selVal||'')+'" placeholder="如 renderJizaiLib()" style="width:240px;padding:5px 8px">';
  else wrap.innerHTML='';
}
function adminTagJsOf(typeId, valId){
  var t=(document.getElementById(typeId)||{}).value||'';
  var v=(document.getElementById(valId)||{}).value||'';
  if(t==='tab'&&v) return "openInnerTab('"+v+"')";
  if(t==='tpl'&&v) return "renderTplEntry('"+v+"')";
  if(t==='js'&&v) return v;
  return '';
}
function adminEditTag(idx){
  var lv=(document.getElementById('editTag_'+idx)||{}).value||'';
  lv=lv.trim();
  var extra=[]; try{ extra=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('admin_extra_tags')||'[]'); }catch(e){}
  if(idx<0||idx>=extra.length) return;
  if(!lv){ alert('标签名称不能为空'); return; }
  var dup=extra.some(function(x,i){ return x.label===lv&&i!==idx; });
  if(dup){ alert('已有同名标签'); return; }
  var jv=adminTagJsOf('editType_'+idx,'editVal_'+idx);
  var oldLabel=extra[idx].label;
  extra[idx].label=lv; extra[idx].js=jv;
  localStorage.setItem('admin_extra_tags', JSON.stringify(extra));
  var at=null; for(var i=0;i<ADMIN_TAGS.length;i++) if(ADMIN_TAGS[i].label===oldLabel){ at=ADMIN_TAGS[i]; break; }
  if(at){ at.label=lv; at.js=jv; }
  var lay=getAdminLayout();
  if(lay&&lay.assign&&lay.assign[oldLabel]!==undefined){ lay.assign[lv]=lay.assign[oldLabel]; delete lay.assign[oldLabel]; localStorage.setItem('admin_layout', JSON.stringify(lay)); }
  _tagCfg=null;
  renderAddAdminTag();
}
function adminDelTag(idx){
  if(!confirm('确定删除该标签？')) return;
  var extra=[]; try{ extra=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('admin_extra_tags')||'[]'); }catch(e){}
  if(idx<0||idx>=extra.length) return;
  var delLabel=extra[idx].label;
  extra.splice(idx,1);
  localStorage.setItem('admin_extra_tags', JSON.stringify(extra));
  ADMIN_TAGS=ADMIN_TAGS.filter(function(x){ return x.label!==delLabel; });
  var lay=getAdminLayout();
  if(lay&&lay.assign&&lay.assign[delLabel]!==undefined){ delete lay.assign[delLabel]; localStorage.setItem('admin_layout', JSON.stringify(lay)); }
  _tagCfg=null;
  renderAddAdminTag();
}
function adminAddTagSave(){
  var lv=(document.getElementById('newTagLabel')||{}).value||'';
  lv=lv.trim();
  var m=document.getElementById('addTagMsg');
  if(!lv){ if(m)m.textContent='请填写标签名称'; return; }
  if(ADMIN_TAGS.some(function(x){ return x.label===lv; })){ if(m)m.textContent='已存在同名标签'; return; }
  var jv=adminTagJsOf('newTagType','newTagVal');
  var extra=[];
  try{ extra=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('admin_extra_tags')||'[]'); }catch(e){}
  extra.push({label:lv, js:jv});
  localStorage.setItem('admin_extra_tags', JSON.stringify(extra));
  ADMIN_TAGS.push({label:lv, js:jv, g:null});
  if(m){ m.style.color='#2e7d32'; m.textContent='已添加，正在跳转到分组设置…'; }
  setTimeout(function(){ renderAdminTagCfg(); }, 600);
}
var ADMIN_GROUPS_DEFAULT = ['系统设置','内部管理--基础设置','内部管理--报表生成','内部管理--工具模板','内部管理--通用功能'];
var ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT = ['#1565C0','#2e7d32','#c62828','#6a1b9a','#ef6c00','#00838f','#4527a0','#ad1457'];
function adminColorOf(lay,gi){ var c=(lay&&lay.colors&&lay.colors[gi])||ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT[gi%ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT.length]; return c; }
function getAdminLayout(){ try{ var v=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('admin_layout')||'null'); if(v && v.groups && v.assign) return v; }catch(e){} return null; }
function tagGroupOf(t, lay){ if(lay && lay.assign && lay.assign[t.label]!=null) return lay.assign[t.label]; return t.g; }
function tagColorOf(t, lay){
  if(lay && lay.tagColors && lay.tagColors[t.label]) return lay.tagColors[t.label];
  var gi = tagGroupOf(t, lay);
  if(lay && lay.colors && lay.colors[gi]) return lay.colors[gi];
  return ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT[gi % ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT.length] || t.col || _TAG_COL_DEF[0];
}

var tagCfgSel=0;
var _tagCfg = null;
function tagCfgSt(){ if(!_tagCfg){ var lay=getAdminLayout(); _tagCfg={groups:lay?lay.groups.slice():ADMIN_GROUPS_DEFAULT.slice(), assign:lay?Object.assign({},lay.assign):{}, colors:lay&&lay.colors?lay.colors.slice():[], tagColors:lay&&lay.tagColors?Object.assign({},lay.tagColors):{}, gvis:lay&&lay.gvis?lay.gvis.slice():[]}; } return _tagCfg; }
function tagCfgSelGrp(gi){ tagCfgSel=gi; renderAdminTagCfg(); }
function tagCfgToggle(label,gi,on){ var st=tagCfgSt(); if(on){ st.assign[label]=gi; } else { delete st.assign[label]; } renderAdminTagCfg(); var m=$('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='有未保存的更改'; }
function groupVisOf(st,gi){ if(st && st.gvis && st.gvis[gi]) return st.gvis[gi]; var gn=(st&&st.groups)?st.groups[gi]:''; if(gn&&gn.indexOf('系统')>=0) return 'sys'; if(gn&&gn.indexOf('职工')>=0) return 'all'; return 'admin'; }
function grpVisOk(lay,gi){ var v=groupVisOf(lay,gi); var u=currentUser(); if(!u) return false; if(v==='sys') return isSuper(u); if(v==='admin') return isManage(u); return true; }
function tagCfgVis(gi,v){ var st=tagCfgSt(); if(!st.gvis) st.gvis=[]; st.gvis[gi]=v; renderAdminTagCfg(); var m=document.getElementById('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='有未保存的更改'; }
function tagCfgAssign(label,gi){ var st=tagCfgSt(); if(gi===''||gi===null||typeof gi==='undefined'){ delete st.assign[label]; } else { st.assign[label]=+gi; } var m=document.getElementById('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='有未保存的更改'; }
function tagCfgDrag(ev,label){ try{ ev.dataTransfer.setData('text/plain',label); ev.dataTransfer.effectAllowed='move'; }catch(e){} }
function tagCfgDrop(ev,gi){ ev.preventDefault(); var label=''; try{ label=ev.dataTransfer.getData('text/plain'); }catch(e){} if(!label) return; var st=tagCfgSt(); if(gi===''||gi===null||typeof gi==='undefined'){ delete st.assign[label]; } else { st.assign[label]=+gi; } renderAdminTagCfg(); var m=document.getElementById('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='有未保存的更改'; }
function tagCfgAllow(ev){ ev.preventDefault(); try{ ev.dataTransfer.dropEffect='move'; }catch(e){} }
function tagCfgColor(gi,v){ var st=tagCfgSt(); if(!st.colors) st.colors=[]; st.colors[gi]=v; renderAdminTagCfg(); var m=$('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='有未保存的更改'; }
function tagCfgRename(gi,v){ v=(v||'').trim(); if(!v) return; var st=tagCfgSt(); st.groups[gi]=v; renderAdminTagCfg(); var m=$('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='有未保存的更改'; }
function tagCfgAddGrp(){ var inp=$('tagCfgNewGrp'); var v=(inp?inp.value:'').trim(); if(!v) return; var st=tagCfgSt(); st.groups.push(v); if(!st.colors) st.colors=[]; st.colors.push(ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT[st.groups.length-1 % ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT.length]); if(inp)inp.value=''; renderAdminTagCfg(); var m=$('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='有未保存的更改'; }
function tagCfgDelGrp(gi){ var st=tagCfgSt(); if(st.groups.length<=1) return; st.groups.splice(gi,1); if(st.colors) st.colors.splice(gi,1); // 该组标签归到第一组
  ADMIN_TAGS.forEach(function(t){ if(st.assign[t.label]===gi) delete st.assign[t.label]; else if(st.assign[t.label]>gi) st.assign[t.label]--; });
  renderAdminTagCfg(); var m=$('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='有未保存的更改'; }
function bkBar(target, label){
  var b=document.createElement('button'); b.className='bk-rt'; b.textContent='返回';
  b.onclick=function(){ try{ backTo(target); }catch(e){} };
  setTimeout(function(){
    // 统一：返回按钮放入当前可见管理容器的第一个卡片右上角
    var op=document.getElementById('orgPage');
    var ap=document.getElementById('authPage');
    var body=null;
    if(op && op.style.display!=='none'){ body=document.getElementById('orgPageBody'); }
    else if(ap && ap.style.display!=='none'){ body=document.getElementById('authPageBody'); }
    else { var ph=document.getElementById('paneHome'); if(ph && ph.style.display!=='none') body=ph; }
    if(!body) body=document.getElementById('orgPageBody')||document.getElementById('authPageBody')||document.getElementById('paneHome');
    if(body){
      var c=body.querySelector('.card');
      if(c){ c.style.position='relative'; c.appendChild(b); }
      else { body.appendChild(b); }
    }
  },0);
  return '';
}
function renderAdminTagCfg(){
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u || u.role!=='countyAdmin') return;
  showPage('mainApp'); setTab('tabHome'); setPane('paneHome'); nav('管理', '标签分组设置');
  var st = tagCfgSt();
  var h = '<div class="topbar" id="mgmtTopbar" style="flex-wrap:wrap;position:sticky;top:0;padding:12px 16px 10px"><img class="g-logo" onclick="renderCountyManagePage()" style="cursor:pointer;height:26px;width:26px;border-radius:6px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0" src=""><span class="g-brand" id="mgmtBrand" style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">浏阳一表通</span><span id="mgmtTitle" style="position:absolute;left:50%;top:14px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.5)">标签分组设置</span><span id="mgmtRight" style="margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap"></span><div class="g-nav5"><button class="g-tag" onclick="openHomeTab()">办公</button><button class="g-tag" onclick="openBizTab()">业务</button><button class="g-tag" style="padding:2px 2px;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis" onclick="bizPickStation()">📍 选择测站</button><button class="g-tag" onclick="openGuide(\'管理\')">使用指南</button><button class="g-tag on" onclick="openMineTab()">设置</button></div></div>' + bkBar('backFromManage','管理') + '<div class="card"><h3>标签分组设置</h3><p class="mut">分组管理：给每个分组改名、改色、删除；下方标签归属：未归类的标签可勾选归入当前分组。点「保存」后立即生效。</p></div>';
  // 分组管理：每个组下面显示已归类的标签
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>分组管理</h3>'
    + st.groups.map(function(g,gi){
      var gc=st.colors[gi]||ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT[gi%ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT.length];
      var tagsInGrp = ADMIN_TAGS.filter(function(t){ var tgi=tagGroupOf(t,{assign:st.assign}); return tgi===gi; }).map(function(t){ return t.label; });
      var _gv=groupVisOf(st,gi);
      var _visSel='<select onchange="tagCfgVis('+gi+',this.value)" style="font-size:12px;padding:2px 4px">'
        +'<option value="sys"'+(_gv==='sys'?' selected':'')+'>仅系统管理</option>'
        +'<option value="admin"'+(_gv==='admin'?' selected':'')+'>仅管理员</option>'
        +'<option value="all"'+(_gv==='all'?' selected':'')+'>管理员+职工</option></select>';
      return '<div style="margin:8px 0">'
        + '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center"><input type="color" value="'+gc+'" onchange="tagCfgColor('+gi+',this.value)" style="width:36px;height:26px;padding:0;border:1px solid var(--border);cursor:pointer"><input value="'+esc(g)+'" style="flex:1;padding:4px 8px" onchange="tagCfgRename('+gi+',this.value)">'+_visSel+'<button onclick="tagCfgDelGrp('+gi+')" style="background:#c0392b;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:4px;padding:4px 10px;cursor:pointer">删除</button></div>'
        + (tagsInGrp.length ? '<div style="margin-top:4px;padding:4px 8px;background:var(--bg-hover);border-radius:6px;font-size:12px"><b>已归类：</b>'+esc(tagsInGrp.join('、'))+'</div>' : '<div style="margin-top:4px;padding:4px 8px;background:var(--bg-hover);border-radius:6px;font-size:12px;color:#999">暂无归类标签</div>')
        + '</div>';
    }).join('')
    + '<div style="margin-top:6px"><input id="tagCfgNewGrp" placeholder="新分组名称" style="padding:4px 8px"> <button onclick="tagCfgAddGrp()" style="cursor:pointer">添加分组</button></div></div>';
  // 标签归属：文件夹卡片式，标签可拖拽进/出任意文件夹
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>标签文件夹（拖拽管理）</h3>';
  h += '<p class="mut" style="margin:0 0 10px">按住标签拖进任意文件夹即归入该组；拖到「未分组」即移出。文件夹可见性在上方「分组管理」里设置。</p>';
  h += '<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;align-items:flex-start">';
  var chipFn=function(t){
    return '<span draggable="true" ondragstart="tagCfgDrag(event,\''+t.label+'\')" style="display:inline-block;margin:3px;padding:3px 12px;border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;background:#fff;color:var(--t1);cursor:move;font-size:13px">'+esc(t.label)+'</span>';
  };
  st.groups.forEach(function(g,gi){
    var gc=st.colors[gi]||ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT[gi%ADMIN_COLORS_DEFAULT.length];
    var tags=ADMIN_TAGS.filter(function(t){ return tagGroupOf(t,{assign:st.assign})===gi; });
    h += '<div ondragover="tagCfgAllow(event)" ondrop="tagCfgDrop(event,'+gi+')" style="flex:0 0 230px;min-height:110px;border:2px dashed '+gc+';border-radius:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--bg-hover)">'
      + '<div style="font-weight:600;color:'+gc+';font-size:13px;margin-bottom:4px">📁 '+esc(g)+' <span style="font-weight:400;color:#999">('+tags.length+')</span></div>'
      + '<div>'+tags.map(chipFn).join('')+'</div></div>';
  });
  var unTags=ADMIN_TAGS.filter(function(t){ var tgi=tagGroupOf(t,{assign:st.assign}); return tgi==null||tgi<0||tgi>=st.groups.length; });
  h += '<div ondragover="tagCfgAllow(event)" ondrop="tagCfgDrop(event,\'\')" style="flex:0 0 230px;min-height:110px;border:2px dashed #999;border-radius:8px;padding:6px 8px;background:var(--bg-hover)">'
    + '<div style="font-weight:600;color:#666;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:4px">📂 未分组 <span style="font-weight:400;color:#999">('+unTags.length+')</span></div>'
    + '<div>'+unTags.map(chipFn).join('')+'</div></div>';
  h += '</div>';
  h += '<div style="margin-top:10px"><button onclick="tagCfgSave()" style="background:#1565C0;color:#fff;border:none;border-radius:6px;padding:8px 18px;cursor:pointer">保存</button> <button onclick="tagCfgReset()" style="cursor:pointer">恢复默认</button> <span id="tagCfgMsg" style="color:#c0392b;font-size:12px;margin-left:8px"></span></div></div>';
  $('paneHome').innerHTML = h;
  try{ var _mb=$('mgmtBrand'); if(_mb) _mb.textContent=appNameOf(u); var _lgm=document.querySelector('link[rel="icon"]'); var _srm=_lgm?(_lgm.getAttribute('href')||''):''; var _mtb=$('mgmtTopbar'); if(_mtb){ var _im3=_mtb.querySelector('img'); if(_im3&&_srm) _im3.setAttribute('src',_srm); } }catch(e){}
}
function tagCfgSave(){ if(_tagCfg){ localStorage.setItem('admin_layout', JSON.stringify(_tagCfg)); _tagCfg=null; } renderAdminTagCfg(); var m=$('tagCfgMsg'); if(m)m.textContent='已保存'; setTimeout(function(){ if(m)m.textContent=''; },2000); }
function tagCfgReset(){ localStorage.removeItem('admin_layout'); _tagCfg=null; renderAdminTagCfg(); }

  var h = '<div class="topbar" id="mgmtTopbar" style="flex-wrap:wrap;position:sticky;top:0;padding:12px 16px 10px"><img class="g-logo" onclick="goBack()" style="cursor:pointer;height:26px;width:26px;border-radius:6px;object-fit:cover;flex-shrink:0" src=""><span class="g-brand" id="mgmtBrand" style="font-size:16px;font-weight:700;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">浏阳一表通</span><span id="mgmtTitle" style="position:absolute;left:50%;top:14px;transform:translateX(-50%);font-size:17px;font-weight:800;color:#fff;white-space:nowrap;text-shadow:0 1px 3px rgba(0,0,0,.5)">管理</span><span id="mgmtRight" style="margin-left:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap"></span><div class="g-nav5"><button class="g-tag" onclick="openHomeTab()">办公</button><button class="g-tag" onclick="openBizTab()">业务</button><button class="g-tag" style="padding:2px 2px;font-size:12px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis" onclick="bizPickStation()">📍 选择测站</button><button class="g-tag" onclick="openGuide(\'管理\')">使用指南</button><button class="g-tag on" onclick="openMineTab()">设置</button></div></div>' + bkBar('backFromManage','管理') + '<div style="text-align:right;padding:2px 8px 6px"><a style="color:#2563eb;cursor:pointer;font-size:13px;text-decoration:underline" onclick="doLogout()">退出</a></div>' + '<div class="card"><h3>管理</h3><p class="mut">' + (o?esc(o.name):'') + ' · 本机构全部管理功能</p></div>';
    var _lay=getAdminLayout();

    var items=ADMIN_TAGS.filter(function(t){ var g=tagGroupOf(t,_lay); if(g<0||g>=_groups.length) g=t.g; return g===gi; });
    if(!grpVisOk(_lay,gi)){
      // 组不可见时，仍放行「标签分组设置」给管理员（避免入口被自己锁死）

  });

/* ===================== 模板生成器 v2（图片+表格，缩放移动，指定输入） ===================== */
var TPL={selectMode:false,type:null,mode:'preview',scale:1,dx:0,dy:0,filled:{},tplWB:null,img:null,inputs:[],drag:null,fname:'',sel:null,addMode:false,selMode:false};
function renderTemplateGen(){

  if(!window.__tplDragBound){ window.__tplDragBound=true; document.addEventListener('mousemove',function(e){ tplDragMove(e); }); document.addEventListener('mouseup',function(){ tplDragEnd(); }); }
  var body=$('orgPageBody');
  var h=bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel())
    +'<div class="card"><h3>模板生成器</h3><p class="mut">导入 Excel(.xlsx/.xls)、Word(.docx) 生成结构化模板，或导入图片作为模板底图；可缩放、上下左右移动调整；点「指定输入」标记需录入的位置（表格点空白格、图片点画布），录入数据自动填入对应位置，A4 打印效果与原表相同。</p>'
    +'<div id="tplSteps" style="margin:2px 0 6px;font-size:12px;color:#888"></div>'
    +'<div class="tpl-tool"><input type="file" id="tplFile" accept=".xlsx,.xls,.docx,.png,.jpg,.jpeg,.bmp" style="display:none" onchange="tplFileChg()">'
    +'<button onclick="$(\'tplFile\').click()">导入表格/图片</button> '
    +'<select id="tplSheet" style="display:none" onchange="tplRender()"></select>'
    +'<span>缩放 <input type="range" id="tplZoom" min="40" max="300" value="100" style="width:90px;vertical-align:middle" oninput="tplZoomIn()"><span id="tplZoomVal">100%</span></span> '
    +'<button onclick="tplMove(0,-1)">上移</button><button onclick="tplMove(0,1)">下移</button><button onclick="tplMove(-1,0)">左移</button><button onclick="tplMove(1,0)">右移</button> '
    +'<button onclick="tplResetView()">复位</button> '
    +'<button id="tplUndoBtn" style="display:none" onclick="tplUndo()">撤销</button> '
