    +'<button id="tplInBtn" style="display:none" onclick="tplSetMode(\'input\')">预览/输入</button> '
    +'<button id="tplPrintBtn" style="display:none" onclick="tplSetMode(\'print\')">预览/打印</button> <span id="tplSideWrap"><button id="tplAddBackBtn" style="display:none" onclick="tplAddBack()">＋反面</button><button id="tplSideBtn" style="display:none" onclick="tplSideSw()">⇄ 正/反面</button><button id="tplDelBackBtn" style="display:none" onclick="tplDelBack()">×删反面</button></span> '
    +'<span id="tplTypeWrap" style="display:none">类型 <select id="tplType"><option value="text">文本框</option><option value="date">日期</option><option value="number">数字</option><option value="check">复选框</option><option value="radio">单选框</option></select></span> '
    +'<span id="tplFontWrap" style="display:none">字体 <select id="tplFont" onchange="tplFontChange()"><option value="SimSun">宋体</option><option value="FangSong">仿宋</option><option value="SimHei">黑体</option><option value="KaiTi">楷体</option></select></span> <span id="tplInSizeWrap" style="display:none">字号<button onclick="tplInSize(-1)">-</button><button onclick="tplInSize(1)">+</button></span> '
    +'<span id="tplStyleWrap" style="display:none">字号<button onclick="tplStyleSize(-1)">-</button><button onclick="tplStyleSize(1)">+</button> 对齐<button onclick="tplStyleAlign(\'left\')">左</button><button onclick="tplStyleAlign(\'center\')">中</button><button onclick="tplStyleAlign(\'right\')">右</button><button id="tplMergeBtn" onclick="tplMergeToggle()">合并</button><button id="tplSplitBtn" onclick="tplSplitCell()">拆分</button><button id="tplAddRowBtn" onclick="tplAddRow()">加行</button><button id="tplDelRowBtn" onclick="tplDelRow()">删行</button><button id="tplAddColBtn" onclick="tplAddCol()">加列</button><button id="tplDelColBtn" onclick="tplDelCol()">删列</button><button onclick="tplStyleBold()">粗体</button><button onclick="tplRowH(-1)">行高-</button><button onclick="tplRowH(1)">行高+</button><button onclick="tplColW(-1)">列宽-</button><button onclick="tplColW(1)">列宽+</button><button onclick="tplFitWidth()">适应页宽</button><button id="tplLinkBtn" onclick="tplOpenLinkPanel()">关联数据</button></span> '
    +'<button id="tplSaveBtn" style="display:none" onclick="tplSaveTpl()">保存模板</button></div>'
    +'<p class="mut" id="tplHint">尚未导入。导入 Excel/Word 生成结构化模板，或导入图片作为模板底图。</p>'
    +'<div id="tplStage" class="tpl-stage"><div id="tplInner" class="tpl-stage-inner"></div></div>'
    +'<div id="tplPrint" style="display:none"></div>';
  body.innerHTML=h;
  TPL={type:null,mode:'preview',scale:1,dx:0,dy:0,filled:{},tplWB:null,img:null,inputs:[],drag:null,fname:'',sel:null,addMode:false,selMode:false};
  if(!window.__tplStageDragBound){ window.__tplStageDragBound=true; document.addEventListener('mousedown',function(e){
    if(TPL.mode!=='spec'||TPL.type!=='table') return;
    var st=document.getElementById('tplStage'); if(!st) return;
    var r=st.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(e.clientX<r.left-2||e.clientX>r.right+2||e.clientY<r.top-2||e.clientY>r.bottom+2) return;
    tplDragStartCanvas(e);
  }); }
  tplBindDrag();
  var _bb=document.getElementById('backBtn'); if(_bb){ _bb.onclick=function(){ tplBackGen(); }; }
}
function tplLoadLib(which, cb){
  var libs={xlsx:'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/xlsx@0.18.5/dist/xlsx.full.min.js', jszip:'https://cdn.jsdelivr.net/npm/jszip@3.10.1/dist/jszip.min.js'};
  var done=function(){ if(cb) cb(); };
  if((which==='xlsx'&&window.XLSX)||(which==='jszip'&&window.JSZip)){ done(); return; }
  var s=document.createElement('script'); s.src=libs[which]; s.onload=done; s.onerror=done; document.head.appendChild(s);
}
function tplFileChg(){
  var f=$('tplFile').files[0]; if(!f) return;
  var n=f.name.toLowerCase(); TPL.fname=f.name.replace(/\.[^.]+$/,'');
  if(/\.(png|jpe?g|bmp|gif)$/.test(n)){
    var r=new FileReader();
    r.onload=function(ev){ TPL.type='img'; TPL.img=ev.target.result; TPL.inputs=[]; TPL.filled={}; TPL.dx=0; TPL.dy=0; TPL.scale=1; tplReadyImg(); };
    r.readAsDataURL(f);
  } else {
    var need=(n.indexOf('.docx')>-1)?'jszip':'xlsx';
    tplLoadLib(need, function(){ tplProcessFile(f); });
  }
}
function tplProcessFile(f){
  var name=f.name.toLowerCase(); var r=new FileReader();
  r.onload=function(ev){
    var ab=ev.target.result;
    try{
      if(name.indexOf('.docx')>-1){
        JSZip.loadAsync(ab).then(function(zip){ return zip.file('word/document.xml').async('string'); })
        .then(function(xml){ TPL.type='table'; TPL.t= tplXmlParse(xml); tplDetectHeaderFooter(TPL.t); TPL.inputs=[]; TPL.filled={}; tplReady(); })
        .catch(function(e){ alert('Word 解析失败：'+(e&&e.message||e)); });
      } else {
        TPL.tplWB=XLSX.read(new Uint8Array(ab),{type:'array',cellStyles:true});
        var sel=$('tplSheet'); sel.innerHTML=''; sel.style.display='';
        (TPL.tplWB.SheetNames||[]).forEach(function(n){ var o=document.createElement('option'); o.text=n; sel.add(o); });
        tplRender();
      }
    }catch(e){ alert('解析失败：'+(e&&e.message||e)); }
  };
  r.readAsArrayBuffer(f);
}
function tplRender(){
  if(!TPL.tplWB) return;
  var name=$('tplSheet').value; var ws=TPL.tplWB.Sheets[name];
  TPL.type='table'; TPL.t=tplXlsxParse(ws); TPL.inputs=[]; TPL.filled={}; tplReady();
}
function tplReady(){
  TPL.t2=null;TPL.inputs2=null;TPL.filled2=null;TPL.side='front';
  $('tplPrintBtn').style.display=''; $('tplModeBtn').style.display=''; $('tplTextBtn').style.display=''; $('tplInBtn').style.display=''; $('tplSaveBtn').style.display=''; $('tplUndoBtn').style.display=''; tplSyncUndoBtn();
  var _ab2=$('tplAddBackBtn'); if(_ab2) _ab2.style.display=(TPL.type==='table'?'':'none'); tplSideBtnHL();
  var t=TPL.t;
  TPL.scale=100; TPL.dx=0; TPL.dy=0; var zz=$('tplZoom'); if(zz){ zz.value=100; } var zv=$('tplZoomVal'); if(zv){ zv.textContent='100%'; }
  $('tplHint').textContent='已导入 '+t.R+' 行 × '+t.C+' 列。已自动把 '+((t.blanks&&t.blanks.length)||0)+' 个空白格标为输入点（黄色格）；不需要的格子点一下可取消，漏标的空格点一下补上。「编辑模板」改文字排版；「预览/输入」看录入界面；「预览/打印」看打印效果。';
  if(t.blanks && t.blanks.length){ TPL.inputs=t.blanks.map(function(b){ return {kind:'cell',key:(b.r+1)+'_'+(b.c+1),type:'text',font:'SimSun'}; }); }
  TPL.mode='spec'; TPL.addMode=true; tplSyncModeBtns(); tplRenderInner(); TPL.dirty=true; tplFitA4();
}
function tplReadyImg(){
  TPL.t2=null;TPL.inputs2=null;TPL.filled2=null;TPL.side='front';
  $('tplPrintBtn').style.display=''; $('tplModeBtn').style.display=''; $('tplTextBtn').style.display=''; $('tplInBtn').style.display=''; $('tplSaveBtn').style.display=''; $('tplUndoBtn').style.display=''; tplSyncUndoBtn();
  var _ab2=$('tplAddBackBtn'); if(_ab2) _ab2.style.display=(TPL.type==='table'?'':'none'); tplSideBtnHL();
  $('tplHint').textContent='图片模板已载入；「指定输入」模式下点击图片任意位置添加输入框，可拖动/缩放，录入后 A4 打印（图片为底图，文字叠加对应位置）。';
  TPL.mode='spec'; TPL.addMode=true; tplSyncModeBtns(); tplRenderInner(); TPL.dirty=true; tplFitA4();
}
/* ---- 解析 ---- */
function tplDetectHeaderFooter(td){
  var R=td.R,C=td.C,grid=td.grid,merges=td.merges||[];
  var headerRows=[],footerRows=[];
  var hdrKw=/表|记录|单|台账|报表|清单|登记簿|卡片|账册/;
  var ftrKw=/签名|审核|复核|制表|填报|盖章|日期|负责人|经手人|审核人|批准人|审核日期|填报人|编制人|校核|审签/;
  for(var r=0;r<Math.min(3,R);r++){
    var rt='';for(var c=0;c<C;c++)rt+=(grid[r][c].text||'');
    var isHdr=false;
    if(r===0)isHdr=true;
    else{
      var bigM=merges.some(function(m){return m.r1===r&&(m.c2-m.c1)>=2;});
      if(bigM)isHdr=true;
      else if(hdrKw.test(rt))isHdr=true;
    }
    if(isHdr)headerRows.push(r);else break;
  }
  for(var r=R-1;r>=Math.max(headerRows.length,R-6);r--){
    var rt2='';for(var c=0;c<C;c++)rt2+=(grid[r][c].text||'');
    if(ftrKw.test(rt2))footerRows.push(r);
    else if(rt2.trim()==='')continue;
    else break;
  }
  footerRows.sort(function(a,b){return a-b;});
  TPL._headerRows=headerRows;TPL._footerRows=footerRows;
}
function tplXlsxParse(ws){
  var ref=ws['!ref']||'A1'; var rg=XLSX.utils.decode_range(ref);
  var R=rg.e.r-rg.s.r+1, C=rg.e.c-rg.s.c+1;
  var cols=[]; (ws['!cols']||[]).forEach(function(c){ cols.push(c.wpx||Math.round((c.wch||8)*7.5)); });
  while(cols.length<C) cols.push(80);
  var rows=[]; (ws['!rows']||[]).forEach(function(r){ rows.push(Math.round((r.hpt||18)*96/72)); });
  while(rows.length<R) rows.push(24);
  var merges=[]; (ws['!merges']||[]).forEach(function(m){ merges.push({r1:m.s.r,c1:m.s.c,r2:m.e.r,c2:m.e.c}); });
  var grid=[]; for(var r=0;r<R;r++){ grid[r]=[]; for(var c=0;c<C;c++) grid[r][c]={text:'',style:null}; }
  for(var a in ws){ if(a[0]!=='!'){ try{ var ad=XLSX.utils.decode_cell(a); var cell=ws[a]; if(cell!==undefined&&cell.v!==undefined&&cell.v!==null&&String(cell.v).trim()!==''){ grid[ad.r][ad.c]={text:String(cell.v),style:cell.s||null}; } }catch(e){} } }
  var inMerge={}; merges.forEach(function(m){ for(var r=m.r1;r<=m.r2;r++)for(var c=m.c1;c<=m.c2;c++) inMerge[r+'_'+c]=1; });
  var blanks=[]; for(var r=0;r<R;r++)for(var c=0;c<C;c++){ if(!inMerge[r+'_'+c]&&grid[r][c].text==='') blanks.push({r:r,c:c}); }
  tplDetectHeaderFooter({R:R,C:C,grid:grid,merges:merges});
  return {R:R,C:C,cols:cols,rows:rows,merges:merges,grid:grid,blanks:blanks};
}
function tplDxa(d){ return d?Math.max(12,Math.round(d/1440*96)):24; }
function tplCellText(tc){ var ps=tc.getElementsByTagName('w:p'); var txt=''; var ts=tc.getElementsByTagName('w:t');
  if(ps.length>1){ for(var p=0;p<ps.length;p++){ var sgs=ps[p].getElementsByTagName('w:t'); var seg=''; for(var i=0;i<sgs.length;i++) seg+=sgs[i].textContent; if(p>0) txt+='\n'; txt+=seg; } }
  else { for(var i=0;i<ts.length;i++) txt+=ts[i].textContent; }
  return txt.replace(/^[\s\u3000]+|[\s\u3000]+$/g,''); }
function tplTcStyle(tc){
  var s={border:{}}; var tcPr=tc.getElementsByTagName('w:tcPr')[0];
  if(tcPr){ var bd=tcPr.getElementsByTagName('w:tcBorders')[0];
    if(bd){ ['top','bottom','left','right'].forEach(function(e){ var el=bd.getElementsByTagName('w:'+e)[0]; if(el&&el.getAttribute&&el.getAttribute('w:val')&&el.getAttribute('w:val')!=='nil'&&el.getAttribute('w:val')!=='none'){ s.border[e]={color:el.getAttribute('w:color')||'000000'}; } else { delete s.border[e]; } }); } }
  var rp=tc.getElementsByTagName('w:rPr')[0];
  if(rp){ var f=rp.getElementsByTagName('w:rFonts')[0]; if(f) s.font=(f.getAttribute('w:eastAsia')||f.getAttribute('w:ascii')||''); var sz=rp.getElementsByTagName('w:sz')[0]; if(sz) s.sz=parseInt(sz.getAttribute('w:val')||'20')/2; if(rp.getElementsByTagName('w:b').length) s.bold=true; }
  var pPr=tc.getElementsByTagName('w:pPr')[0];
  if(pPr){ var jc=pPr.getElementsByTagName('w:jc')[0]; if(jc) s.align=jc.getAttribute('w:val'); }
  return s;
}
function tplPText(p){ var ts=p.getElementsByTagName('w:t'); var s=''; for(var i=0;i<ts.length;i++) s+=ts[i].textContent; return s.replace(/^[\s\u3000]+|[\s\u3000]+$/g,''); }
function tplXmlParse(xml){
  var doc=new DOMParser().parseFromString(xml,'application/xml');
  var body=doc.getElementsByTagName('w:body')[0];
  var tbl=doc.getElementsByTagName('w:tbl')[0]; if(!tbl) throw '文档中没有表格';
  /* 表格外的标题段落（body 顶层 tbl 前的 w:p） */
  var title='';
  if(body){ for(var bi=0;bi<body.childNodes.length;bi++){ var bn=body.childNodes[bi]; if(bn.nodeType!==1) continue; var tag=(bn.localName||bn.nodeName).toLowerCase(); if(tag==='tbl') break; if(tag==='p'){ title += (title?'\n':'') + tplPText(bn); } } }
  var cols=[]; var gc=tbl.getElementsByTagName('w:gridCol');
  for(var i=0;i<gc.length;i++){ var w=parseInt(gc[i].getAttribute('w:w')||'0'); cols.push(w?tplDxa(w):100); }
  if(!cols.length){ var tw=tbl.getElementsByTagName('w:tblW')[0]; var trs0=tbl.getElementsByTagName('w:tr'); if(tw&&trs0.length){ var nc=trs0[0].getElementsByTagName('w:tc').length; var total=parseInt(tw.getAttribute('w:w')||'0'); var cw=nc?(total/nc):200; for(var i=0;i<nc;i++) cols.push(tplDxa(cw)); } }
  var trs=tbl.getElementsByTagName('w:tr'); var grid=[]; var rows=[]; var merges=[]; var vMergeMap={};
  for(var r=0;r<trs.length;r++){ var tr=trs[r]; var th=tr.getElementsByTagName('w:trHeight')[0]; rows.push(th?tplDxa(parseInt(th.getAttribute('w:hVal')||'0')):24);
    var tcs=tr.getElementsByTagName('w:tc'); var row=[]; var col=0;
    for(var t=0;t<tcs.length;t++){ var tc=tcs[t]; var tcPr=tc.getElementsByTagName('w:tcPr')[0]; var span=1; var vm=null;
      if(tcPr){ var gs=tcPr.getElementsByTagName('w:gridSpan')[0]; if(gs) span=parseInt(gs.getAttribute('w:val')||'1'); var vme=tcPr.getElementsByTagName('w:vMerge')[0]; if(vme) vm=vme; }
      var txt=tplCellText(tc); var style=tplTcStyle(tc);
      for(var k=0;k<span;k++) row[col+k]={text:(k===0?txt:''),style:style,first:(k===0)};
      if(span>1) merges.push({r1:r,c1:col,r2:r,c2:col+span-1});
      if(vm){
        var vv=vm.getAttribute('w:val')||'continue';
        if(vv!=='continue'){ var m0={r1:r,c1:col,r2:r,c2:col}; merges.push(m0); vMergeMap[col]=m0; }
        else if(vMergeMap[col]){ vMergeMap[col].r2=r; for(var k2=0;k2<span;k2++){ row[col+k2]={text:'',style:style}; } }
      }
      col+=span; } grid[r]=row; }
  var R=grid.length, C=cols.length; if(!C){ grid.forEach(function(row){ C=Math.max(C,row.length); }); }
  /* 标题段落插入为表格首行（合并全行） */
  if(title){
    var ht=14*(title.split('\n').length)+6;
    rows.unshift(ht);
    var newRow=[]; for(var c0=0;c0<C;c0++) newRow[c0]={text:(c0===0?title:''),style:{align:'center',bold:true},first:(c0===0)};
    grid.unshift(newRow);
    merges.unshift({r1:0,c1:0,r2:0,c2:C-1});
    for(var mi=1;mi<merges.length;mi++){ merges[mi].r1++; merges[mi].r2++; }
    R++;
  }
  var blanks=[]; var used={}; merges.forEach(function(m){ for(var r=m.r1;r<=m.r2;r++)for(var c=m.c1;c<=m.c2;c++) used[r+'_'+c]=1; });
  for(var r=0;r<R;r++)for(var c=0;c<C;c++){ var cell=grid[r]&&grid[r][c]; if(!used[r+'_'+c]&&(!cell||cell.text==='')) blanks.push({r:r,c:c}); }
  return {R:R,C:C,cols:cols,rows:rows,merges:merges,grid:grid,blanks:blanks};
}
function tplColor(c){ if(!c) return '#000'; return c.indexOf('#')===0?c:'#'+c; }
function tplStyleCss(st){ var css=''; if(!st) return css; if(st.nobd) css+='border:none;';
  var b=st.border;
  if(b&&Object.keys(b).length){ var s=tplColor(b.top&&b.top.color),bt=tplColor(b.bottom&&b.bottom.color),bl=tplColor(b.left&&b.left.color),br=tplColor(b.right&&b.right.color); if(b.top&&b.bottom&&b.left&&b.right){ css+='border:1px solid '+s+';'; } else { if(b.top) css+='border-top:1px solid '+s+';'; if(b.bottom) css+='border-bottom:1px solid '+bt+';'; if(b.left) css+='border-left:1px solid '+bl+';'; if(b.right) css+='border-right:1px solid '+br+';'; } }
  if(st.font) css+='font-family:'+st.font+';'; if(st.sz) css+='font-size:'+st.sz+'pt;'; if(st.bold) css+='font-weight:bold;'; if(st.italic) css+='font-style:italic;'; if(st.align) css+='text-align:'+st.align+';'; return css; }
function tplMergeAt(t,r,c){ for(var i=0;i<t.merges.length;i++){ var m=t.merges[i]; if(m.r1<=r&&r<=m.r2&&m.c1<=c&&c<=m.c2) return m; } return null; }
/* ---- 渲染（统一 stage） ---- */
function tplRenderInner(){
  var masks=document.querySelectorAll('#tplInnerMask,#tplStaffMask,#tplStationMask,#tplLinkPanel'); for(var _i=0;_i<masks.length;_i++){ if(masks[_i]&&masks[_i].parentNode) masks[_i].parentNode.removeChild(masks[_i]); }

  var inner=$('tplInner'); if(!inner) return;
  if(TPL.mode==='print'){ inner.innerHTML = (TPL.type==='table'?tplPrintHtml():tplPrintImgHtml()); }
  else if(TPL.type==='table') inner.innerHTML=(TPL.mode==='input'?tplStationBarHtml():'')+tplTableHtml()+(TPL.mode==='spec'||TPL.mode==='input'?tplFreeCanvasHtml(TPL.mode,TPL.filled||{}):'');
  else if(TPL.type==='img') inner.innerHTML=tplImgHtml();
  tplApplyView();
}
function tplFitA4(){
  var stage=$('tplStage'); var inner=$('tplInner');
  if(!stage||!inner) return;
  var W=stage.clientWidth-28; if(!W||W<200) W=794;
  var s=Math.floor((W)/794*100); s=Math.max(25,Math.min(160,s));
  TPL.scale=s; TPL.dx=Math.max(0,(W-794*s/100)/2);
  var stH=stage.clientHeight; var paperH=1123*s/100;
  TPL.dy=(stH-paperH)>6? Math.max(0,(stH-paperH)/2) : 0;
  var zz=$('tplZoom'); if(zz) zz.value=s; var zv=$('tplZoomVal'); if(zv) zv.textContent=s+'%';
  tplApplyView();
}
function tplApplyView(){ var inner=$('tplInner'); if(inner) inner.style.transform='translate('+TPL.dx+'px,'+TPL.dy+'px) scale('+(TPL.scale/100)+')'; }
function tplZoomIn(){ TPL.scale=parseInt($('tplZoom').value)||100; $('tplZoomVal').textContent=TPL.scale+'%'; tplApplyView(); }
function tplMove(dx,dy){ TPL.dx+=dx*10; TPL.dy+=dy*10; tplApplyView(); }
function tplResetView(){ tplFitA4(); }
function tplIsInput(key){ for(var i=0;i<TPL.inputs.length;i++) if(TPL.inputs[i].kind==='cell'&&TPL.inputs[i].key===key) return true; return false; }
function tplImgHtml(){
  var h='<img id="tplImgEl" class="tpl-img" src="'+TPL.img+'" style="width:100%;height:auto;display:block">';
  if(TPL.mode==='input'||TPL.mode==='spec'){
    for(var i=0;i<TPL.inputs.length;i++){ var b=TPL.inputs[i]; if(b.kind==='img') h+=tplIboxHtml(b); }
  }
  return h;
}
function tplIboxHtml(b){
  var v=(TPL.filled&&TPL.filled[b.id])||'';
  var s='style="left:'+b.x+'%;top:'+b.y+'%;width:'+b.w+'%;height:'+b.h+'%;position:absolute"';
  var del=TPL.mode==='spec'?'<div class="ib-del" onclick="event.stopPropagation();tplDelInput(\''+b.id+'\')">×</div>':'';
  var hnd=TPL.mode==='spec'?'<div class="ib-handle" data-id="'+b.id+'" onmousedown="tplResizeStart(event,this)"></div>':'';
  var inp=TPL.mode==='input'?'<input data-k="'+b.id+'" value="'+esc(v)+'" oninput="tplOnIn(this)">':'';
  return '<div class="tpl-ibox" id="ib_'+b.id+'" data-id="'+b.id+'" '+s+(TPL.mode==='spec'?' onmousedown="tplDragStart(event,this)"':'')+'>'+inp+del+hnd+'</div>';
}
function tplKeepAlign(s){
  if(s===null||s===undefined) return '';
  return String(s).replace(/ +/g, function(sp){
    var n=sp.length;
    if(n<2) return ' ';
    return '<span style="display:inline-block;width:'+(n*0.65)+'em"></span>';
  });
}
function tplOnIn(inp){ TPL.filled=TPL.filled||{}; var k=inp.getAttribute('data-k')||inp.getAttribute('data-fid'); if(k) TPL.filled[k]=inp.value; if(inp.tagName==='TEXTAREA') tplAdaptIn(inp); if(typeof jzRecAutoSave==='function') jzRecAutoSave(); }
function tplAdaptIn(inp){
  var v=inp.value||'';
  var w=inp.clientWidth-8, h=inp.clientHeight-6;
  if(w<=10||h<=10){ return; }
  var fs=14, min=6, n=v.length||1;
  while(fs>min){
    var perLine=Math.max(1,Math.floor(w/fs));
    var lines=Math.ceil(n/perLine);
    var needH=lines*fs*1.25;
    var needW=Math.min(n,perLine)*fs;
    if(needH<=h&&needW<=w+2){ break; }
    fs--;
  }
  inp.style.fontSize=fs+'px'; inp.style.lineHeight='1.25';
}
function tplTextKey(e){ if(e.key==='Enter'&&!e.shiftKey){ e.preventDefault(); var t=e.target; var v=t.value||''; var pos=t.selectionStart||v.length; t.value=v.slice(0,pos)+'\n\u3000\u3000'+v.slice(pos); t.selectionStart=t.selectionEnd=pos+3; tplOnIn(t); } }
function tplToggleCheck(key){ var v=TPL.filled[key]||''; v = v===''?'√' : (v==='√'?'×':''); TPL.filled[key]=v; tplRenderInner(); }
function tplToggleRadio(key){ var v=TPL.filled[key]||''; TPL.filled[key] = (v==='√')?'':'√'; tplRenderInner(); }
function tplToggleCheckF(id){ var v=TPL.filled[id]||''; v = v===''?'√' : (v==='√'?'×':''); TPL.filled[id]=v; tplRenderInner(); }
function tplToggleRadioF(id){ var v=TPL.filled[id]||''; TPL.filled[id] = (v==='√')?'':'√'; tplRenderInner(); }
/* 图片输入框：添加/删除/拖动/缩放 */
function tplBindDrag(){
  document.addEventListener('mousemove', tplDocMove, false);
  document.addEventListener('mouseup', tplDocUp, false);
  var st=$('tplStage'); if(st) st.addEventListener('click', tplStageClick, false);
}
function tplAddInputAt(px,py){
  var inner=$('tplInner'); var r=inner.getBoundingClientRect();
  var x=(px-r.left)/r.width*100, y=(py-r.top)/r.height*100;
  x=Math.max(0,Math.min(96,x)); y=Math.max(0,Math.min(96,y));
  tplPushUndo();
  var id='in'+Date.now();
  TPL.inputs.push({kind:'img',id:id,x:x,y:y,w:12,h:3});
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplDelInput(id){
  if(!TPL._batch) tplPushUndo();
  for(var i=0;i<TPL.inputs.length;i++) if(TPL.inputs[i].id===id){ TPL.inputs.splice(i,1); break; }
  if(TPL.filled) delete TPL.filled[id]; tplRenderInner();
}
function tplDragStart(e,el){
  var id=el.getAttribute('data-id'); if(e.target.classList.contains('ib-del')||e.target.classList.contains('ib-handle')) return;
  TPL.drag={mode:'move',id:id,startX:e.clientX,startY:e.clientY,origX:null,origY:null}; e.preventDefault();
}
function tplResizeStart(e,el){
  var id=el.getAttribute('data-id'); TPL.drag={mode:'resize',id:id,startX:e.clientX,startY:e.clientY,origX:null,origY:null,origW:null,origH:null}; e.stopPropagation(); e.preventDefault();
}
function tplDocMove(e){
  if(!TPL.drag) return; var b=tplFindInput(TPL.drag.id); if(!b) return;
  var inner=$('tplInner'); var r=inner.getBoundingClientRect();
  var dx=(e.clientX-TPL.drag.startX)/r.width*100, dy=(e.clientY-TPL.drag.startY)/r.height*100;
  if(TPL.drag.mode==='move'){
    if(TPL.drag.origX===null){ TPL.drag.origX=b.x; TPL.drag.origY=b.y; }
    b.x=Math.max(0,Math.min(96,TPL.drag.origX+dx)); b.y=Math.max(0,Math.min(96,TPL.drag.origY+dy));
  } else if(TPL.drag.mode==='resize'){
    if(TPL.drag.origW===null){ TPL.drag.origW=b.w; TPL.drag.origH=b.h; TPL.drag.origX=b.x; TPL.drag.origY=b.y; }
    b.w=Math.max(2,Math.min(96,TPL.drag.origW+dx)); b.h=Math.max(1,Math.min(96,TPL.drag.origH+dy));
  }
  var el=document.getElementById('ib_'+b.id); if(el){ el.style.left=b.x+'%'; el.style.top=b.y+'%'; el.style.width=b.w+'%'; el.style.height=b.h+'%'; }
}
function tplDocUp(ev){
  TPL.drag=null;
  if(TPL.merging){ tplMergeEnd(ev); }
  else if(TPL.mode==='text'){ tplSelEndText(ev); }
  else { tplSelEnd(ev); }
}
function tplFindInput(id){ for(var i=0;i<TPL.inputs.length;i++) if(TPL.inputs[i].id===id) return TPL.inputs[i]; return null; }
/* 点击图片添加输入框（edit 模式） */
function tplStageClick(e){
  if(TPL.type!=='img'||TPL.mode!=='spec') return;
  if(e.target.id==='tplImgEl'){ tplAddInputAt(e.clientX,e.clientY); }
}
function tplPrintFrame(html){
  var f=document.getElementById('tplPrintFrame');
  if(!f){ f=document.createElement('iframe'); f.id='tplPrintFrame'; f.style.position='absolute'; f.style.left='-9999px'; f.style.width='0'; f.style.height='0'; f.style.border='0'; document.body.appendChild(f); }
  var doc=f.contentWindow.document; doc.open();
  doc.write('<html><head><style>@page{size:A4 portrait;margin:0}html,body{margin:0;padding:0}table.tpl-print-tbl{border-collapse:collapse}.tpl-print-tbl td{border:1px solid #000;font-size:10pt;padding:2px 4px;vertical-align:middle;overflow:hidden;white-space:pre-wrap;word-break:break-all}.tpl-print-page{position:relative;margin:0;padding:0}</style></head><body>'+html+'<\/body><\/html>');
  doc.close();
  setTimeout(function(){ try{ f.contentWindow.print(); }catch(e){} }, 200);
}

function tplTableHtml(){
  var t=TPL.t; var filled=TPL.filled||{};
  var hdrRows=TPL._headerRows||[]; var ftrRows=TPL._footerRows||[];
  var hdrSet={},ftrSet={};
  hdrRows.forEach(function(r){hdrSet[r]=1;});
  ftrRows.forEach(function(r){ftrSet[r]=1;});
  var used={};
  // ===== 表头行：放在表格上方，居中，无边框 =====
  var h='';
  for(var r=0;r<t.R;r++){
    if(!hdrSet[r]) continue;
    var rowText='';
    for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++){
      if(used[r+'_'+c]) continue;
      var m=tplMergeAt(t,r,c);
      if(m&&(m.r1!==r||m.c1!==c)) continue;
      if(m){ for(var rr=m.r1;rr<=m.r2;rr++)for(var cc=m.c1;cc<=m.c2;cc++) used[rr+'_'+cc]=1; }
      var cell=(t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c])||{text:'',style:null};
      if(cell.text) rowText += (rowText?'  ':'') + cell.text;
    }
    if(rowText) h+='<div class="tpl-hdr-row" style="text-align:center;font-weight:bold;font-size:14pt;padding:6px 0 4px;line-height:1.5">'+esc(rowText)+'</div>';
  }
  // ===== 中间表格：无边框 =====
  h+='<table class="tpl-tbl" style="margin:0;border:none">'; h+='<colgroup>'; t.cols.forEach(function(w){ h+='<col style="width:'+w+'px">'; }); h+='</colgroup>';
  h+='<tbody>';
  for(var r=0;r<t.R;r++){
    if(hdrSet[r]||ftrSet[r]) continue;
    h+='<tr style="height:'+t.rows[r]+'px">';
    for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++){
      if(used[r+'_'+c]) continue;
      var m=tplMergeAt(t,r,c);
      if(m&&(m.r1!==r||m.c1!==c)) continue;
      var rs=1,cs=1;
      if(m){ rs=m.r2-m.r1+1; cs=m.c2-m.c1+1; for(var rr=m.r1;rr<=m.r2;rr++)for(var cc=m.c1;cc<=m.c2;cc++) used[rr+'_'+cc]=1; }
      var cellExtra='';
      var cell=(t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c])||{text:'',style:null}; var key=(r+1)+'_'+(c+1); var val=(filled[key]!==undefined&&filled[key]!==null)?filled[key]:cell.text;
      var isIn=tplIsInput(key); var content;
      if(TPL.mode==='input'&&cell.link){
        if(cell.link.kind==='staff'){ var f=cell.link.field||'name';
          if(f==='name'){ var curv=TPL.filled[key]||''; var lb=cell.link.multi?'点选人员':'点选一人';
            content='<span class="tpl-staff" onclick="tplStaffPick(\''+key+'\','+(cell.link.multi?1:0)+')">'+esc(curv||lb)+'</span>'; }
          else { content='<span class="tpl-slink">'+esc(TPL.filled[key]||'')+'</span>'; } }
        else { content='<span class="tpl-slink">'+esc(TPL.filled[key]||'')+'</span>'; }
      }
      else if(TPL.mode==='input'&&isIn){ var io=tplGetInput(key); var ty=io?(io.type||'text'):'text'; var fn=io?(io.font||''):'';
        if(ty==='check') content='<span class="tpl-check" data-k="'+key+'" onclick="tplToggleCheck(\''+key+'\')">'+esc(filled[key]||'')+'</span>';
        else if(ty==='radio') content='<span class="tpl-radio" data-k="'+key+'" onclick="tplToggleRadio(\''+key+'\')">'+esc(filled[key]||'')+'</span>';
        else if(ty==='date') content='<input type="date" class="tpl-in" data-k="'+key+'" value="'+esc(filled[key]||'')+'" onchange="tplOnIn(this)" style="width:96%;font-size:10pt">';
        else if(ty==='number') content='<input type="number" class="tpl-in" data-k="'+key+'" value="'+esc(filled[key]||'')+'" onchange="tplOnIn(this)" style="width:96%;font-size:10pt">';
        else content='<textarea class="tpl-in" data-k="'+key+'" style="font-family:'+(TPL.inFont||(cell.style&&cell.style.font)||fn)+';font-size:'+((TPL.inSize||(cell.style&&cell.style.sz)||10))+'pt" oninput="tplOnIn(this)" onkeydown="tplTextKey(event)">'+esc(filled[key]||'')+'</textarea>';
      }
      else if(TPL.mode==='spec'){
        var io2=tplGetInput(key); var ty2=io2?(io2.type||'text'):'text'; var tyLab=ty2==='check'?'☑ 勾选':(ty2==='radio'?'◉ 单选':(ty2==='date'?'📅 日期':(ty2==='number'?'🔢 数字':'✎ 文本')));
        if(isIn){ content='<span style="color:#1d5c99">'+tyLab+'</span>'; cellExtra=' data-k="'+key+'"'; }
        else if(cell.text===''&&!m){ content='<span style="color:#99a">＋ 标记</span>'; cellExtra=' data-k="'+key+'" data-blank="1"'; }
        else { content=tplKeepAlign(cell.text)+' <span style="color:#1d5c99">＋</span>'; cellExtra=' data-k="'+key+'"'; }
      }
      else if(TPL.mode==='text'){
        var sel=TPL.curCell===key;
        if(TPL.merging){ content=esc(cell.text||''); cellExtra=' data-k="'+key+'" onmousedown="tplSelStart(\''+key+'\',event)" onmouseover="tplSelOver(\''+key+'\')" style="cursor:crosshair'; }
        else { content=esc(cell.text); cellExtra=' data-k="'+key+'" onmousedown="tplSelStart(\''+key+'\',event)" onmouseover="tplSelOver(\''+key+'\')" ondblclick="tplInlineStart(\''+key+'\',event)" style="cursor:text'+(sel?';outline:2px solid #1d5c99':'' )+'"'; }
      }
      else { content=tplKeepAlign(val); }
      var bdStyle = (cell.style&&cell.style.nobd) ? 'border:none;' : 'border:none;';
      h+='<td style="'+bdStyle+tplStyleCss(cell.style).replace(/border[^;]*;?/g,'')+'white-space:pre-wrap;padding:2px 4px'+(isIn&&TPL.mode==='input'?';background:#fff8e1;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #ffd54f':'' )
+'"'+cellExtra+(rs>1?' rowspan="'+rs+'"':'')+(cs>1?' colspan="'+cs+'"':'')+'>'+content+'</td>';
    } h+='</tr>';
  }
  h+='</tbody></table>';
  // ===== 签名栏行：放在表格下方，无边框 =====
  for(var r=0;r<t.R;r++){
    if(!ftrSet[r]) continue;
    var cells=[];
    for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++){
      if(used[r+'_'+c]) continue;
      var m=tplMergeAt(t,r,c);
      if(m&&(m.r1!==r||m.c1!==c)) continue;
      if(m){ for(var rr=m.r1;rr<=m.r2;rr++)for(var cc=m.c1;cc<=m.c2;cc++) used[rr+'_'+cc]=1; }
      var cell=(t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c])||{text:'',style:null};
      if(cell.text) cells.push('<span style="display:inline-block;margin-right:24px;padding:4px 0">'+esc(cell.text)+'</span>');
    }
    if(cells.length) h+='<div class="tpl-ftr-row" style="padding:8px 4px;line-height:1.8">'+cells.join('')+'</div>';
  }
  return h;
}
function tplPrintTable(){ tplPrintFrame(tplPrintHtml()); }
function tplPrintHtml(){
  var t=TPL.t; var filled=TPL.filled||{};
  var hdrRows=TPL._headerRows||[]; var ftrRows=TPL._footerRows||[];
  var hdrSet={},ftrSet={};
  hdrRows.forEach(function(r){hdrSet[r]=1;});
  ftrRows.forEach(function(r){ftrSet[r]=1;});
  var used={};
  // 表头行
  var h='';
  for(var r=0;r<t.R;r++){
    if(!hdrSet[r]) continue;
    var rowText='';
    for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++){
      if(used[r+'_'+c]) continue;
      var m=tplMergeAt(t,r,c);
      if(m&&(m.r1!==r||m.c1!==c)) continue;
      if(m){ for(var rr=m.r1;rr<=m.r2;rr++)for(var cc=m.c1;cc<=m.c2;cc++) used[rr+'_'+cc]=1; }
      var cell=(t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c])||{text:'',style:null};
      if(cell.text) rowText += (rowText?'  ':'') + cell.text;
    }
    if(rowText) h+='<div style="text-align:center;font-weight:bold;font-size:15pt;padding:8px 0 4px;line-height:1.5">'+esc(rowText)+'</div>';
  }
  // 中间表格（无边框）
  h+='<table class="tpl-print-tbl" style="page-break-after:auto;border:none">'; h+='<colgroup>'; t.cols.forEach(function(w){ h+='<col style="width:'+w+'px">'; }); h+='</colgroup>';
  h+='<tbody>';
  for(var r=0;r<t.R;r++){
    if(hdrSet[r]||ftrSet[r]) continue;
    h+='<tr style="height:'+t.rows[r]+'px">';
    for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++){
      if(used[r+'_'+c]) continue;
      var m=tplMergeAt(t,r,c);
      if(m&&(m.r1!==r||m.c1!==c)) continue;
      var rs=1,cs=1;
      if(m){ rs=m.r2-m.r1+1; cs=m.c2-m.c1+1; for(var rr=m.r1;rr<=m.r2;rr++)for(var cc=m.c1;cc<=m.c2;cc++) used[rr+'_'+cc]=1; }
      var cell=(t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c])||{text:'',style:null}; var key=(r+1)+'_'+(c+1); var val=(filled[key]!==undefined&&filled[key]!==null)?filled[key]:cell.text; var disp; var io=tplGetInput(key); var ty=io?(io.type||'text'):'text'; var fn=io?(io.font||''):'';
      if(ty==='check'){ disp='<span style="display:inline-block;min-width:13px;height:13px;border:1px solid #000;text-align:center;line-height:13px;font-size:12px;vertical-align:middle">'+esc(val||'')+'</span>'; }
      else if(ty==='radio'){ disp='<span style="display:inline-block;min-width:13px;height:13px;border:1px solid #000;border-radius:50%;text-align:center;line-height:12px;font-size:12px;vertical-align:middle">'+esc(val||'')+'</span>'; }
      else if(io){ var n=(val||'').length; var cw=0; for(var cc2=c;cc2<c+cs;cc2++) cw+=(t.cols[cc2]||60);
        var fs=12; while(fs>5){ var charW=fs*1.333; var perLine=Math.max(1,Math.floor(cw/charW)); var lines=Math.ceil(n/perLine); var needH=lines*fs*1.2; var needW=Math.min(n,perLine)*charW; if(needH<=(t.rows[r]*rs-2)&&needW<=cw){ break; } fs--; }
        disp='<div style="font-family:'+(TPL.inFont||(cell.style&&cell.style.font)||fn)+',serif;font-size:'+fs+'pt;line-height:1.2;word-break:break-all">'+esc(val||'')+'</div>'; }
      else { disp=tplKeepAlign(val); }
      h+='<td style="border:none;white-space:pre-wrap;padding:2px 4px"'+(rs>1?' rowspan="'+rs+'"':'')+(cs>1?' colspan="'+cs+'"':'')+'>'+disp+'</td>';
    } h+='</tr>';
  }
  h+='</tbody></table>';
  // 签名栏行
  for(var r=0;r<t.R;r++){
    if(!ftrSet[r]) continue;
    var cells=[];
    for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++){
      if(used[r+'_'+c]) continue;
      var m=tplMergeAt(t,r,c);
      if(m&&(m.r1!==r||m.c1!==c)) continue;
      if(m){ for(var rr=m.r1;rr<=m.r2;rr++)for(var cc=m.c1;cc<=m.c2;cc++) used[rr+'_'+cc]=1; }
      var cell=(t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c])||{text:'',style:null};
      if(cell.text) cells.push('<span style="display:inline-block;margin-right:24px;padding:6px 0">'+esc(cell.text)+'</span>');
    }
    if(cells.length) h+='<div style="padding:10px 4px;line-height:1.8">'+cells.join('')+'</div>';
  }
  return '<div style="position:relative">'+h+tplFreePrintCanvasHtml(filled)+'</div>';
}
function tplPrintImg(){ tplPrintFrame(tplPrintImgHtml()); }
function tplPrintImgHtml(){
  var filled=TPL.filled||{};
  var pw=210, ph=297; // mm A4
  var h='<div class="tpl-print-page" style="width:'+pw+'mm;min-height:'+ph+'mm">'
    +'<img src="'+TPL.img+'" style="width:100%;display:block">';
  for(var i=0;i<TPL.inputs.length;i++){ var b=TPL.inputs[i]; if(b.kind!=='img') continue;
    var v=filled[b.id]||'';
    h+='<div style="position:absolute;left:'+b.x+'%;top:'+b.y+'%;width:'+b.w+'%;height:'+b.h+'%;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10pt;line-height:1;border:1px dashed #999">'+esc(v)+'</div>';
  }
  h+='</div>';
  return h;
}

/* ---- 区域选择（表格 edit 拖选空白格） ---- */
function tplKeyRC(key){ var p=key.split('_'); return {r:parseInt(p[0])-1,c:parseInt(p[1])-1}; }
function tplSelStart(key,ev){ if(ev&&ev.target&&ev.target.isContentEditable) return; if(ev)ev.preventDefault(); TPL.dragSel=true; TPL.sel={start:key,over:key}; tplSelMark(); }
function tplSelOver(key,ev){ if(TPL.dragSel&&TPL.sel&&TPL.sel.start){ TPL.sel.over=key; tplSelMark(); } }
function tplSelEnd(ev){
  TPL.dragSel=false;
  if(!TPL.sel||!TPL.sel.start) return;
  var a=tplKeyRC(TPL.sel.start), b=tplKeyRC(TPL.sel.over);
  var r1=Math.min(a.r,b.r),r2=Math.max(a.r,b.r),c1=Math.min(a.c,b.c),c2=Math.max(a.c,b.c);
  if(r1===r2&&c1===c2){ tplToggleCellByKey(TPL.sel.start); }
  else {
    var t=TPL.t;
    for(var r=r1;r<=r2;r++)for(var c=c1;c<=c2;c++){
      var cell=(t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c])||{text:''};
      if(cell.text!=='') continue; if(tplMergeAt(t,r,c)) continue;
      var key=(r+1)+'_'+(c+1);
      if(!tplIsInput(key)) TPL.inputs.push({kind:'cell',key:key,type:tplCurrentType(),font:tplCurrentFont()});
    }
  }
  TPL.sel=null; tplRenderInner();
}


function tplDragStartCanvas(e){
  if(TPL.mode!=='spec'||TPL.type!=='table') return;
  if(e&&e.preventDefault) e.preventDefault();
  var x=e.clientX||0, y=e.clientY||0;
  TPL.drag={x1:x,y1:y,x2:x,y2:y};
  var box=$('tplDragBox'); if(!box){ box=document.createElement('div'); box.id='tplDragBox'; document.body.appendChild(box); }
  box.style.display='block'; tplDragPaint();
}
function tplDragStart(key,e){
  if(e) e.preventDefault();
  var x=e?e.clientX:0, y=e?e.clientY:0;
  TPL.drag={x1:x,y1:y,x2:x,y2:y};
  var box=$('tplDragBox'); if(!box){ box=document.createElement('div'); box.id='tplDragBox'; document.body.appendChild(box); }
  box.style.display='block';
  tplDragPaint();
}
function tplDragMove(e){
  var d=TPL.drag; if(!d) return;
  if(e.clientX!==undefined&&e.clientY!==undefined){ d.x2=e.clientX; d.y2=e.clientY; tplDragPaint(); }
}
function tplDragPaint(){
  var d=TPL.drag; var box=$('tplDragBox');
  if(!d||!box){ if(box) box.style.display='none'; return; }
  var x=Math.min(d.x1,d.x2),y=Math.min(d.y1,d.y2),w=Math.abs(d.x2-d.x1),h=Math.abs(d.y2-d.y1);
  box.style.left=x+'px'; box.style.top=y+'px'; box.style.width=w+'px'; box.style.height=h+'px';
}
function tplDragEnd(){
  var d=TPL.drag; TPL.drag=null; var box=$('tplDragBox'); if(box) box.style.display='none';
  if(!d) return;
  var x=Math.min(d.x1,d.x2),y=Math.min(d.y1,d.y2),w=Math.abs(d.x2-d.x1),h=Math.abs(d.y2-d.y1);
  if(w<3&&h<3){ tplRenderInner(); return; }
  var tds=document.querySelectorAll('#tplInner td[data-k]');
  var hits=[];
  for(var i=0;i<tds.length;i++){ var td=tds[i]; var k=td.getAttribute('data-k'); if(!k) continue;
    var rc=td.getBoundingClientRect();
    if(rc.right>x&&rc.left<x+w&&rc.bottom>y&&rc.top<y+h){ hits.push(k); }
  }
  TPL._batch=1; tplPushUndo();
  if(hits.length>=2){ for(var j=0;j<hits.length;j++){ if(!tplGetInput(hits[j])) TPL.inputs.push({kind:'cell',key:hits[j],type:tplCurrentType(),font:tplCurrentFont()}); } }
  else { var inner=document.getElementById('tplInner').getBoundingClientRect();
    if(inner.width>0&&inner.height>0){
      var xp=(x-inner.left)/inner.width*100, yp=(y-inner.top)/inner.height*100, wp=w/inner.width*100, hp=h/inner.height*100;
      TPL.inputs.push({kind:'free',id:'f'+(Date.now()+''+Math.floor(Math.random()*1000)),type:tplCurrentType(),font:tplCurrentFont(),x:xp,y:yp,w:wp,h:hp});
    }
  }
  TPL._batch=0;
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplFreeCanvasHtml(mode, filled){
  var h='';
  for(var i=0;i<TPL.inputs.length;i++){ var b=TPL.inputs[i]; if(b.kind!=='free') continue;
    var v=(filled&&filled[b.id])||''; var ty=b.type||'text';
    var pos='position:absolute;left:'+b.x+'%;top:'+b.y+'%;width:'+b.w+'%;height:'+b.h+'%;';
    if(mode==='spec'){
      h+='<span style="'+pos+'border:1px dashed #1d5c99;box-sizing:border-box"></span>';
    }
    else if(mode==='input'){
      if(ty==='check') h+='<span class="tpl-check" data-fid="'+b.id+'" style="'+pos+'" onclick="tplToggleCheckF(\''+b.id+'\')">'+esc(v)+'</span>';
      else if(ty==='radio') h+='<span class="tpl-radio" data-fid="'+b.id+'" style="'+pos+'" onclick="tplToggleRadioF(\''+b.id+'\')">'+esc(v)+'</span>';
      else if(ty==='date') h+='<input type="date" data-fid="'+b.id+'" value="'+esc(v)+'" onchange="tplOnIn(this)" style="'+pos+'font-size:10pt">';
      else if(ty==='number') h+='<input type="number" data-fid="'+b.id+'" value="'+esc(v)+'" onchange="tplOnIn(this)" style="'+pos+'font-size:10pt">';
      else h+='<textarea class="tpl-in" data-fid="'+b.id+'" style="'+pos+'font-family:'+(b.font||'')+'" oninput="tplOnIn(this)" onkeydown="tplTextKey(event)">'+esc(v)+'</textarea>';
    }
  }
  return h;
}
function tplFreePrintCanvasHtml(filled){
  var h='';
  for(var i=0;i<TPL.inputs.length;i++){ var b=TPL.inputs[i]; if(b.kind!=='free') continue;
    var v=(filled&&filled[b.id])||''; var ty=b.type||'text';
    var pos='position:absolute;left:'+b.x+'%;top:'+b.y+'%;width:'+b.w+'%;height:'+b.h+'%;';
    if(ty==='text') h+='<div style="'+pos+'font-size:10pt;line-height:1">'+esc(v)+'</div>';
    else h+='<div style="'+pos+'border:1px solid #000;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;font-size:10pt">'+esc(v)+'</div>';
  }
  return h;
}
function tplGetCell(r,c){ var g=TPL.t.grid; return (g&&g[r]&&g[r][c])||null; }


function tplPushUndo(){
  TPL.undo=TPL.undo||[];
  TPL.undo.push({inputs:JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(TPL.inputs||[])),
    grid:(function(){if(TPL.type!=='table'||!TPL.t.R) return null;var g=[];for(var r=0;r<TPL.t.R;r++){g[r]=[];for(var c=0;c<TPL.t.C;c++){var cl=(TPL.t.grid[r]&&TPL.t.grid[r][c])||{text:'',style:null};g[r][c]={text:cl.text,style:cl.style?{sz:cl.style.sz,align:cl.style.align,bold:cl.style.bold}:null};}}return g;})() ,
    scale:TPL.scale,dx:TPL.dx,dy:TPL.dy,mode:TPL.mode});
  if(TPL.undo.length>50) TPL.undo.shift();
  TPL.dirty=true; tplAutoSave();
  tplSyncUndoBtn();
}
function tplSyncUndoBtn(){ var b=$('tplUndoBtn'); if(b) b.disabled=!(TPL.undo&&TPL.undo.length); }
function tplUndo(){
  if(!TPL.undo||!TPL.undo.length) return;
  var s=TPL.undo.pop();
  TPL.inputs=s.inputs||[];
  if(s.grid&&TPL.t) TPL.t.grid=s.grid;
  if(s.scale!=null){ TPL.scale=s.scale; TPL.dx=s.dx||0; TPL.dy=s.dy||0; var zz=$('tplZoom'); if(zz) zz.value=s.scale; var zv=$('tplZoomVal'); if(zv) zv.textContent=s.scale+'%'; }
  if(s.mode){ TPL.mode=s.mode; TPL.addMode=(s.mode==='spec'); if(s.mode!=='spec') TPL.selMode=false; }
  tplApplyView(); tplSyncModeBtns(); tplSyncUndoBtn(); tplRenderInner();
}

function tplSetMode(m){
  TPL.mode=m; TPL.addMode=(m==='spec'); if(m!=='spec') TPL.selMode=false;
  try{ tplCloseLinkPanel(); tplStaffClose(); tplStationClose(); tplCloseFree(); }catch(e){}
  tplSyncModeBtns(); tplRenderInner();
}
function tplSelMode(){
  TPL.selMode=!TPL.selMode;
  var b=$('tplSelBtn'); if(b) b.className='btn'+(TPL.selMode?' act':'');
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplSyncModeBtns(){
  var m=TPL.mode;
  var mk=$('tplModeBtn'); if(mk){ mk.className='btn'+(m==='spec'?' act':''); }
  var tk=$('tplTextBtn'); if(tk){ tk.className='btn'+(m==='text'?' act':''); }
  var ik=$('tplInBtn'); if(ik){ ik.className='btn'+(m==='input'?' act':''); }
  var pk=$('tplPrintBtn'); if(pk){ pk.className='btn'+(m==='print'?' act':''); }
  var sw=$('tplStyleWrap'); if(sw){ sw.style.display=(m==='text'?'':'none'); }
  var tw=$('tplTypeWrap'),fw=$('tplFontWrap'); if(tw){ tw.style.display=(m==='spec'?'':'none'); } if(fw){ fw.style.display=(m==='text'||m==='input'||m==='spec'?'':'none'); }
  var iw=$('tplInSizeWrap'); if(iw){ iw.style.display=(m==='input'?'':'none'); }
  var sb=$('tplSelBtn'); if(sb){ sb.style.display=(m==='spec'?'':'none'); sb.className='btn'+(m==='spec'&&TPL.selMode?' act':''); }
  var inner=$('tplInner'); if(inner){ if(m==='spec') inner.classList.add('tpl-spec'); else inner.classList.remove('tpl-spec'); }
  tplStepHL();
}
function tplAddCell(key){ tplToggleCellByKey(key); }
function tplCurRC(){ var k=TPL.curCell||(TPL.sel&&TPL.sel.start); if(!k) return null; return tplKeyRC(k); }
function tplAddRow(){
  var p=tplCurRC(); var t=TPL.t; tplPushUndo();
  var r=(p?p.r:Math.max(0,t.R-1));
  var nr=[]; for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++) nr[c]={text:'',style:null};
  t.grid.splice(r+1,0,nr);
  t.rows.splice(r+1,0,(t.rows[r]||28));
  t.R++;
  for(var i=0;i<t.merges.length;i++){ var m=t.merges[i];
    if(m.r1>r){ m.r1++; m.r2++; } else if(m.r2>=r){ m.r2++; }
  }
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplDelRow(){
  var p=tplCurRC(); if(!p){ alert('请先点选要删除的行'); return; }
  var t=TPL.t; if(t.R<=1){ alert('不能删除最后一行'); return; } tplPushUndo();
  var r=p.r; t.grid.splice(r,1); t.rows.splice(r,1); t.R--;
  for(var i=t.merges.length-1;i>=0;i--){ var m=t.merges[i];
    if(m.r1<=r&&m.r2>=r){ t.merges.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if(m.r1>r){ m.r1--; m.r2--; }
  }
  TPL.curCell=null; tplRenderInner();
}
function tplAddCol(){
  var p=tplCurRC(); var t=TPL.t; tplPushUndo();
  var c=(p?p.c:Math.max(0,t.C-1));
  for(var i=0;i<t.grid.length;i++){ t.grid[i].splice(c+1,0,{text:'',style:null}); }
  t.cols.splice(c+1,0,(t.cols[c]||60));
  t.C++;
  for(var i=0;i<t.merges.length;i++){ var m=t.merges[i];
    if(m.c1>c){ m.c1++; m.c2++; } else if(m.c2>=c){ m.c2++; }
  }
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplDelCol(){
  var p=tplCurRC(); if(!p){ alert('请先点选要删除的列'); return; }
  var t=TPL.t; if(t.C<=1){ alert('不能删除最后一列'); return; } tplPushUndo();
  var c=p.c;
  for(var i=0;i<t.grid.length;i++){ t.grid[i].splice(c,1); }
  t.cols.splice(c,1); t.C--;
  for(var i=t.merges.length-1;i>=0;i--){ var m=t.merges[i];
    if(m.c1<=c&&m.c2>=c){ t.merges.splice(i,1); continue; }
    if(m.c1>c){ m.c1--; m.c2--; }
  }
  TPL.curCell=null; tplRenderInner();
}
var TPL_LINK_FIELDS=[{k:'name',l:'站名'},{k:'code',l:'编码'},{k:'river',l:'河名'},{k:'address',l:'地址'},{k:'category',l:'类别'},{k:'projects',l:'测验项目'},{k:'benchmarks',l:'测验设备'}];
function tplStations(){
  var arr=[]; var seen={};
  var add=function(n){ if(n&&!seen[n]){ seen[n]=1; arr.push({name:n}); } };
  try{
    if(typeof HYDRO_HTML==='string'&&HYDRO_HTML){
      var m1=HYDRO_HTML.match(/const STATION_TOP16=\[([\s\S]*?)\];/);
      if(m1){ try{ var a=(0,eval)('['+m1[1]+']'); a.forEach(add); }catch(e){} }
      var m2=HYDRO_HTML.match(/const STATION_CATS=\{([\s\S]*?)\};\n/);
      if(m2){ try{ var o=(0,eval)('({'+m2[1]+'})'); Object.keys(o).forEach(function(k){ (o[k]||[]).forEach(add); }); }catch(e){} }
    }
  }catch(e){}
  var srcs=[];
  try{ if(window.App&&Array.isArray(App.stations)) srcs.push(App.stations); }catch(e){}
  try{ if(window.db&&Array.isArray(db.stations)) srcs.push(db.stations); }catch(e){}
  try{ if(window.HM_BUILTIN_STATIONS&&Array.isArray(HM_BUILTIN_STATIONS)) srcs.push(HM_BUILTIN_STATIONS); }catch(e){}
  try{ if(typeof stations!=='undefined'&&Array.isArray(stations)) srcs.push(stations); }catch(e){}
  srcs.forEach(function(list){ (list||[]).forEach(function(s){
    if(typeof s==='string'){ add(s); }
    else if(s&&s.name){ if(!seen[s.name]){ seen[s.name]=1; arr.push(s); } }
  }); });
  return arr;
}
function tplStaff(){
  var arr=[]; var seen={};
  var add=function(x){ if(x&&x.name&&x.status!=='left'&&x.status!=='disabled'&&!seen[x.name]){ seen[x.name]=1; arr.push(x); } };
  try{ if(window.db&&Array.isArray(db.people)) db.people.forEach(add); }catch(e){}
  if(!arr.length){ try{ if(window.sys&&Array.isArray(sys.users)) sys.users.forEach(function(x){ if(x&&x.name&&x.role!=='super'&&x.status!=='left'&&x.status!=='disabled'&&!seen[x.name]&&!/总管理|局$|管理$/.test(x.name)){ seen[x.name]=1; arr.push({name:x.name,phone:x.phone||'',post:x.title||x.post||''}); } }); }catch(e){} }
  return arr;
}
function tplOpenLinkPanel(){
  tplCloseLinkPanel();
  var b=$('tplLinkBtn'); if(!b) return;
  var r=b.getBoundingClientRect();
  var d=document.createElement('div'); d.id='tplLinkPanel'; d.className='tpl-linkpanel';
  d.style.left=(r.left+window.scrollX)+'px'; d.style.top=(r.bottom+4+window.scrollY)+'px';
  var k=TPL.curCell;
  var h='<div style="font-weight:700;margin-bottom:6px">关联到当前格'+(k?(' '+k):'')+'</div>';
  h+='<div class="mut" style="margin:2px 0">· 站点字段（选站后自动填入）</div>';
  TPL_LINK_FIELDS.forEach(function(f,i){ h+='<button class="btn gray" style="margin:2px" onclick="tplSetLinkField('+i+')">'+f.l+'</button>'; });
  h+='<div class="mut" style="margin:6px 0 2px">· 人员字段（选人后联动填入）</div>';
  [['name','姓名'],['phone','电话'],['post','职务']].forEach(function(pf,i){ h+='<button class="btn gray" style="margin:2px" onclick="tplSetLinkStaffField('+i+')">人员·'+pf[1]+'</button>'; });
  h+='<div class="mut" style="margin:6px 0 2px">· 选人填入本人名字</div>';
  h+='<button class="btn gray" style="margin:2px" onclick="tplSetLinkStaff(0)">人员·单选</button>';
  h+='<button class="btn gray" style="margin:2px" onclick="tplSetLinkStaff(1)">人员·多选</button>';
  h+='<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn" onclick="tplSetLinkClear()">清除关联</button></div>';
  d.innerHTML=h; document.body.appendChild(d);
}
function tplCloseLinkPanel(){ var d=$('tplLinkPanel'); if(d){ d.parentNode.removeChild(d); } }
function tplSetLinkField(i){ var f=TPL_LINK_FIELDS[i]; if(f) tplSetLink({kind:'station',field:f.k}); }
function tplSetLinkStaff(m){ tplSetLink({kind:'staff',field:'name',multi:!!m}); }
function tplSetLinkStaffField(i){ var f=[['name','姓名'],['phone','电话'],['post','职务']][i]; if(f) tplSetLink({kind:'staff',field:f[0]}); }
function tplSetLinkClear(){ tplSetLink(null); }
function tplSetLink(link){
  var k=TPL.curCell||(TPL.sel?TPL.sel.start:null); if(!k){ tplCloseLinkPanel(); alert('请先在编辑模板下点选一个格子'); return; }
  var p=tplKeyRC(k); var t=TPL.t; if(!t.grid[p.r]||!t.grid[p.r][p.c]) return;
  tplPushUndo(); t.grid[p.r][p.c].link=link;
  tplCloseLinkPanel(); tplRenderInner();
  if(link&&link.kind==='station') tplStationOpen();
}
function tplStationBarHtml(){
  var sel=TPL.station||'';
  var h='<div class="tpl-stbar"><span>选站：</span><button class="btn" onclick="tplStationOpen()">'+(sel||'— 选站 —')+'</button>'+(sel?' <button class="btn gray" onclick="tplStationPick(\'\')">清除</button>':'')+'</div>';
  return h;
}
function tplStationOpen(){
  tplStationClose();
  var sts=tplStations(); var sel=TPL.station||'';
  var h='<div class="tpl-mask" onclick="tplStationClose()"></div><div class="tpl-panel"><h4 style="margin:0 0 6px">选站</h4><div style="max-height:320px;overflow:auto;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px">';
  if(!sts.length) h+='<div class="mut">暂无站点</div>';
  sts.forEach(function(s){ var nm=s.name||''; h+='<div class="tpl-station-it'+(nm===sel?' on':'')+'" style="flex:0 0 140px;box-sizing:border-box" onclick="tplStationChose(\''+esc(nm)+'\')">'+esc(nm)+'</div>'; });
  h+='</div><div style="text-align:right;margin-top:8px"><button class="btn gray" onclick="tplStationClose()">关闭</button></div></div>';
  var d=document.createElement('div'); d.id='tplStationMask'; d.innerHTML=h; document.body.appendChild(d);
}
function tplStationChose(name){ tplStationClose(); tplStationPick(name); }
function tplStationClose(){ var d=$('tplStationMask'); if(d){ d.parentNode.removeChild(d); } }
function tplStationPick(name){
  TPL.station=name; var st=null;
  tplStations().forEach(function(s){ if(s.name===name) st=s; });
  var key=TPL.curCell||(TPL.sel?TPL.sel.start:null); if(!key) return;
  var rc=key.split('_'); var r=+rc[0]-1,c=+rc[1]-1;
  var cell=TPL.t.grid[r]&&TPL.t.grid[r][c];
  if(!cell||!cell.link||cell.link.kind!=='station') return;
  TPL.filled=TPL.filled||{};
  var v=st?st[cell.link.field]:'';
  if(Array.isArray(v)) v=v.join('、');
  TPL.filled[key]=(v!==undefined&&v!==null)?String(v):'';
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplStaffPick(key,multi){
  tplStaffClose();
  var people=tplStaff(); var cur=(TPL.filled[key]||'');
  var chosen={}; (cur||'').split(/[、,，]/).forEach(function(n){ n=n.trim(); if(n) chosen[n]=1; });
  var h='<div class="tpl-mask" onclick="tplStaffClose()"></div><div class="tpl-panel"><h4 style="margin:0 0 6px">'+(multi?'选择人员（可多选）':'选择一人')+'</h4><div style="max-height:260px;overflow:auto">';
  if(!people.length) h+='<div class="mut">暂无在职人员</div>';
  people.forEach(function(x){ var n=(typeof x==='string')?x:(x.name||''); if(!n) return; h+='<label class="tpl-staff-it'+(chosen[n]?' on':'')+'" data-n="'+n+'" onclick="tplStaffTog(this,event)">'+esc(n)+'</label>'; });
  h+='</div><div style="text-align:right;margin-top:8px"><button class="btn gray" onclick="tplStaffClose()">取消</button> <button class="btn" onclick="tplStaffConfirm(\''+key+'\','+(multi?1:0)+')">确定</button></div></div>';
  var d=document.createElement('div'); d.id='tplStaffMask'; d.innerHTML=h; document.body.appendChild(d);
}
function tplStaffTog(el,ev){ if(ev)ev.stopPropagation(); el.classList.toggle('on'); }
function tplStaffConfirm(key,multi){
  var names=[]; var items=document.querySelectorAll('#tplStaffMask .tpl-staff-it.on');
  for(var i=0;i<items.length;i++) names.push(items[i].getAttribute('data-n'));
  if(!multi&&names.length>1) names=[names[0]];
  TPL.filled=TPL.filled||{}; TPL.filled[key]=names.join('、');
  var p=null; var people=tplStaff();
  for(var pi=0;pi<people.length;pi++){ if(people[pi].name===names[0]){ p=people[pi]; break; } }
  var t=TPL.t;
  for(var r=0;r<t.R;r++)for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++){
    var cl=t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c]; if(!cl||!cl.link||cl.link.kind!=='staff'||!cl.link.field||cl.link.field==='name') continue;
    var fkey=(r+1)+'_'+(c+1); TPL.filled[fkey]=(p&&p[cl.link.field]!==undefined&&p[cl.link.field]!==null)?String(p[cl.link.field]):'';
  }
  tplStaffClose(); tplRenderInner();
}
function tplStaffClose(){ var d=$('tplStaffMask'); if(d){ d.parentNode.removeChild(d); } }
function tplInlineStart(key,ev){
  if(TPL.dragSel) return;
  TPL.sel=null; tplSelMarkClear();
  tplTextExitEditing();
  var td=document.querySelector('td[data-k="'+key+'"]');
  if(!td) return;
  td.contentEditable='true'; td.style.outline='2px solid #1565C0'; td.focus();
  TPL.curCell=key;
  if(ev&&ev.clientX!==undefined){ try{ tplPlaceCaret(td, ev.clientX, ev.clientY); }catch(e){} }
}
function tplSelEndText(ev){
  TPL.dragSel=false;
  if(!TPL.sel||!TPL.sel.start){ TPL.sel=null; return; }
  TPL.sel={start:TPL.sel.start, over:TPL.sel.over||TPL.sel.start};
  tplSelMark();
}
function tplSelModeToggle(){
  TPL.selectMode=!TPL.selectMode;
  if(TPL.selectMode){ TPL.sel=null; tplSelMarkClear(); TPL.curCell=null; tplTextExitEditing(); }
  else { TPL.sel=null; tplSelMarkClear(); }
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplFontChange(){
  var s=$('tplFont'); var v=s?s.value:'';
  if(TPL.mode==='input'){ TPL.inFont=v; tplRenderInner(); return; }
  if(TPL.mode==='text'){ tplStyleFont(v); }
}
function tplStyleFont(f){
  var k=TPL.curCell||(TPL.sel?TPL.sel.start:null); if(!k) return;
  var p=tplKeyRC(k); var t=TPL.t; if(!t.grid[p.r]||!t.grid[p.r][p.c]) return;
  tplPushUndo(); var cell=t.grid[p.r][p.c]; if(!cell.style) cell.style={}; cell.style.font=f; tplRenderInner();
}
function tplInSize(d){ TPL.inSize=((TPL.inSize||10)+d*2); if(TPL.inSize<6)TPL.inSize=6; if(TPL.inSize>48)TPL.inSize=48; tplRenderInner(); }
function tplCloseFree(){ var d=$('tplInnerMask'); if(d){ d.parentNode.removeChild(d); } }
function tplTextStart(key,ev){
  if(ev) ev.preventDefault();
  TPL.dragSel=true;
  tplTextExitEditing();
  TPL.sel={start:key,over:key}; tplSelMark();
}
function tplTextExitEditing(){
  var tds=document.querySelectorAll('#tplInner .tpl-tbl td[contenteditable="true"]');
  for(var i=0;i<tds.length;i++){ var td=tds[i]; var k=td.getAttribute('data-k'); if(!k) continue;
    var text=(td.innerText==null)?'':td.innerText; var p=tplKeyRC(k); var t=TPL.t;
    if(t.grid[p.r]&&t.grid[p.r][p.c]) t.grid[p.r][p.c].text=text;
    td.contentEditable='false'; td.style.outline='';
  }
}
function tplPlaceCaret(td,x,y){
  td.contentEditable='true'; td.style.outline='2px solid #1565C0'; td.focus();
  var r=null;
  try{ if(document.caretRangeFromPoint) r=document.caretRangeFromPoint(x,y); }catch(e){}
  if(r){ try{ var sel=window.getSelection(); sel.removeAllRanges(); sel.addRange(r); }catch(e){} }
}
function tplTextEnd(ev){
  TPL.dragSel=false;
  if(!TPL.sel||!TPL.sel.start) return;
  var start=TPL.sel.start, over=TPL.sel.over||start;
  if(start===over){
    var td=document.querySelector('td[data-k="'+start+'"]');
    TPL.curCell=start; TPL.sel=null; tplSelMarkClear();
    if(td){
      var t=TPL.t; var p=tplKeyRC(start); var cell=(t.grid[p.r]&&t.grid[p.r][p.c]);
      td.textContent=(cell&&cell.text)||'';
      tplInlineBindSave(td,start);
      if(ev&&ev.clientX!==undefined) tplPlaceCaret(td, ev.clientX, ev.clientY);
    }
  } else {
    var tds=document.querySelectorAll('#tplInner .tpl-tbl td');
    for(var i=0;i<tds.length;i++){ var x=tds[i]; if(x.getAttribute('data-k')) x.contentEditable='false'; }
    TPL.curCell=null;
  }
}
function tplInlineBindSave(td,key){
  var done=function(){
    td.contentEditable='false'; td.style.outline='';
    var text=(td.innerText==null)?'':td.innerText.replace(/\u0000/g,''); tplPushUndo();
    var p=tplKeyRC(key); var t=TPL.t;
    if(t.grid[p.r]&&t.grid[p.r][p.c]) t.grid[p.r][p.c].text=text;
    tplRenderInner();
  };
  td.addEventListener('blur', done, {once:true});
  td.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){ if(ev.key==='Enter'){ ev.preventDefault(); td.blur(); } });
}
function tplInlineEdit(key, td){
  TPL.curCell=key;
  var t=TPL.t; var p=tplKeyRC(key); var cell=(t.grid[p.r]&&t.grid[p.r][p.c]);
  td.textContent=(cell&&cell.text)||''; td.contentEditable='true';
  td.style.outline='2px solid #1565C0'; td.focus();
  var done=function(){
    td.contentEditable='false'; td.style.outline=''; td.classList.remove('tpl-editing');
    var text=(td.innerText||'').trim(); tplPushUndo();
    if(t.grid[p.r]&&t.grid[p.r][p.c]) t.grid[p.r][p.c].text=text;
    tplRenderInner();
  };
  td.addEventListener('blur', done, {once:true});
  td.addEventListener('keydown', function(ev){ if(ev.key==='Enter'){ ev.preventDefault(); td.blur(); } });
}
function tplCurCell(key){ TPL.curCell=key; tplRenderInner(); }
function tplEditCellText(key){
  var t=TPL.t; var p=tplKeyRC(key); var cell=t.grid[p.r][p.c];
  var n=prompt('修改此格文字：', cell?cell.text:'');
  if(n!==null){ tplPushUndo(); if(cell){ cell.text=n; } tplRenderInner(); }
}
function tplStyleSize(d){ var k=TPL.curCell; if(!k) return; tplPushUndo(); var t=TPL.t; var p=tplKeyRC(k); var cell=t.grid[p.r][p.c]; if(!cell.style) cell.style={}; cell.style.sz=(cell.style.sz||10)+d*2; if(cell.style.sz<6)cell.style.sz=6; if(cell.style.sz>30)cell.style.sz=30; tplRenderInner(); }
function tplMergeToggle(){
  if(TPL.sel&&TPL.sel.start&&(TPL.sel.over||TPL.sel.start)!==TPL.sel.start){
    TPL.merging=true; tplMergeEnd(); return;
  }
  TPL.merging=!TPL.merging; if(!TPL.merging) TPL.sel=null;
  if(TPL.merging){ document.addEventListener('mouseup',tplMergeEnd); }
  else { document.removeEventListener('mouseup',tplMergeEnd); }
  tplMergeSyncBtn(); tplRenderInner();
}
function tplMergeSyncBtn(){ var b=$('tplMergeBtn'); if(b) b.className='btn'+(TPL.merging?' act':''); }
function tplMergeEnd(ev){
  TPL.dragSel=false;
  if(!TPL.merging||!TPL.sel||!TPL.sel.start){ TPL.sel=null; return; }
  var a=tplKeyRC(TPL.sel.start), b=tplKeyRC(TPL.sel.over||TPL.sel.start);
  var r0=Math.min(a.r,b.r),r1=Math.max(a.r,b.r),c0=Math.min(a.c,b.c),c1=Math.max(a.c,b.c);
  var t=TPL.t; tplPushUndo();
  for(var i=t.merges.length-1;i>=0;i--){ var m=t.merges[i]; if(m.r1<=r1&&m.r2>=r0&&m.c1<=c1&&m.c2>=c0) t.merges.splice(i,1); }
  var nm={r1:r0,c1:c0,r2:r1,c2:c1,saved:[]};
  for(var r=r0;r<=r1;r++)for(var c=c0;c<=c1;c++){ if(r===r0&&c===c0) continue; if(t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c]){ nm.saved.push([r,c,t.grid[r][c].text||'']); t.grid[r][c]={text:'',style:null}; } else if(t.grid[r]){ t.grid[r][c]={text:'',style:null}; } }
  t.merges.push(nm);
  TPL.sel=null; TPL.merging=false; tplMergeSyncBtn(); document.removeEventListener('mouseup',tplMergeEnd); tplRenderInner();
}
function tplSplitCell(){
  var k=TPL.curCell; if(!k){ alert('请先在编辑模板下点选一个要拆分的格子'); return; }
  var p=tplKeyRC(k); var t=TPL.t;
  if(!t.grid[p.r]||!t.grid[p.r][p.c]) return;
  var mg=tplMergeAt(t,p.r,p.c);
  if(mg){
    tplPushUndo();
    for(var mi=t.merges.length-1;mi>=0;mi--){ var mo=t.merges[mi]; if(mo.r1===mg.r1&&mo.c1===mg.c1&&mo.r2===mg.r2&&mo.c2===mg.c2){
      if(mo.saved){ for(var si=0;si<mo.saved.length;si++){ var sv=mo.saved[si]; if(t.grid[sv[0]]&&t.grid[sv[0]][sv[1]]) t.grid[sv[0]][sv[1]].text=sv[2]; } }
      t.merges.splice(mi,1);
    } }
    tplRenderInner(); return;
  }
  tplPushUndo();
  var r=p.r,c=p.c;
  var text=t.grid[r][c].text, style=t.grid[r][c].style;
  var colw=t.cols[c]||80, rowh=t.rows[r]||24;
  var half=Math.round(colw/2); t.cols[c]=Math.max(10,half); t.cols.splice(c+1,0,Math.max(10,colw-half));
  var halfr=Math.round(rowh/2); t.rows[r]=Math.max(10,halfr); t.rows.splice(r+1,0,Math.max(10,rowh-halfr));
  t.C++; t.R++;
  for(var i=0;i<t.grid.length;i++){
    var row=t.grid[i]||[]; var nr=[];
    for(var cc=0;cc<=c;cc++) nr.push(row[cc]||{text:'',style:null});
    nr.push({text:'',style:null});
    for(var cc2=c+1;cc2<row.length;cc2++) nr.push(row[cc2]||{text:'',style:null});
    t.grid[i]=nr;
  }
  var nr2=[]; for(var cc=0;cc<t.C;cc++) nr2[cc]={text:'',style:null};
  t.grid.splice(r+1,0,nr2);
  t.grid[r][c].text=text; t.grid[r][c].style=style;
  for(var m=0;m<t.merges.length;m++){ var mm=t.merges[m];
    if(mm.r1>r){ mm.r1++; mm.r2++; }
    if(mm.c1>c){ mm.c1++; mm.c2++; }
  }
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplStyleAlign(a){
  tplPushUndo();
  if(TPL.sel&&TPL.sel.start&&(TPL.sel.over||TPL.sel.start)!==TPL.sel.start){
    var s=TPL.sel; var p1=tplKeyRC(s.start),p2=tplKeyRC(s.over||s.start);
    var r1=Math.min(p1.r,p2.r),r2=Math.max(p1.r,p2.r),c1=Math.min(p1.c,p2.c),c2=Math.max(p1.c,p2.c);
    for(var r=r1;r<=r2;r++)for(var c=c1;c<=c2;c++){ var cell=(TPL.t.grid[r]&&TPL.t.grid[r][c]); if(cell){ cell.style=cell.style||{}; cell.style.align=a; } }
  } else {
    var k=TPL.curCell; if(!k) return;
    var p=tplKeyRC(k); var cell=(TPL.t.grid[p.r]&&TPL.t.grid[p.r][p.c]); if(cell){ cell.style=cell.style||{}; cell.style.align=a; }
  }
  tplRenderInner();
}
function tplStyleBold(){ var k=TPL.curCell; if(!k) return; tplPushUndo(); var t=TPL.t; var p=tplKeyRC(k); var cell=t.grid[p.r][p.c]; if(!cell.style) cell.style={}; cell.style.bold=!cell.style.bold; tplRenderInner(); }

function tplToggleCellByKey(key){
  if(!TPL._batch) tplPushUndo();
  var found=-1; for(var i=0;i<TPL.inputs.length;i++) if(TPL.inputs[i].kind==='cell'&&TPL.inputs[i].key===key){found=i;break;}
  if(found>=0){ TPL.inputs.splice(found,1); }
  else { TPL.inputs.push({kind:'cell',key:key,type:tplCurrentType(),font:tplCurrentFont()}); }
  tplRenderInner();
}

function tplCurrentType(){ var s=$('tplType'); return s?s.value:'text'; }

function tplSelMark(){
  if(!TPL.sel||!TPL.sel.start) return;
  var a=tplKeyRC(TPL.sel.start), b=tplKeyRC(TPL.sel.over);
  var r1=Math.min(a.r,b.r),r2=Math.max(a.r,b.r),c1=Math.min(a.c,b.c),c2=Math.max(a.c,b.c);
  var tds=document.querySelectorAll('#tplInner .tpl-tbl td');
  for(var i=0;i<tds.length;i++){ var td=tds[i]; var k=td.getAttribute('data-k'); if(!k) continue; var p=tplKeyRC(k); td.classList.toggle('tpl-selcell',(p.r>=r1&&p.r<=r2&&p.c>=c1&&p.c<=c2)); }
}

}

function tplMk(rowsDef,C,rh){
  var R=rowsDef.length; var grid=[]; var merges=[]; var rows=[];
  for(var r=0;r<R;r++){
    var def=rowsDef[r]; var g=[]; var cc=0;
    for(var i=0;i<def.length;i++){
      var cell=def[i]; var span=(cell&&cell.span)||1; var text=(typeof cell==='string')?cell:(cell?cell.t:'');
      g[cc]={text:text};
      if(span>1) merges.push([r,cc,r,cc+span-1]);
      for(var k=1;k<span;k++){ cc++; g[cc]={text:''}; }
      cc++;
    }
    while(cc<C){ g[cc]={text:''}; cc++; }
    grid.push(g); rows.push(rh||40);
  }
  var cols=[]; for(var c=0;c<C;c++) cols.push(150);
  return {R:R,C:C,cols:cols,rows:rows,merges:merges,grid:grid};
}

function tplBlanksOf(t){ var out=[]; var used={}; (t.merges||[]).forEach(function(m){ if(m.length) m={r1:m[0],c1:m[1],r2:m[2],c2:m[3]}; for(var r=m.r1;r<=m.r2;r++)for(var c=m.c1;c<=m.c2;c++) used[r+'_'+c]=1; }); for(var r=0;r<t.R;r++)for(var c=0;c<t.C;c++){ var cell=t.grid[r]&&t.grid[r][c]; if(used[r+'_'+c]) continue; if(!cell||!cell.text) out.push({kind:'cell',key:(r+1)+'_'+(c+1),type:'text',font:'SimSun'}); } return out; }

function getSysTplLib(){ try{ return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hydro_tpl_sys')||'[]'); }catch(e){ return []; } }
function saveSysTplLib(l){ try{ localStorage.setItem('hydro_tpl_sys',JSON.stringify(l)); return true; }catch(e){ return false; } }
function getSysTpls(){
  var sys=getSysTplLib(); var out=[];
  BUILTIN_SYS_TPL.forEach(function(b){ out.push(b); });
  sys.forEach(function(s){ var i=-1; for(var k=0;k<out.length;k++) if(out[k].name===s.name){ i=k; break; } if(i>=0) out[i]=s; else out.push(s); });
  return out;
}

function saveTplLib(l){ try{ localStorage.setItem('hydro_tpl_lib', JSON.stringify(l)); return true; }catch(e){ alert('模板库保存失败（图片可能过大）：'+e.message); return false; } }
function tplTableTitle(){
  if(TPL.type!=='table'||!TPL.t||!TPL.t.grid) return '';
  for(var r=0;r<TPL.t.R;r++){
    var s=''; var row=TPL.t.grid[r]||[];
    for(var c=0;c<TPL.t.C;c++){ var cl=row[c]; if(cl&&cl.text) s+=cl.text; }
    s=s.replace(/\s+/g,'').trim(); if(s) return s;
  }
  return '';
}
