// ===== 字段库：站类组过滤 + 自定义覆盖 =====
// 每个字段第5位（索引4）为适用站类组数组，如 ['H'] 表示仅水文类；null/缺省表示全部适用
// 数据驱动：某站类数据中出现过的字段始终适用该站类；该站类录过此类数据但从未出现该字段则不适用
// 扫描站点数据，推断每个数据类中每个字段实际出现过的站类组
// 返回 { catId: { fieldId: { seen:[组...], hasData:[组...] } } }
window.dcInferFromStations = function(stations){
  var S = window.DC_SCHEMA;
  var out = {};
  if(!stations || !S) return out;
  stations.forEach(function(st){
    var grp = S.stypeGroup[st.category] || 'H';
    S.cats.forEach(function(cat){
      if(cat.scope === 'gl') return;
      var o = out[cat.id] = out[cat.id] || {};
      function mark(key, list){
        var e = o[key] = o[key] || { seen: [], hasData: [] };
        if(e[list].indexOf(grp) < 0) e[list].push(grp);
      }
      function seeRec(rec){
        if(!rec || typeof rec !== 'object') return;
        Object.keys(rec).forEach(function(k){ mark(k, 'seen'); });
      }
      if(cat.id === 'flow'){
        var ys = st.years || {}, any = false;
        Object.keys(ys).forEach(function(y){
          (ys[y] || []).forEach(function(rec){ any = true; seeRec(rec); });
        });
        if(any) mark('__has', 'hasData');
      } else {
        var d = (st.hist && st.hist[cat.id]) || {}, any2 = false;
        Object.keys(d).forEach(function(y){
          var v = d[y];
          if(Array.isArray(v)) v.forEach(function(rec){ any2 = true; seeRec(rec); });
          else if(v && typeof v === 'object'){ any2 = true; seeRec(v); }
          else if(v){ any2 = true; }
        });
        if(any2) mark('__has', 'hasData');
      }
    });
  });
  return out;
};
// 计算某字段的最终适用站类组：数据优先，无数据时按静态定义
window.dcEffGroups = function(cat, f, infer){
  var S = window.DC_SCHEMA;
  var all = Object.keys(S.groupName || {});
  var inf = infer && infer[cat.id] && infer[cat.id][f[0]];
  var stat = f[4] || [];
  var out = [];
  all.forEach(function(g){
    if(inf){
      if(inf.seen && inf.seen.indexOf(g) >= 0){ out.push(g); return; }
      if(inf.hasData && inf.hasData.indexOf(g) >= 0) return; // 该组有此类数据但无此字段
    }
    if(!stat.length || stat.indexOf(g) >= 0) out.push(g);
  });
  return out;
};
// 按站类取某数据类的匹配字段（供导入、编辑、浏览页使用）
window.dcCatFields = function(catId, stype){
  var cat = window.dcCat(catId);
  if(!cat) return [];
  return window.dcFieldsFor(cat, stype);
};
window.dcFieldsFor = function(cat, stype, infer){
  var S = window.DC_SCHEMA;
  if(!cat) return [];
  var grp = S.stypeGroup && S.stypeGroup[stype] ? S.stypeGroup[stype] : null;
  if(!grp) return cat.fields;
  return cat.fields.filter(function(f){
    return window.dcEffGroups(cat, f, infer).indexOf(grp) >= 0;
  });
};
// ===== 字段匹配 + 规范化存储：所有类型数据入库前先与字段库匹配 =====
// 表头 → 字段id 映射（按中文名匹配字段库；同名列取先出现的字段）
window.dcMapHeader = function(catId, header){
  var cat = window.dcCat(catId);
  var map = {};
  if(!cat || !header) return map;
  for(var hi = 0; hi < header.length; hi++){
    var h = String(header[hi] || '').trim();
    if(!h) continue;
    for(var j = 0; j < cat.fields.length; j++){
      if(cat.fields[j][1] === h){ map[hi] = cat.fields[j][0]; break; }
    }
  }
  return map;
};
// 单条记录规范化：键统一为字段id；未匹配列保留原文键；数值字段按有效位格式化
// 站点关键字段（站名/年份/测站编码/站类等）不入项目记录——它们由站点对象本身承载，避免重复存储（测站基本信息类除外）
window.dcNormRec = function(catId, header, cells, map){
  var cat = window.dcCat(catId);
  var rec = {};
  var ST_IDS = { stno:1, stype:1, mtype:1, category:1 };
  var n = Math.min(header ? header.length : 0, cells ? cells.length : 0);
  for(var i = 0; i < n; i++){
    var h = String(header[i] || '').trim();
    if(h === '站名' || h === '年份' || h === '测站编码' && catId !== 'basic') continue;
    var v = cells[i] == null ? '' : String(cells[i]).trim();
    if(!v) continue;
    var key = (map && map[i]) ? map[i] : h;
    if(!key) continue;
    if(catId !== 'basic' && ST_IDS[key]) continue;
    // 按字段库的有效位格式化数值
    if(cat){
      for(var j = 0; j < cat.fields.length; j++){
        if(cat.fields[j][0] === key){
          var dig = cat.fields[j][3];
          if(dig != null && typeof dig === 'number'){
            var num = parseFloat(v);
            if(!isNaN(num)) v = window.dcFmt(num, dig);
          }
          break;
        }
      }
    }
    rec[key] = v;
  }
  return rec;
};
// 加载用户自定义字段库（覆盖默认 schema）
window.dcLoadCustomSchema = function(){
  try{
    var raw = localStorage.getItem('dc_schema_custom');
    if(!raw) return false;
    var obj = JSON.parse(raw);
    if(!obj || !obj.cats) return false;
    var defIds = {};
    (window.DC_SCHEMA.cats || []).forEach(function(c){ defIds[c.id] = true; });
    obj.cats.forEach(function(c){
      if(!c || !c.id) return;
      if(!defIds[c.id]) return; // 只允许覆盖已有类别，不允许新增类别（避免导入逻辑混乱）
      var defCat = window.dcCat(c.id);
      if(defCat && Array.isArray(c.fields)) defCat.fields = c.fields;
    });
    return true;
  }catch(e){ return false; }
};
// 保存用户自定义字段库
window.dcSaveCustomSchema = function(){
  try{
    var cats = (window.DC_SCHEMA.cats || []).map(function(c){
      return { id: c.id, fields: c.fields };
    });
    localStorage.setItem('dc_schema_custom', JSON.stringify({ cats: cats }));
    return true;
  }catch(e){ return false; }
};
// 清除自定义，恢复默认
window.dcResetCustomSchema = function(){
  try{ localStorage.removeItem('dc_schema_custom'); return true; }catch(e){ return false; }
};
// 启动时加载
window.dcLoadCustomSchema();
// ===== 字段库 end =====
// 某站类对某数据类的需求状态: 'req'必需 / 'opt'可选 / 'no'不适用 / 'gl'全局
window.dcCatStatus = function(stCategory, catId){
  var S = window.DC_SCHEMA; if(!S) return 'opt';
  var grp = S.stypeGroup[stCategory] || 'H';
  for(var i = 0; i < S.cats.length; i++){
    var c = S.cats[i];
    if(c.id !== catId) continue;
    if(c.scope === 'gl') return 'gl';
    if((c.req || []).indexOf(grp) >= 0) return 'req';
    if((c.opt || []).indexOf(grp) >= 0) return 'opt';
    return 'no';
  }
  return 'opt';
};
// 按类别id取schema
window.dcCat = function(catId){
  var S = window.DC_SCHEMA; if(!S) return null;
  for(var i = 0; i < S.cats.length; i++){ if(S.cats[i].id === catId) return S.cats[i]; }
  return null;
};
// 有效位数格式化
window.dcFmt = function(val, digits){
  if(val == null || val === '') return '';
  var n = parseFloat(val);
  if(isNaN(n)) return String(val);
  if(digits === 'q'){ return n > 10 ? String(Math.round(n)) : n.toFixed(1); }
  if(typeof digits === 'number'){ return n.toFixed(digits); }
  return String(val);
};
// 通用CSV类型检测：返回 { kind, kindName, scope } 或 null
window.dcCsvDetectKind = function(header){
  var has = function(k){ return header.indexOf(k) >= 0; };
  // 全局类（无站名列）
  if(has('仪器名称') && has('型号')) return { kind: 'equipments', kindName: '仪器设备', scope: 'gl' };
  if(has('规范编号') && has('规范名称')) return { kind: 'standards', kindName: '规范标准', scope: 'gl' };
  // 矩阵类（雨量/水位/墒情）：站名,年份,类型,月份,日1...日31
  if(has('日1') && has('类型') && has('月份')){
    return { kind: 'matrix', kindName: '矩阵数据（雨量/水位/墒情）', scope: 'yr' };
  }
  // 记录类（需站名列）
  if(has('起点距') && has('高程')) return { kind: 'section', kindName: '大断面', scope: 'yr' };
  if(has('精度类别')) return { kind: 'taskbook', kindName: '测验任务书', scope: 'st' };
  if(has('测次日期') && has('流量')) return { kind: 'flow', kindName: '流量测次', scope: 'yr' };
  if(has('编号') && has('零点高程')) return { kind: 'gauges', kindName: '水尺零高', scope: 'yr' };
  if(has('编号') && has('高程') && has('类型')) return { kind: 'levels', kindName: '水准点', scope: 'yr' };
  if(has('水位') && has('流量') && has('面积')) return { kind: 'zq', kindName: '水位流量关系', scope: 'yr' };
  if(has('高洪水位级')) return { kind: 'floodplan', kindName: '高洪测验方案', scope: 'st' };
  if(has('设备清单') || has('测验设施') || has('报汛级别')) return { kind: 'report', kindName: '设施设备', scope: 'st' };
  if(has('测站沿革') || has('迁站记录')) return { kind: 'textual', kindName: '测站考证', scope: 'st' };
  if(has('测站编码') || has('站类')) return { kind: 'station', kindName: '站点信息', scope: 'st' };
  return null;
};
window.dcCsvSummarize = function(text){
  try{
    text = String(text || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
    var lines = text.replace(/\r/g, '\n').split('\n');
    var rows = [];
    for(var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++){ if(lines[i].trim().length) rows.push(lines[i]); }
    if(rows.length < 2) return { err: '内容为空或只有表头' };
    var header = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[0]).map(function(s){ return s.trim(); });
    var det = window.dcCsvDetectKind(header);
    if(!det) return { err: '无法识别数据类型。支持：站点信息/大断面/任务书/流量测次/水准点/水尺零高/雨量/水位/墒情/水位流量关系/流率表/高洪方案/设施设备/测站考证/仪器设备/规范标准' };
    // 全局类不需要站名列
    if(det.scope === 'gl'){
      return { kind: det.kind, kindName: det.kindName, rows: rows.length - 1, stations: ['（全局共用）'] };
    }
    // 单站类需站名列
    if((header[0] || '') !== '站名') return { err: '无法识别：第一列表头应为"站名"，当前为"' + (header[0] || '') + '"' };
    var stSet = {}, n = 0;
    for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
      var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
      var nm = (c[0] || '').trim();
      if(nm){ stSet[nm] = 1; n++; }
    }
    return { kind: det.kind, kindName: det.kindName, rows: n, stations: Object.keys(stSet) };
  }catch(e){ return { err: '识别异常：' + e.message }; }
};
/* 多栏断面Excel预处理：识别"实测大断面成果表"格式（5组3列：垂线号|起点距|河底高程），
   自动提取数据点、补全高程前缀、转为标准CSV（站名,年份,起点距,高程） */
window.dcParseMultiColSection = function(csv, fileName){
  try{
    csv = String(csv||'').replace(/^\uFEFF/,'');
    var lines = csv.replace(/\r/g,'\n').split('\n').filter(function(l){return l.trim();});
    if(lines.length < 4) return null;
    var hdr = lines[2] || lines[1] || '';
    if(hdr.indexOf('垂')<0 || hdr.indexOf('起点')<0 || hdr.indexOf('高程')<0) return null;
    /* 从文件名提取站名和年份 */
    var stName='', stYear='';
    var fn = fileName || '';
    var mY = fn.match(/(\d{4})/) || fn.match(/(\d{4})年/);
    if(mY) stYear = mY[1];
    var mS = fn.match(/([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,4})站/);
    if(mS) stName = mS[1];
    /* 若文件名没提取到，从表格内容找 */
    if(!stName){ var l0 = (lines[0]||'')+(lines[1]||''); var ms2=l0.match(/([\u4e00-\u9fa5]{2,4})站/); if(ms2) stName=ms2[1]; }
    if(!stYear){ var l1=lines[1]||''; var my2=l1.match(/(\d{4})/); if(my2) stYear=my2[1]; }
    if(!stName || !stYear) return null;
    /* 找数据起始行（跳过标题、年份信息行，找到含数字的行） */
    var dataStart=3;
    for(var di=2;di<lines.length;di++){
      var parts=lines[di].split(',');
      if(parts.length>=6 && parts.some(function(p){return parseFloat(p)>=0;})){ dataStart=di; break; }
    }
    /* 提取数据点 */
    var pts=[];
    for(var i=dataStart;i<lines.length;i++){
      var cols=lines[i].split(',');
      var ngrp=Math.floor((cols.length-1)/3);
      for(var g=0;g<ngrp;g++){
        var base=g*3;
        var vt=(cols[base]||'').trim();
        var dist=parseFloat(cols[base+1]);
        var elev=parseFloat(cols[base+2]);
        if(isNaN(dist)||isNaN(elev)) continue;
        var seq=0;
        if(/右岸/.test(vt)) seq=0;
        else if(/左岸/.test(vt)) seq=999;
        else seq=parseInt(vt)||0;
        pts.push({seq:seq,dist:dist,rawElev:elev});
      }
    }
    if(pts.length<3) return null;
    pts.sort(function(a,b){return a.seq-b.seq;});
    /* 补全高程前缀：rawElev<100时为省略整数部分的值 */
    var fixed=pts.map(function(p){
      if(p.rawElev>=100) return {dist:p.dist,elev:p.rawElev};
      var dec=p.rawElev/100;
      /* 在已知完整值中找最近的锚点 */
      var prevC=null,nextC=null;
      pts.forEach(function(q){ if(q.rawElev>=100){ if(q.dist<=p.dist&&(!prevC||q.dist>prevC.dist))prevC=q; if(q.dist>=p.dist&&(!nextC||q.dist<nextC.dist))nextC=q; } });
      var baseInt=182;
      if(prevC) baseInt=Math.floor(prevC.rawElev);
      else if(nextC) baseInt=Math.floor(nextC.rawElev);
      /* 尝试使值连续 */
      var best=baseInt+dec;
      if(prevC && best>prevC.rawElev+3){ best=(baseInt-1)+dec; }
      if(nextC && best<nextC.rawElev-3 && baseInt>175){ best=(baseInt+1)+dec; }
      return {dist:p.dist,elev:Math.round(best*100)/100};
    });
    /* 按距离去重（取平均） */
    var uniq={};
    fixed.forEach(function(p){ var k=String(p.dist); if(!uniq[k]) uniq[k]={dist:p.dist,sum:0,n:0}; uniq[k].sum+=p.elev; uniq[k].n++; });
    var rows=Object.keys(uniq).sort(function(a,b){return parseFloat(a)-parseFloat(b);}).map(function(k){return {dist:uniq[k].dist,elev:Math.round(uniq[k].sum/uniq[k].n*100)/100};});
    /* 生成标准CSV */
    var out='站名,年份,起点距,高程\n';
    rows.forEach(function(r){ out+=stName+','+stYear+','+r.dist+','+r.elev+'\n'; });
    return {csv:out, station:stName, year:stYear, count:rows.length};
  }catch(e){ return null; }
};
window.dcCsvImportText = function(text, stations){
  try{
    text = String(text || '').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '');
    var lines = text.replace(/\r/g, '\n').split('\n');
    var rows = [];
    for(var i = 0; i < lines.length; i++){ if(lines[i].trim().length) rows.push(lines[i]); }
    if(rows.length < 2) return { err: '文件为空或只有表头' };
    var header = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[0]).map(function(s){ return s.trim(); });
    var det = window.dcCsvDetectKind(header);
    if(!det) return { err: '无法识别CSV类型（支持：站点信息/大断面/任务书/流量测次/水准点/水尺零高/雨量/水位/墒情/水位流量关系/流率表/高洪方案/设施设备/测站考证/仪器设备/规范标准）' };
    var kind = det.kind, scope = det.scope;
    var has = function(k){ return header.indexOf(k) >= 0; };
    var col = function(k){ return header.indexOf(k); };
    var curYear = String(new Date().getFullYear());
    var touched = {}, skipped = {}, count = 0;
    var findSt = function(name){
      if(!stations) return null;
      for(var j = 0; j < stations.length; j++){ if(stations[j].name === name) return stations[j]; }
      return null;
    };

    // 全局类：仪器/规范，不依赖站名列
    if(scope === 'gl'){
      var items = [];
      var gmap = window.dcMapHeader(kind, header);
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        if(!c.length || !c[0].trim()) continue;
        items.push(window.dcNormRec(kind, header, c, gmap)); count++;
      }
      var storeKey = kind === 'equipments' ? 'dc_equipments' : 'dc_standards';
      var existing = [];
      try{ existing = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(storeKey) || '[]'); }catch(e){}
      var byKey = {};
      existing.forEach(function(it){
        var k = it.name || it.code || it.model || JSON.stringify(it);
        byKey[k] = it;
      });
      items.forEach(function(it){
        var k = it.name || it.code || it.model || JSON.stringify(it);
        byKey[k] = it;
      });
      var merged = Object.values(byKey);
      localStorage.setItem(storeKey, JSON.stringify(merged));
      return { kind: kind, count: count, msg: det.kindName + ' ' + count + ' 条，已更新全局库（共' + merged.length + '条）' };
    }

    if((header[0] || '') !== '站名') return { err: '无法识别：第一列表头应为"站名"，当前为"' + (header[0] || '') + '"' };
    if(!stations || !stations.length){ if(kind !== 'station') return { err: '系统中还没有站点，请先导入站点信息' }; }

    if(kind === 'station'){
      var maxId = 0;
      stations.forEach(function(s){ if(s.id > maxId) maxId = s.id; });
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        var name = (c[0] || '').trim();
        if(!name) continue;
        var g = function(k, dft){ var p = col(k); return p >= 0 ? (c[p] || '').trim() : (dft || ''); };
        var st = findSt(name);
        var rawCat = g('站类','') || g('站别','');
        if(rawCat){
          if(!st){
            maxId++;
            st = { id: maxId, name: name, category: rawCat, years: {}, hist: {} };
            stations.push(st);
          } else { st.category = rawCat; }
        } else if(!st){
          maxId++;
          st = { id: maxId, name: name, category: '中小河水文站', years: {}, hist: {} };
          stations.push(st);
        }
        window.dcCsvHistInit(st);
        var y0 = g('设站年月','').slice(0, 4) || curYear;
        if(!st.hist.basic[y0]) st.hist.basic[y0] = {};
        var b = st.hist.basic[y0];
        if(g('河流名称')) b.river = g('河流名称');
        var catB = window.dcCat ? window.dcCat('basic') : null;
        if(catB){ catB.fields.forEach(function(f){ var v = g(f[1]); if(v) b[f[0]] = v; }); }
        else {
          if(g('精度等级')) b.cls = g('精度等级');
          if(g('测站编码')) b.stno = g('测站编码');
          if(g('经度')) b.lng = g('经度');
          if(g('纬度')) b.lat = g('纬度');
          if(g('集水面积')) b.area = g('集水面积');
        }
        touched[name] = 1; count++;
      }
    } else if(kind === 'section'){
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        var name = (c[0] || '').trim();
        var y = (c[1] || '').trim();
        if(!name || !y){ continue; }
        var st = findSt(name);
        if(!st){ skipped[name] = 1; continue; }
        window.dcCsvHistInit(st);
        if(!st.hist.sections[y]) st.hist.sections[y] = [];
        var arr = st.hist.sections[y];
        var sec = null;
        for(var k = 0; k < arr.length; k++){ if((arr[k].name || '') === '大断面'){ sec = arr[k]; break; } }
        if(!sec){
          sec = { id: Date.now(), name: '大断面', date: '', bank: '右岸', wlevel: '', rows: [] };
          arr.push(sec);
        }
        var dist = parseFloat(c[2]), elev = parseFloat(c[3]);
        if(isNaN(dist) || isNaN(elev)) continue;
        var ptType = (c[4] || '').trim();
        sec.rows.push(ptType ? { dist: dist, elev: elev, type: ptType } : { dist: dist, elev: elev });
        touched[name] = 1; count++;
      }
    } else if(kind === 'taskbook'){
      var tmap = window.dcMapHeader('taskbook', header);
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        var name = (c[0] || '').trim();
        if(!name) continue;
        var st = findSt(name);
        if(!st){ skipped[name] = 1; continue; }
        window.dcCsvHistInit(st);
        var y = curYear;
        var yp = col('年份');
        if(yp >= 0 && (c[yp] || '').trim()) y = c[yp].trim();
        if(!st.hist.taskbook[y]) st.hist.taskbook[y] = {};
        var rec = window.dcNormRec('taskbook', header, c, tmap);
        delete rec['站名']; delete rec['年份'];
        Object.assign(st.hist.taskbook[y], rec);
        touched[name] = 1; count++;
      }
    } else if(kind === 'flow'){
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        var name = (c[0] || '').trim();
        var y = (c[1] || '').trim();
        if(!name || !y){ continue; }
        var st = findSt(name);
        if(!st){ skipped[name] = 1; continue; }
        window.dcCsvHistInit(st);
        if(!st.years[y]) st.years[y] = [];
        var g3 = function(k){ var p = col(k); return p >= 0 ? (c[p] || '').trim() : ''; };
        var rec = {
          no: g3('施测号数'), pos: g3('断面位置'),
          time: g3('测次日期'), z: g3('水位'), q: g3('流量'), a: g3('面积'), v: g3('平均流速'),
          vmax: g3('最大流速'), width: g3('水面宽'), hbar: g3('平均水深'), hmax: g3('最大水深'),
          slope: g3('水面比降'), n: g3('糙率'),
          method: g3('测流方法'), vline: g3('垂线数'), dur: g3('测速历时'),
          staff: g3('测验人员'), equip: g3('使用仪器'), pts: g3('测点总数'), remark: g3('备注')
        };
        if(!rec.time || (!rec.z && !rec.q)) continue;
        var exist = null;
        for(var k = 0; k < st.years[y].length; k++){
          var e0 = st.years[y][k];
          var same = rec.no ? ((e0.no || '') === rec.no) : ((e0.time || '') === rec.time);
          if(same){ exist = e0; break; }
        }
        if(exist){ Object.assign(exist, rec); } else {
          st.years[y].push(rec);
        }
        touched[name] = 1; count++;
      }
    } else if(kind === 'levels' || kind === 'gauges'){
      // 水准点/水尺零高：站名,年份,编号,高程/零点高程,类型,位置,...
      var yp2 = col('年份');
      var lgmap = window.dcMapHeader(kind, header);
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        var name = (c[0] || '').trim();
        if(!name) continue;
        var st = findSt(name);
        if(!st){ skipped[name] = 1; continue; }
        window.dcCsvHistInit(st);
        var y = (yp2 >= 0 && (c[yp2] || '').trim()) ? c[yp2].trim() : curYear;
        if(!st.hist[kind][y]) st.hist[kind][y] = [];
        var rec = window.dcNormRec(kind, header, c, lgmap);
        // 去重：按编号（新数据键 name，旧数据键 编号，两者兼容）
        var key = rec['name'] || rec['编号'] || JSON.stringify(rec);
        var exist = null;
        for(var k = 0; k < st.hist[kind][y].length; k++){
          var r = st.hist[kind][y][k];
          if(((r['name'] || r['编号'] || '') === key)){ exist = r; break; }
        }
        if(exist){ Object.assign(exist, rec); } else { st.hist[kind][y].push(rec); }
        touched[name] = 1; count++;
      }
    } else if(kind === 'zq'){
      // 水位流量关系：站名,年份,水位,流量,面积,流速
      var yp3 = col('年份');
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        var name = (c[0] || '').trim();
        if(!name) continue;
        var st = findSt(name);
        if(!st){ skipped[name] = 1; continue; }
        window.dcCsvHistInit(st);
        var y = (yp3 >= 0 && (c[yp3] || '').trim()) ? c[yp3].trim() : curYear;
        var z = parseFloat(c[col('水位')]), q = parseFloat(c[col('流量')]);
        if(isNaN(z) || isNaN(q)) continue;
        var a = col('面积') >= 0 ? parseFloat(c[col('面积')]) : '';
        var v = col('流速') >= 0 ? parseFloat(c[col('流速')]) : '';
        if(!st.hist.zq[y]) st.hist.zq[y] = [];
        // 每站每年只保留一组关系点（追加模式）
        var grp = null;
        for(var k = 0; k < st.hist.zq[y].length; k++){
          if(st.hist.zq[y][k].name === '水位流量关系'){ grp = st.hist.zq[y][k]; break; }
        }
        if(!grp){ grp = { name: '水位流量关系', pts: [] }; st.hist.zq[y].push(grp); }
        grp.pts.push([z, q, a, v]);
        touched[name] = 1; count++;
      }
    } else if(kind === 'matrix'){
      // 矩阵：站名,年份,类型,月份,日1...日31
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        var name = (c[0] || '').trim();
        if(!name) continue;
        var st = findSt(name);
        if(!st){ skipped[name] = 1; continue; }
        window.dcCsvHistInit(st);
        var y = (c[1] || '').trim() || curYear;
        var mtype = (c[col('类型')] || '').trim();
        var month = parseInt(c[col('月份')] || '0', 10);
        if(!month || month < 1 || month > 12) continue;
        var catId = mtype.indexOf('雨') >= 0 ? 'rain' : (mtype.indexOf('墒') >= 0 ? 'moisture' : 'water');
        if(!st.hist[catId][y]) st.hist[catId][y] = {};
        if(!st.hist[catId][y].zhai) st.hist[catId][y].zhai = [];
        var zhai = st.hist[catId][y].zhai;
        for(var d = 1; d <= 31; d++){
          var ci = col('日' + d);
          if(ci < 0) break;
          var val = (c[ci] || '').trim();
          if(!val) continue;
          if(!zhai[month - 1]) zhai[month - 1] = {};
          zhai[month - 1][d] = val;
        }
        touched[name] = 1; count++;
      }
    } else if(kind === 'floodplan' || kind === 'report' || kind === 'textual'){
      // 高洪方案/设施设备/测站考证：站名,年份,字段1,字段2,...
      var yp4 = col('年份');
      var frmap = window.dcMapHeader(kind, header);
      for(var i = 1; i < rows.length; i++){
        var c = window.dcCsvParseLine(rows[i]);
        var name = (c[0] || '').trim();
        if(!name) continue;
        var st = findSt(name);
        if(!st){ skipped[name] = 1; continue; }
        window.dcCsvHistInit(st);
        var y = (yp4 >= 0 && (c[yp4] || '').trim()) ? c[yp4].trim() : curYear;
        if(!st.hist[kind][y]) st.hist[kind][y] = {};
        var rec = window.dcNormRec(kind, header, c, frmap);
        delete rec['站名']; delete rec['年份'];
        Object.assign(st.hist[kind][y], rec);
        touched[name] = 1; count++;
      }
    }
    var kindName = det ? det.kindName : kind;
    var msg = kindName + ' ' + count + ' 条';
    var tList = Object.keys(touched);
    if(tList.length) msg += '（' + tList.slice(0, 5).join('、') + (tList.length > 5 ? '等' : '') + '）';
    var sList = Object.keys(skipped);
    if(sList.length) msg += '；跳过未建站点：' + sList.join('、');
    return { kind: kind, count: count, msg: msg };
  }catch(e){
    return { err: '解析异常：' + e.message };
  }
};
window.dcHomeInject = function(f){
  var doc, win;
  try{ doc = f.contentDocument; win = f.contentWindow; }catch(e){ return; }
  if(!doc || !doc.body || !win) return;
  if(doc.getElementById('dcHome')) return;
  var sc = doc.createElement('script');
  sc.textContent = [
    '(function(){',
    'var P = window.parent;',
    'function el(tag, css, txt){ var e = document.createElement(tag); if(css) e.style.cssText = css; if(txt != null) e.textContent = txt; return e; }',
    'var home, panel, prevBox, ta, fileIn, homeBtn, cardsBox, dbBox, dbContent, dbChips, dbSel, dbYear, flBox, tbTitle, tbStation;',
    'function buildHome(){',
    '  home = el("div", "position:fixed;left:0;top:0;right:0;bottom:0;background:#F4F6FA;z-index:99998;overflow:auto;font-family:inherit;");',
    '  home.id = "dcHome";',
    '  var wrap = el("div", "max-width:920px;margin:0 auto;padding:120px 20px 28px;");',
    '',
    '',
    '  cardsBox = el("div", "display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;");',
    '  var c1 = el("div", "flex:1;min-width:260px;background:#1565C0;color:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:26px 24px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(21,101,192,.25);");',
    '  c1.appendChild(el("div", "font-size:20px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;", "批量导入"));',
    '  c1.appendChild(el("div", "font-size:13px;opacity:.9;line-height:1.7;", "CSV / Excel 文件选择导入，或复制数据库结果直接粘贴导入"));',
    '  var c2 = el("div", "flex:1;min-width:260px;background:#fff;color:#1A2B45;border:1px solid #E3E8F0;border-radius:12px;padding:26px 24px;cursor:pointer;box-shadow:0 2px 8px rgba(26,43,69,.08);");',
    '  c2.appendChild(el("div", "font-size:20px;font-weight:700;margin-bottom:8px;", "数据库"));',
    '  c2.appendChild(el("div", "font-size:13px;color:#68788F;line-height:1.7;", "按类别浏览和查询已入库数据（站点、任务书、大断面、测验资料等）"));',
    '  c1.onclick = function(){ cardsBox.style.display = "none"; panel.style.display = "block"; };',
    '  c2.onclick = function(){ enterDB(); };',

    'var __srcs = [];',
    'function fileToTexts(file, cb){',
    '  var name = file.name || "";',
    '  var ext = name.slice(name.lastIndexOf(".")).toLowerCase();',
    '  if(ext === ".xlsx" || ext === ".xls"){',
    '    /* iframe 隔离时 window.XLSX 未定义，但顶层已加载；先借顶层 XLSX */',
    '    if(typeof XLSX === "undefined" && window.parent && window.parent.XLSX){ try{ window.XLSX = window.parent.XLSX; }catch(e){} }',
    '    function _f2tRun(){',
    '      if(typeof XLSX === "undefined"){ cb([{ name: name, err: "Excel解析库未加载（需联网后重试，或将Excel另存为CSV）" }]); return; }',
    '      var r = new FileReader();',
    '      r.onload = function(e){',
    '        try{',
    '          var wb = XLSX.read(new Uint8Array(e.target.result), { type: "array" });',
    '          var out = [];',
    '          for(var i = 0; i < wb.SheetNames.length; i++){',
    '            var sn = wb.SheetNames[i];',
    '            var csv = XLSX.utils.sheet_to_csv(wb.Sheets[sn]);',
    '            if(csv && csv.trim()){ var mc=window.dcParseMultiColSection?window.dcParseMultiColSection(csv,name):null; if(mc){ out.push({ name: name + " [" + sn + "]", text: mc.csv }); } else { out.push({ name: name + " [" + sn + "]", text: csv }); } }',
    '          }',
    '          if(!out.length) out = [{ name: name, err: "Excel中没有数据" }];',
    '          cb(out);',
    '        }catch(ex){ cb([{ name: name, err: "Excel解析失败：" + ex.message }]); }',
    '      };',
    '      r.readAsArrayBuffer(file);',
    '    }',
    '    if(window.XLSX){ _f2tRun(); return; }',

    '    cabinets.sort(function(a, b){ var ra = cabRank(a), rb = cabRank(b); if(ra !== rb) return ra - rb; return a.name.localeCompare(b.name, "zh"); });',

    '  /* ===== 垂线布设方案 / 垂线转移方案 年柜渲染（大断面→布设→转移 闭环） ===== */',
    '  function layoutCard(rec, st, year){',

    '    if(rec.sectionYear) hd.appendChild(el("span", "font-size:10px;color:#8A98AB;", "依据" + rec.sectionYear + "年大断面" + (rec.sectionDate ? "(" + rec.sectionDate + ")" : "")));',

    '      function td(v, css){ var t=el("td", "padding:4px 6px;"+(css||""), (v==null?"":String(v))); tr.appendChild(t); return t; }',

    '    if(rec.norm) card.appendChild(el("div", "font-size:10px;color:#8A98AB;margin-top:4px;", rec.norm));',
    '    if(rec.remark) card.appendChild(el("div", "font-size:11px;color:#666;margin-top:3px;", "备注：" + rec.remark));',
    '    del.onclick = function(){',
    '      if(!st.hist || !st.hist.layouts || !st.hist.layouts[year]) return;',

    '  function renderLayouts(body, arr, st, year){',
    '    var wrap = el("div", "padding:6px 0 2px;");',
    '    var btn = el("button", "margin:0 0 6px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px dashed #1565C0;border-radius:6px;background:#F5F9FE;color:#1565C0;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;", "⟳ 按最新大断面自动生成 / 规范校核");',
    '    var msg = el("div", "font-size:12px;color:#C62828;margin:2px 0 6px;", ""); msg.style.display = "none";',

    '    if(rec.fixed && rec.fixed.length) row("中间固定垂线(" + rec.fixed.length + "根，起点距m)", rec.fixed.join(", "));',

    '    if(rec.remark) row("备注", rec.remark);',

    '  function renderTransfers(body, arr, st, year){',
    '    var wrap = el("div", "padding:6px 0 2px;");',
    '    var btn = el("button", "margin:0 0 6px;padding:8px 16px;border:1px dashed #1565C0;border-radius:6px;background:#F5F9FE;color:#1565C0;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;cursor:pointer;", "↑ 取最新垂线布设成果，更新中间固定垂线");',
    '    var msg = el("div", "font-size:12px;color:#C62828;margin:2px 0 6px;", ""); msg.style.display = "none";',
    '    btn.onclick = function(){',
    '      msg.style.display = "none"; msg.textContent = "";',
    '      if(!arr || !arr.length){ msg.textContent = "本年还没有转移方案记录（预置方案随选站自动生成）"; msg.style.display = "block"; return; }',
    '      var lm = (st.hist && st.hist.layouts) || {};',

    '      var lv = null;',

    '      var changed = 0;',
    '      arr.forEach(function(r){',

    '      });',

    '    };',

    '    body.appendChild(el("div", "font-size:11px;color:#8A98AB;margin:0 0 8px;", "垂线转移只移动左右岸边两根线（规范B.2.4）；中间固定垂线由「垂线布设方案」确定"));',
    '    (arr || []).forEach(function(rec){ body.appendChild(transferCard(rec, st, year)); });',
    '  }',
    '  var _HN = (window.top && window.top.HY_NORM) || null;',
    '  var DC_PREC_C = _HN ? _HN.C : { water:{dec:2}, rain:{dec:1}, evap:{dec:1}, qday:{sig:3}, flow:{sig:3}, sediment:{sig:3} };',
    '  var DC_PREC_F = _HN ? _HN.F : { stage:{dec:2}, z:{dec:2}, elev:{dec:3}, g:{dec:3}, q:{sig:3}, avq:{sig:3}, qq:{sig:3}, cs:{sig:3}, xs:{sig:3}, area:{dec:2}, v:{dec:2}, vv:{dec:2}, vel:{dec:2}, dist:{dec:1}, rain:{dec:1}, p:{dec:1}, evap:{dec:1}, e:{dec:1} };',
    '  try{ var S0 = P.DC_SCHEMA; if(S0 && S0.cats){ var _FT = _HN ? _HN.F : DC_PREC_F; S0.cats.forEach(function(c0){ (c0.fields || []).forEach(function(f0){ var d0 = f0[3]; var pr0 = (d0 === "q") ? {sig:3} : ((typeof d0 === "number" && d0 > 0) ? {dec:d0} : null); if(pr0) _FT[f0[0]] = pr0; }); }); } }catch(e0){}',
    '  function roundHE(n, dec){',
    '    var f = Math.pow(10, dec), x = Math.abs(n) * f, fl = Math.floor(x), frac = x - fl, out;',
    '    if(Math.abs(frac - 0.5) < 1e-9){ out = (fl % 2 === 0) ? fl : fl + 1; } else { out = Math.round(x); }',
    '    return ((n < 0 ? -1 : 1) * out / f).toFixed(dec);',
    '  }',
    '  function fmtNum(v, pre){',
    '    var s = (v == null ? "" : String(v)).trim();',
    '    if(!/^-?\\d+(\\.\\d+)?$/.test(s) || !pre) return s;',
    '    var n = parseFloat(s); if(isNaN(n)) return s;',
    '    if(pre.sig){ if(n === 0) return "0"; var mag = Math.floor(Math.log10(Math.abs(n))); var dec = pre.sig - 1 - mag; if(dec < 0) dec = 0; if(dec > 8) dec = 8; return roundHE(n, dec); }',
    '    return roundHE(n, pre.dec);',
    '  }',
    '  function normText(pre){',
    '    if(!pre) return "";',
    '    var b = pre.sig ? (pre.sig + "位有效数字") : (pre.dec + "位小数");',
    '    return pre.tol ? (b + "，误差" + pre.tol) : b;',
    '  }',
    '  function autoNorm(lbl){ var s = String(lbl || ""); if(_HN){ return _HN.auto(s); }',
    '    if(/水位|水尺/.test(s)) return {dec:2, tol:"±0.01m"};',
    '    if(/流量/.test(s)) return {sig:3, tol:"相对≤5%"};',
    '    if(/含沙|输沙/.test(s)) return {sig:3, tol:"相对≤10%"};',
    '    if(/降水|雨量/.test(s)) return {dec:1, tol:"±0.1mm"};',
    '    if(/蒸发/.test(s)) return {dec:1, tol:"±0.1mm"};',
    '    if(/流速/.test(s)) return {dec:2, tol:"±0.01m/s"};',
    '    if(/比降/.test(s)) return {dec:2};',

'function levelPage(pc){',

'  row2.appendChild(b0); row2.appendChild(b1); row2.appendChild(b2); bar.appendChild(row2); pc.appendChild(bar);',
'  var content = el("div"); pc.appendChild(content);',

'function vColor(verdict){ if(/沿用/.test(verdict)) return {bg:"#F1F5F9",c:"#546173"}; if(/新设|新列/.test(verdict)) return {bg:"#E8F1FC",c:"#1565C0"}; if(/变动/.test(verdict)) return {bg:"#FFF3E0",c:"#E07B00"}; return {bg:"#FDECEC",c:"#C62828"}; }',
'var L_TYPES=["基本水准点","校核水准点","引据水准点","固定点"];',
'var L_STATUS=["在用","备用","待测","引据","停用","注销"];',

'var levelCtx=null;',
'function fv(r,m,k){ var v=r[k]; return (v!=null&&v!=="")?v:(m&&m[k]?m[k]:""); }',
'function getLevel(st,name){ return (KZ.levels||[]).filter(function(l){return l.station===st&&l.name===name;})[0]||null; }',
'function ensureLevel(st,name){ var l=getLevel(st,name); if(!l){ l={station:st,name:name,type:"",set_date:"",elev:"",location:"",status:"",discard_date:"",discard_reason:"",remark:""}; KZ.levels=KZ.levels||[]; KZ.levels.push(l); } return l; }',
'function edCell(css,val,onCommit,isSelect,opts){ var td=el("td",css); td.title="点击编辑"; td.textContent=val; bindEdit(td,val,onCommit,isSelect,opts); return td; }',
'function bindEdit(td,val,onCommit,isSelect,opts){ td.onclick=function(){ if(td.querySelector("input,select"))return; var old=String(val==null?"":val); var inp; if(isSelect){ inp=document.createElement("select"); inp.style.cssText="width:100%;padding:3px;font-size:12px;"; var blank=document.createElement("option");blank.value="";blank.textContent="（空）";inp.appendChild(blank); opts.forEach(function(x){var o=document.createElement("option");o.value=x;o.textContent=x;inp.appendChild(o);}); } else { inp=document.createElement("input"); inp.style.cssText="width:100%;padding:3px;border:1px solid #1565C0;font-size:12px;box-sizing:border-box;"; } inp.value=old; td.textContent=""; td.appendChild(inp); if(!isSelect) inp.focus(); function commit(){ var nv=inp.value; if(nv!==old){ onCommit(nv); } } function restore(){ td.textContent=inp.value; } inp.onblur=function(){ commit(); restore(); }; inp.onkeydown=function(e){ e=e||window.event; if(e.key==="Enter"){ inp.blur(); } else if(e.key==="Escape"){ inp.value=old; td.textContent=old; } }; if(isSelect){ inp.onchange=function(){ inp.blur(); }; } }; }',
'function mkSelectIn(opts,val){ var sx=el("select","width:100%;padding:8px;border:1px solid #CBD5E1;border-radius:6px;font-size:14px;box-sizing:border-box;"); opts.forEach(function(x){var o=document.createElement("option");o.value=x;o.textContent=x;if(x===val)o.selected=true;sx.appendChild(o);}); return sx; }',

'use strict';
(function(){
  if(typeof window.openYbt !== 'function'){ return; }
  var _openYbt = openYbt;
  var _frame = document.getElementById('ybtFrame');
  var _gen = 0, _abort = null;
  function scheduleInject(key, fn){
    if(!_frame) return;
    var myGen = _gen;
    var alive = function(){ return myGen === _gen && (_frame.getAttribute('data-ybt-target')||'').indexOf(key) >= 0; };
    var fire = function(){ try{ if(alive()) fn(_frame); }catch(e){} };
    if(_abort){ try{ _abort.abort(); }catch(e){} }
    _abort = (typeof AbortController !== 'undefined') ? new AbortController() : null;
    try{
      if(_abort){ _frame.addEventListener('load', fire, {signal:_abort.signal}); }
      else { _frame.addEventListener('load', fire); }
    }catch(e){ try{ _frame.addEventListener('load', fire); }catch(e2){} }
    [250,700,1300,2200,3200].forEach(function(d){ setTimeout(fire,d); });
  }
  window.openYbt = function(hash, title){
    _frame = document.getElementById('ybtFrame') || _frame;
    _gen++;
    if(_abort){ try{ _abort.abort(); }catch(e){} _abort = null; }
    if(_frame) _frame.setAttribute('data-ybt-target', hash || '');
    _openYbt(hash, title);
    try{
      if((hash || '').indexOf('数据中心') >= 0){
        scheduleInject('数据中心', function(f){ window.dcHomeInject(f); });
      }
      if((hash || '').indexOf('考证') >= 0){
        scheduleInject('考证', function(f){ window.kzHomeInject(f); });
      }
    }catch(e){}
  };
})();

function toast(msg) {
  var t = $('toastBox');
  t.textContent = msg;
  t.style.opacity = 1;
  setTimeout(function(){ t.style.opacity = 0; }, 2000);
}


function renderLoginLogPage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!(isSuper(u)||isOrgAdmin(u,u.orgId)||u.role==='provinceAdmin')) { alert('仅各级机构管理员可查看登录日志'); return; }
    if (!canPerm((typeof u!=='undefined'?u.role:''), '登录日志')) { alert('该功能已被管理员关闭，当前角色无权使用'); return; }  showPage('orgPage');  setTopTitle('登录日志与统计');
  var log = loginLog();
  var vis = visibleLogIds(u);
  if (vis) log = log.filter(function(e){ return vis.indexOf(e.orgId) >= 0; });
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var total = log.length;
  var byDate = {}, byOrg = {}, byUser = {};
  log.forEach(function(e){
    var d = (e.t||'').split(',')[0] || (e.t||'日期未知');
    byDate[d] = (byDate[d]||0)+1;
    byOrg[e.orgName] = (byOrg[e.orgName]||0)+1;
    byUser[e.name] = (byUser[e.name]||0)+1;
  });
  var f = window.SUPER_LOG_FILTER || null;
  var flist = log;
  if (f) flist = log.filter(function(e){
    if (f.org && e.orgName!==f.org) return false;
    if (f.user && e.name!==f.user) return false;
    if (f.date && (e.t||'').split(',')[0]!==f.date) return false;
    return true;
  });
  var orgStats = Object.keys(byOrg).map(function(k){return {k:k,v:byOrg[k]};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.v-a.v;});
  var userStats = Object.keys(byUser).map(function(k){return {k:k,v:byUser[k]};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.v-a.v;});
  var dateStats = Object.keys(byDate).map(function(k){return {k:k,v:byDate[k]};}).sort(function(a,b){ return b.k<a.k?1:-1; }).slice(-7);
  var chip = function(label,obj){
    return '<span onclick="setLogFilter(' + JSON.stringify(obj).replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + ')" style="cursor:pointer;background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:12px;padding:3px 10px;margin:2px 4px 2px 0;display:inline-block;">' + label + '</span>';
  };
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>登录日志与统计</h3><p class="mut">累计登录 ' + total + ' 次。点击下方机构/人员/日期可只看对应明细，点「全部」恢复。</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>分类统计（点击查看）</h3>';
  h += '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:2px"><b>按机构：</b>' + (orgStats.length?orgStats.map(function(x){return chip(esc(x.k)+'（'+x.v+'）', {org:x.k});}).join(''):'暂无') + '</div>';
  h += '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:8px"><b>按人员：</b>' + (userStats.length?userStats.map(function(x){return chip(esc(x.k)+'（'+x.v+'）', {user:x.k});}).join(''):'暂无') + '</div>';
  h += '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:8px"><b>按日期（近7日）：</b>' + (dateStats.length?dateStats.map(function(x){return chip(esc(x.k)+'（'+x.v+'）', {date:x.k});}).join(''):'暂无') + '</div>';
  h += '<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn gray" onclick="setLogFilter(null)">查看全部（'+total+'条）</button></div>';
  h += '</div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>登录明细' + (f?('（筛选：'+((f.org||'')+(f.user||'')+(f.date||''))+'）'):'（最近200条）') + '</h3>';
  var list = (f?flist:log.slice(-200)).slice().reverse();
  if (!list.length) h += '<div class="empty">暂无登录记录</div>';
  list.forEach(function(e){
    h += '<div style="background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px;">'
      + '<b>' + esc(e.name) + '</b>（' + esc(e.orgName||'系统') + '）　' + esc(e.t) + '<span style="color:var(--t3)">　' + esc(e.m||'') + '</span></div>';
  });
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
}function setLogFilter(f){ window.SUPER_LOG_FILTER = f; renderLoginLogPage(); }

function renderAuditLogPage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!(isSuper(u)||isOrgAdmin(u,u.orgId)||u.role==='provinceAdmin')) { alert('仅各级机构管理员可查看操作审计'); return; }
  if (!canPerm((typeof u!=='undefined'?u.role:''), '操作审计')) { alert('该功能已被管理员关闭，当前角色无权使用'); return; }
  showPage('orgPage'); setTopTitle('操作审计');
  var log = auditLog();
  var vis = visibleLogIds(u);
  if (vis) log = log.filter(function(e){ return vis.indexOf(e.orgId) >= 0; });
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var range = window.AUDIT_RANGE || 0;
  if (range) log = log.filter(function(e){ try{ var d=new Date(e.t); if(isNaN(d.getTime())) return true; return (Date.now()-d.getTime()) <= range*86400000; }catch(x){ return true; } });
  var byAction = {}, byUser = {}, byOrg = {};
  log.forEach(function(e){
    byAction[e.action] = (byAction[e.action]||0)+1;
    byUser[e.name] = (byUser[e.name]||0)+1;
    byOrg[e.orgName||'系统'] = (byOrg[e.orgName||'系统']||0)+1;
  });
  var f = window.AUDIT_FILTER || null;
  var flist = log;
  if (f) flist = log.filter(function(e){
    if (f.action && e.action!==f.action) return false;
    if (f.user && e.name!==f.user) return false;
    if (f.org && (e.orgName||'系统')!==f.org) return false;
    return true;
  });
  var actS = Object.keys(byAction).map(function(k){return {k:k,v:byAction[k]};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.v-a.v;});
  var userS = Object.keys(byUser).map(function(k){return {k:k,v:byUser[k]};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.v-a.v;});
  var orgS  = Object.keys(byOrg).map(function(k){return {k:k,v:byOrg[k]};}).sort(function(a,b){return b.v-a.v;});
  var chip = function(label,obj){
    return '<span onclick="setAuditFilter(' + JSON.stringify(obj).replace(/"/g,'&quot;') + ')" style="cursor:pointer;background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:12px;padding:3px 10px;margin:2px 4px 2px 0;display:inline-block;">' + label + '</span>';
  };
  var rangeChip = function(days,lbl){
    var on = (window.AUDIT_RANGE||0)===days;
    return '<span onclick="setAuditRange('+days+')" style="cursor:pointer;background:'+(on?'var(--c-main);color:#fff':'var(--bg-input)')+';border-radius:12px;padding:3px 10px;margin:2px 4px 2px 0;display:inline-block;">'+lbl+'</span>';
  };
  var scopeTxt = vis ? '本机构及下级机构' : '全省（含超管）';
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>操作审计</h3><p class="mut">记录关键操作（登录/退出/机构/账号/权限/期限/省份/考勤/记录等），可查到操作人、机构与具体内容。当前查看范围：' + scopeTxt + '。<br>点下方操作类型/人员/机构/时间，可分类查看对应明细；点「全部明细」恢复。</p></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>分类统计（点击查看）</h3>';
  h += '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:2px"><b>按操作类型：</b>' + (actS.length?actS.map(function(x){return chip(esc(x.k)+'（'+x.v+'）', {action:x.k});}).join(''):'暂无') + '</div>';
  h += '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:8px"><b>按人员：</b>' + (userS.length?userS.map(function(x){return chip(esc(x.k)+'（'+x.v+'）', {user:x.k});}).join(''):'暂无') + '</div>';
  h += '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:8px"><b>按机构：</b>' + (orgS.length?orgS.map(function(x){return chip(esc(x.k)+'（'+x.v+'）', {org:x.k});}).join(''):'暂无') + '</div>';
  h += '<div style="font-size:12px;margin-top:8px"><b>时间范围：</b>' + rangeChip(7,'近7天') + rangeChip(30,'近30天') + rangeChip(0,'全部') + '</div>';
  h += '<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn gray" onclick="setAuditFilter(null)">全部明细（'+log.length+'条）</button></div>';
  h += '</div>';
  var list = (f?flist:log.slice(-300)).slice().reverse();
  if (!list.length) { h += '<div class="card"><h3>操作明细</h3><div class="empty">暂无审计记录</div></div>'; }
  else {
    var groups = {};
    list.forEach(function(e){ (groups[e.action]=groups[e.action]||[]).push(e); });
    Object.keys(groups).forEach(function(act){
      h += '<div class="card"><h3>'+esc(act)+'（'+groups[act].length+'条）</h3>';
      groups[act].forEach(function(e){
        h += '<div style="background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px;font-size:12px;">'
          + '<b>' + esc(e.name) + '</b>（' + esc(e.orgName||'系统') + '）　' + esc(e.detail||'—')
          + '<div style="color:var(--t3);margin-top:2px">' + esc(e.t) + '</div></div>';
      });
      h += '</div>';
    });
  }
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
}
function setAuditFilter(f){ window.AUDIT_FILTER = f; renderAuditLogPage(); }


function renderSummaryPage() {
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u || (u.role!=='super' && u.role!=='bureauAdmin' && u.role!=='countyAdmin')) { alert('您没有查看数据汇总的权限'); return; }
  var oid;
  if (u.role==='countyAdmin') { oid = u.orgId; window.__SUM_BUREAU = oid; }
  else if (u.role==='bureauAdmin') { oid = u.orgId; window.__SUM_BUREAU = oid; }
  else { oid = (window.__SUM_BUREAU || 0); if (!oid) { oid = firstBureauId(); } }
  if (!oid) { alert('未找到机构'); return; }
  var o = orgById(oid); if (!o) { alert('未找到机构'); return; }
  window.__SUM_BUREAU = oid;
  showPage('orgPage'); setTopTitle('县域局汇总 · ' + o.name);
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel());
  var sel = '';
  if (u.role==='super') {
    var bs = sys.orgs.filter(function(x){ return x.type==='bureau'; });
    sel = '<div style="margin:8px 0">选择地市局：<select id="sumBureau" onchange="sumSelBureau(this.value)">'
      + bs.map(function(x){ return '<option value="'+x.id+'"'+(x.id===oid?' selected':'')+'>'+esc(x.name)+'</option>'; }).join('')
      + '</select></div>';
  }
  var isCounty = (u.role==='countyAdmin');
  var title = isCounty ? (esc(o.name) + ' · 本县数据总览') : (esc(o.name) + ' · 下辖县域局汇总');
  var tip = isCounty ? '本县范围内的人员、测站、考勤、排班、台账、野外数据总览。' : '汇总项目：人员、测站、考勤、排班、台账、野外。超管可查任意市，地市局总管理查本市。';
  setTopTitle(title);
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>' + title + '</h3>'
    + '<p class="mut">' + tip + '</p>'
    + sel
    + '<div style="margin:8px 0">查看：<button class="btn gray" onclick="sumTab(\'all\')">汇总表</button> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="sumTab(\'people\')">人员</button> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="sumTab(\'stations\')">测站</button> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="sumTab(\'kq\')">考勤</button> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="sumTab(\'pb\')">排班</button> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="sumTab(\'tz\')">台账</button> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="sumTab(\'yw\')">野外</button></div>'
    + '<div id="sumBody"></div></div>';
  body.innerHTML = h;
  sumTab('all');
}
function firstBureauId(){ var b=sys.orgs.filter(function(x){ return x.type==='bureau'; }); return b.length? b[0].id : 0; }
function sumSelBureau(v){ window.__SUM_BUREAU=+v; renderSummaryPage(); }
function sumCounties(){ var u=currentUser(); if(u && u.role==='countyAdmin'){ var o=orgById(u.orgId); return o? [o] : []; } var oid=window.__SUM_BUREAU||0; return childrenOf(oid).filter(function(c){ return c.type==='county'; }); }
function orgSum(oid){
  var d=null; try{ d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hydro_v19_'+oid)); }catch(e){}
  if(!d){ return {people:0,stations:0,kq:0,pb:0,tz:0,yw:0,peopleList:[],stationList:[]}; }
  var recs=d.records?d.records.length:0, trips=d.trips?d.trips.length:0, budgetN=d.budget?Object.keys(d.budget).length:0;
  return {
    people:d.people?d.people.length:0,
    stations:d.stations?d.stations.length:0,
    kq:d.entries?Object.keys(d.entries).length:0,
    pb:d.sched?1:0, pbInfo:d.sched?('起'+esc(d.sched.start||'')+' / 值班顺序'+(d.sched.dutyOrder?d.sched.dutyOrder.length:0)+'人'):'未配置',
    tz:budgetN+recs,
    yw:recs+trips,
    peopleList:d.people||[], stationList:d.stations||[], records:d.records||[], trips:d.trips||[], budgetN:budgetN
  };
}
function sumTab(tab){
  var el=document.getElementById('sumBody'); if(!el) return;
  var u=currentUser(); var counties=sumCounties();
  if(!counties.length){ el.innerHTML='<div class="mut">该市暂无可汇总的县域局</div>'; return; }
  var h='';
  if(tab==='all'){
    var sums = counties.map(function(c){ var s=orgSum(c.id); return {name:c.name, s:s}; });
    function barRow(label, f, color){
      var mx = 1;
      sums.forEach(function(x){ if ((x.s[f]||0) > mx) mx = x.s[f]||0; });
      var bars = sums.map(function(x){
        var v = x.s[f]||0;
        return '<div style="flex:1;min-width:0"><div style="background:#E8EDF3;border-radius:3px;height:14px"><div style="width:'+Math.round(v/mx*100)+'%;background:'+color+';height:14px;border-radius:3px"></div></div>'
          + '<div style="font-size:11px;color:#546173;margin-top:1px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">'+esc(x.name)+' '+v+'</div></div>';
      }).join('');
      return '<div style="display:flex;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:6px 0;font-size:13px"><span style="width:40px;flex-shrink:0;color:#1a2332">'+label+'</span>'+bars+'</div>';
    }
    h = '<div class="mut" style="margin-bottom:4px">各指标横向对比（条长按各县最大值归一，色块越长数量越多）</div>'
      + barRow('人员', 'people', '#1565C0')
      + barRow('测站', 'stations', '#2E7D32')
      + barRow('台账', 'tz', '#E65100')
      + barRow('野外', 'yw', '#6A1B9A')
      + '<table style="table-layout:fixed;width:100%;margin-top:10px"><colgroup><col style="width:22%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:13%"><col style="width:13%"></colgroup>'
      + '<tr><th>县域局</th><th>人员</th><th>测站</th><th>考勤记录</th><th>排班</th><th>台账</th><th>野外</th></tr>';
    sums.forEach(function(x){
      var s=x.s;
      h+='<tr><td>'+esc(x.name)+'</td><td>'+s.people+'</td><td>'+s.stations+'</td><td>'+s.kq+'</td>'
        +'<td>'+s.pb+'</td><td>'+s.tz+'</td><td>'+s.yw+'</td></tr>';
    });
    h+='</table><p class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">数值为该县域局对应业务的数据量；点上方各项目标签可查看明细。</p>';
  } else if(tab==='people'){
    h='<h4 style="margin:4px 0">人员汇总</h4>';
    counties.forEach(function(c){ var s=orgSum(c.id); h+='<div style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>'+esc(c.name)+'（'+s.people+'人）</b><div style="font-size:13px;color:#333">'+s.peopleList.map(function(p){return esc(p.name)+(p.role?'（'+esc(p.role)+'）':'');}).join('、')||'无人员'+'</div></div>'; });
  } else if(tab==='stations'){
    h='<h4 style="margin:4px 0">测站汇总</h4>';
    counties.forEach(function(c){ var s=orgSum(c.id); h+='<div style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>'+esc(c.name)+'（'+s.stations+'站）</b><div style="font-size:13px;color:#333">'+s.stationList.join('、')||'无测站'+'</div></div>'; });
  } else if(tab==='kq'){
    h='<h4 style="margin:4px 0">考勤汇总（考勤记录条数）</h4>';
    counties.forEach(function(c){ var s=orgSum(c.id); h+='<div style="margin-bottom:4px"><b>'+esc(c.name)+'</b>：'+s.kq+' 条考勤记录</div>'; });
  } else if(tab==='pb'){
    h='<h4 style="margin:4px 0">排班汇总</h4>';
    counties.forEach(function(c){ var s=orgSum(c.id); h+='<div style="margin-bottom:4px"><b>'+esc(c.name)+'</b>：'+s.pbInfo+'</div>'; });
  } else if(tab==='tz'){
    h='<h4 style="margin:4px 0">台账汇总（预算项+记录数）</h4>';
    counties.forEach(function(c){ var s=orgSum(c.id); h+='<div style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>'+esc(c.name)+'（'+s.tz+'条）</b><div style="font-size:13px;color:#333">'+(s.records||[]).map(function(r){return esc(r.type||'记录')+':'+esc(r.date||'');}).join('、')||'无台账'+'</div></div>'; });
  } else if(tab==='yw'){
    h='<h4 style="margin:4px 0">野外汇总（野外/出差记录数）</h4>';
    counties.forEach(function(c){ var s=orgSum(c.id); h+='<div style="margin-bottom:6px"><b>'+esc(c.name)+'（'+s.yw+'条）</b><div style="font-size:13px;color:#333">'+((s.trips||[]).map(function(t){return '出差:'+esc(t.date||'');})).join('、')||'无野外记录'+'</div></div>'; });
  }
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function renderDataExport() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!isManage(u)) { alert('仅各级机构管理员可导出/导入数据'); return; }
  showPage('orgPage'); setTopTitle('数据导出 / 导入');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var bureaus = sys.orgs.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='bureau'; });
  var provDept = sys.orgs.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='dept' && o.pid===0; });
  var opts = '<option value="0">全部机构</option>';
  if (provDept.length) opts += '<option value="prov">省局直属</option>';
  bureaus.forEach(function(o){ opts += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; });
  var lastBk = null; try { lastBk = localStorage.getItem('hydro_last_backup'); } catch(e){}
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>数据导出 / 导入</h3><p class="mut">可分类（机构 / 人员 / 台账 / 全部）、按区域（省局直属 / 地市局 / 县局）导出数据为 JSON 文件；导入用于恢复数据。</p>'
    + (lastBk ? '<p class="mut" style="margin-top:4px;color:#2E7D32">上次备份时间：'+esc(lastBk)+'</p>' : '<p class="mut" style="margin-top:4px;color:#E65100">尚未备份过：建议先点「导出」保存一份，防止数据丢失。</p>')
    + '<div style="margin-top:8px"><b>① 选择导出区域：</b><select id="expScope">'+opts+'</select> '
    + '<span class="mut">选某地市局即含其下各县域局、市局科室</span></div>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:8px"><b>② 选择导出类别：</b><select id="expCat">'
    + '<option value="all">全部数据</option><option value="org">机构数据</option><option value="user">人员数据</option><option value="daily">台账 / 日常业务数据</option>'
    + '</select></div>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" onclick="doExport()">导出（下载 JSON 文件）</button></div>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:18px"><b>③ 导入数据：</b><input type="file" id="impFile" accept=".json" onchange="doImport(this)" style="font-size:13px"></div>'
    + '<p class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">导入会覆盖对应区域 / 类别的现有数据，导入前建议先导出备份。</p></div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
}
function collectScopeOrgIds(v){
  var ids=[];
  var vis=visibleOrgs(currentUser());
  if (v==='0' || !v) { vis.forEach(function(o){ ids.push(o.id); }); }
  else if (v==='prov') { vis.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='dept' && o.pid===0; }).forEach(function(o){ ids.push(o.id); }); }
  else { var bid=+v; ids.push(bid); vis.filter(function(o){ return o.pid===bid; }).forEach(function(o){ ids.push(o.id); }); }
  return ids;
}
function doExport(){
  var v=document.getElementById('expScope').value;
  var cat=document.getElementById('expCat').value;
  var ids=collectScopeOrgIds(v);
  var data={};
  if (cat==='org'||cat==='all') data.orgs=sys.orgs.filter(function(o){ return ids.indexOf(o.id)>=0; });
  if (cat==='user'||cat==='all') data.users=sys.users.filter(function(x){ return ids.indexOf(x.orgId)>=0; });
  if (cat==='daily'||cat==='all'){ data.daily={}; ids.forEach(function(id){ try{ var d=JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem('hydro_v19_'+id)); if(d) data.daily[id]=d; }catch(e){} }); }
  if (cat==='all'){ data.provinces=sys.provinces||[]; data.trial=sys.trial||{}; data.perms=sys.perms||{}; data.notices=sys.notices||[]; data.config=sys.config||{}; }
  var payload={ type:'hydro_export', version:1, exportTime:new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN'), scope:v, categories:cat, data:data };
  var blob=new Blob([JSON.stringify(payload,null,2)],{type:'application/json'});
  var a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  var nm = v==='prov'?'省局直属':(v==='0'?'全部':(orgById(+v)?orgById(+v).name:'区域'));
  a.download='水文数据_'+nm+'_'+new Date().toISOString().slice(0,10)+'.json';
  document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); document.body.removeChild(a);
  recordAudit('数据导出','导出 '+nm+' / '+(cat==='all'?'全部':cat)+' 数据','admin');
  toast('已导出 '+nm+' 数据');
  try { localStorage.setItem('hydro_last_backup', new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN')); } catch(e){}
}
function doImport(input){
  var f=input.files[0]; if(!f) return;
  var reader=new FileReader();
  reader.onload=function(){
    try{
      var p=JSON.parse(reader.result);
      if(p.type!=='hydro_export'){ alert('不是本系统的导出文件'); input.value=''; return; }
      if(!confirm('确认导入该文件？将覆盖对应区域/类别的现有数据。')){ input.value=''; return; }
      applyImport(p);
      toast('导入完成'); input.value='';
    }catch(e){ alert('导入失败：'+e.message); input.value=''; }
  };
  reader.readAsText(f);
}



function renderGlobalConfigPage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!isSuper(u)) { alert('仅超管可配置全局参数'); return; }
  showPage('orgPage'); setTopTitle('全局配置');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var cfg = sys.config = sys.config || {};
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>全局配置（数据字典 / 基础参数）</h3><p class="mut">统一配置全省考勤、排班等基础参数，各机构默认沿用。</p>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>每月可请年假(天)</label><input id="gALW" type="number" min="0" value="'+(cfg.alw!=null?cfg.alw:30)+'" style="width:120px"></div>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>午休时长(分钟)</label><input id="gMEAL" type="number" min="0" value="'+(cfg.meal!=null?cfg.meal:40)+'" style="width:120px"></div>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>加班分钟起点</label><input id="gOT" type="number" min="0" value="'+(cfg.otMin!=null?cfg.otMin:4)+'" style="width:120px"></div>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>默认上班时间</label><input id="gIn" value="'+(cfg.onTime||'09:00')+'" placeholder="09:00" style="width:120px"></div>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>默认下班时间</label><input id="gOut" value="'+(cfg.offTime||'18:00')+'" placeholder="18:00" style="width:120px"></div>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>默认登录有效期至</label><input id="gTrial" value="'+(cfg.trialEnd||'2027-07-01')+'" placeholder="YYYY-MM-DD" style="width:120px"></div>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" onclick="saveGlobalConfig()">保存全局配置</button></div></div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
}
function saveGlobalConfig(){
  var cfg = sys.config = sys.config || {};
  cfg.alw = +document.getElementById('gALW').value || 30;
  cfg.meal = +document.getElementById('gMEAL').value || 40;
  cfg.otMin = +document.getElementById('gOT').value || 4;
  cfg.onTime = document.getElementById('gIn').value.trim() || '09:00';
  cfg.offTime = document.getElementById('gOut').value.trim() || '18:00';
  var t = document.getElementById('gTrial').value.trim();
  if(/^\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}$/.test(t)) cfg.trialEnd = t;
  saveSys(); recordAudit('全局配置','保存全局基础参数','admin'); toast('全局配置已保存');
}
function renderPwdResetPage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!isManage(u)) { alert('仅各级机构管理员可重置密码'); return; }
  showPage('orgPage'); setTopTitle('密码重置 / 批量改密');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var vis = visibleOrgs(u);
  var bureaus = vis.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='bureau'; });
  var provDept = vis.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='dept' && o.pid===0; });
  var opts = '<option value="0">全部机构</option>';
  if (provDept.length) opts += '<option value="prov">省局直属</option>';
  bureaus.forEach(function(o){ opts += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; });
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>密码重置</h3><p class="mut">选机构后列出人员，可重置单个账号密码（默认 123456）或批量重置该机构全部账号。</p>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:8px"><b>选择机构：</b><select id="pwdScope">'+opts+'</select> '
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="renderPwdList()">列出人员</button></div>'
    + '<div id="pwdList" style="margin-top:10px"></div>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn" onclick="batchResetPwd()">批量重置当前机构全部账号（为 123456）</button></div></div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
}
function pwdScopeIds(){
  var v=document.getElementById('pwdScope').value;
  var vis=visibleOrgs(currentUser());
  var ids=[];
  if(v==='0'||!v){ vis.forEach(function(o){ids.push(o.id);}); }
  else if(v==='prov'){ vis.filter(function(o){return o.type==='dept'&&o.pid===0;}).forEach(function(o){ids.push(o.id);}); }
  else { var bid=+v; ids.push(bid); vis.filter(function(o){return o.pid===bid;}).forEach(function(o){ids.push(o.id);}); }
  return ids;
}
function renderPwdList(){
  var el=document.getElementById('pwdList'); if(!el) return;
  var ids=pwdScopeIds();
  var people=sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.status==='active' && x.role!=='super' && ids.indexOf(x.orgId)>=0; });
  if(!people.length){ el.innerHTML='<div class="mut">该范围暂无人员</div>'; return; }
  var h='<table style="table-layout:fixed;width:100%"><colgroup><col style="width:24%"><col style="width:28%"><col style="width:48%"></colgroup><tr><th>姓名</th><th>机构</th><th>操作</th></tr>';
  people.forEach(function(x){
    var o=orgById(x.orgId);
    h+='<tr><td>'+esc(x.name)+'</td><td>'+esc(o?o.name:'?')+'</td>'
      +'<td><button class="btn gray" onclick="resetOnePwd('+x.id+')">重置为 123456</button> <button class="btn gray" onclick="setCustomPwd('+x.id+')">自定义密码</button></td></tr>';
  });
  el.innerHTML=h;
}
function resetOnePwd(uid){
  if(!confirm('确认将该账号密码重置为 123456？')) return;
  var x=userById(uid); if(!x) return;
  x.pwd='123456'; saveSys();
  recordAudit('密码重置','重置 '+x.name+' 密码为默认','admin'); toast('已重置 '+x.name+' 密码');
}
function setCustomPwd(uid){
  var v=prompt('请输入新密码（至少6位）：','');
  if(!v||v.length<6){ alert('密码至少6位'); return; }
  var x=userById(uid); if(!x) return;
  x.pwd=v; saveSys();
  recordAudit('密码重置','修改 '+x.name+' 密码','admin'); toast('已修改 '+x.name+' 密码');
}
function batchResetPwd(){
  var ids=pwdScopeIds();
  var people=sys.users.filter(function(x){ return x.status==='active' && x.role!=='super' && ids.indexOf(x.orgId)>=0; });
  if(!people.length){ alert('该范围无人员'); return; }
  if(!confirm('确认将当前机构范围内 '+people.length+' 个账号全部重置为 123456？')) return;
  people.forEach(function(x){ x.pwd='123456'; });
  saveSys(); recordAudit('密码重置','批量重置 '+people.length+' 个账号为默认密码','admin'); toast('已批量重置 '+people.length+' 个账号');
}
function renderNoticePage() {
  adminView='sub';
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!isManage(u)) { alert('仅各级机构管理员可发布通知'); return; }
  showPage('orgPage'); setTopTitle('系统通知 / 公告');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var vis = visibleOrgs(u);
  var bureaus = vis.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='bureau'; });
  var opts = '<option value="0">全部机构</option>';
  var provDept = vis.filter(function(o){ return o.type==='dept' && o.pid===0; });
  if (provDept.length) opts += '<option value="prov">省局直属</option>';
  bureaus.forEach(function(o){ opts += '<option value="'+o.id+'">'+esc(o.name)+'</option>'; });
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>发布通知</h3><p class="mut">给所选范围的机构发布公告（发布后各机构登录可见）。</p>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>发布范围</label><select id="noticeScope" onchange="renderNoticeQuick()">'+opts+'</select></div>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>标题</label><input id="noticeTitle" placeholder="通知标题" style="flex:1;background:var(--bg-input)!important;color:var(--t1)!important;border:1px solid var(--border)!important"></div>'
    + '<div class="row"><label>内容</label><textarea id="noticeBody" rows="3" style="flex:1;background:var(--bg-input)!important;color:var(--t1)!important;border:1px solid var(--border)!important" placeholder="通知内容"></textarea></div>'
    + '<div><button class="btn" onclick="publishNotice()">发布</button></div>'
    + '<div id="noticeQuick" style="margin-top:10px;padding-top:10px;border-top:1px dashed var(--border)"></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>已发布通知</h3><div id="noticeList"></div></div>';
  h = bkBar(bkTarget(), bkLabel()) + h;
  body.innerHTML = h;
  renderNoticeList();
  renderNoticeQuick();
}
function publishNotice(){
  var scope=document.getElementById('noticeScope').value;
  var title=(document.getElementById('noticeTitle').value||'').trim();
  var body=(document.getElementById('noticeBody').value||'').trim();
  if(!title){ alert('请填通知标题'); return; }
  if(!sys.notices) sys.notices=[];
  sys.notices.push({ id: Date.now(), title: title, body: body, scope: scope, scopeName: scopeName(scope), by: currentUser()?currentUser().name:'超管', time: new Date().toLocaleString('zh-CN') });
  saveSys(); renderNoticeList();
  document.getElementById('noticeTitle').value=''; document.getElementById('noticeBody').value='';
  recordAudit('通知公告','发布通知：'+title+'（'+scopeName(scope)+'）','admin'); toast('通知已发布');
}
function scopeName(v){ return v==='prov'?'省局直属':(v==='0'||!v?'全部机构':(orgById(+v)?orgById(+v).name:'全部')); }

function quickOrgTarget(){
  var s=document.getElementById('noticeScope'); var v=s? s.value:'0';
  return (v!=='0'&&v!=='prov') ? +v : 0;
}
function renderNoticeQuick(){
  var el=document.getElementById('noticeQuick'); if(!el) return;
  var oid=quickOrgTarget();
  var o=oid?orgById(oid):null;
  if(!o){ el.innerHTML='<div class="mut">发布范围为省局直属或全部机构时，快捷操作作用于对应范围（进入/管理）。</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML='<b>针对部门快捷操作 · '+esc(o.name)+'</b>'
    + '<div style="margin-top:6px;display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:8px">'
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="qoOrgView('+oid+')">进入该机构</button>'
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="qoStaff('+oid+')">人员账号</button>'
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="qoPerm('+oid+')">权限设置</button>'
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="qoTrial('+oid+')">期限设置</button>'
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="qoPwd('+oid+')">密码重置</button></div>';
}
function qoOrgView(oid){ renderEnterOrgPage(); setTimeout(function(){ var s=document.getElementById('enterOrgSel'); if(s){ s.value=String(oid); renderEnterOrgSub(); } },80); }
function qoStaff(oid){ renderStaffManage(); }
function qoPerm(oid){ renderPermManage(); }
function qoTrial(oid){ renderTrialPage(); setTimeout(function(){ var o=orgById(oid); var bid=0; if(o){ if(o.type==='bureau') bid=oid; else if(o.pid){ var po=orgById(o.pid); bid=(po&&po.type==='bureau')?o.pid:(po&&po.pid?po.pid:0); } } var s=document.getElementById('trialBureauSel'); if(s){ s.value=String(bid); renderTrialBureauDetail(); } },80); }
function qoPwd(oid){ renderPwdResetPage(); setTimeout(function(){ var s=document.getElementById('pwdScope'); if(s && s.querySelector('option[value="'+oid+'"]')){ s.value=String(oid); renderPwdList(); } },80); }
function renderNoticeList(){
  var el=document.getElementById('noticeList'); if(!el) return;
  var list=(sys.notices||[]).slice().reverse();
  if(!list.length){ el.innerHTML='<div class="mut">暂无通知</div>'; return; }
  el.innerHTML=list.map(function(n){
    return '<div style="background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:8px;margin-bottom:6px">'
      + '<b>'+esc(n.title)+'</b> <span class="mut">（'+esc(n.scopeName)+'）</span>'
      + '<div style="font-size:13px;margin:4px 0">'+esc(n.body)+'</div>'
      + '<div style="color:var(--t3);font-size:12px">'+esc(n.by)+' · '+esc(n.time)+' <button class="btn del" style="margin-left:8px;font-size:12px" onclick="delNotice('+n.id+')">删除</button></div></div>';
  }).join('');
}
function delNotice(id){
  if(!confirm('确认删除该通知？')) return;
  sys.notices=(sys.notices||[]).filter(function(n){ return n.id!==id; });
  saveSys(); renderNoticeList(); recordAudit('通知公告','删除通知 #'+id,'admin');
}
function applyImport(p){
  var d=p.data||{};
  var needSave=false;
  if(d.orgs){ d.orgs.forEach(function(o){ var ex=null; for(var i=0;i<sys.orgs.length;i++){ if(sys.orgs[i].id===o.id){ ex=sys.orgs[i]; break; } } if(ex) Object.assign(ex,o); else sys.orgs.push(o); }); needSave=true; }
  if(d.users){ d.users.forEach(function(x){ var ex=null; for(var i=0;i<sys.users.length;i++){ if(sys.users[i].id===x.id){ ex=sys.users[i]; break; } } if(ex) Object.assign(ex,x); else sys.users.push(x); }); needSave=true; }
  if(d.daily){ Object.keys(d.daily).forEach(function(id){ try{ localStorage.setItem('hydro_v19_'+id, JSON.stringify(d.daily[id])); }catch(e){} }); }
  if(d.provinces){ sys.provinces=d.provinces; needSave=true; }
  if(d.trial){ sys.trial=d.trial; needSave=true; }
  if(d.perms){ sys.perms=d.perms; needSave=true; }
  if(d.notices){ sys.notices=d.notices; needSave=true; }
  if(d.config){ sys.config=d.config; needSave=true; }
  if(needSave) saveSys();
  recordAudit('数据导入','导入数据文件（'+((p.scope==='prov')?'省局直属':(p.scope==='0'?'全部':(orgById(+p.scope)?orgById(+p.scope).name:'区域')))+'）','admin');
}
function setAuditRange(r){ window.AUDIT_RANGE = +r; renderAuditLogPage(); }function setAuditFilter(f){ window.AUDIT_FILTER = f; renderAuditLogPage(); }

var qrcode = function() {

  //---------------------------------------------------------------------
  // qrcode
  //---------------------------------------------------------------------

  /**
   * qrcode
   * @param typeNumber 1 to 40
   * @param errorCorrectionLevel 'L','M','Q','H'
   */
  var qrcode = function(typeNumber, errorCorrectionLevel) {

    var PAD0 = 0xEC;
    var PAD1 = 0x11;

    var _typeNumber = typeNumber;
    var _errorCorrectionLevel = QRErrorCorrectionLevel[errorCorrectionLevel];
    var _modules = null;
    var _moduleCount = 0;
    var _dataCache = null;
    var _dataList = [];

    var _this = {};

    var makeImpl = function(test, maskPattern) {

      _moduleCount = _typeNumber * 4 + 17;
      _modules = function(moduleCount) {
        var modules = new Array(moduleCount);
        for (var row = 0; row < moduleCount; row += 1) {
          modules[row] = new Array(moduleCount);
          for (var col = 0; col < moduleCount; col += 1) {
            modules[row][col] = null;
          }
        }
        return modules;
      }(_moduleCount);

      setupPositionProbePattern(0, 0);
      setupPositionProbePattern(_moduleCount - 7, 0);
      setupPositionProbePattern(0, _moduleCount - 7);
      setupPositionAdjustPattern();
      setupTimingPattern();
      setupTypeInfo(test, maskPattern);

      if (_typeNumber >= 7) {
        setupTypeNumber(test);
      }

      if (_dataCache == null) {
        _dataCache = createData(_typeNumber, _errorCorrectionLevel, _dataList);
      }

      mapData(_dataCache, maskPattern);
    };

    var setupPositionProbePattern = function(row, col) {

      for (var r = -1; r <= 7; r += 1) {

        if (row + r <= -1 || _moduleCount <= row + r) continue;

        for (var c = -1; c <= 7; c += 1) {

          if (col + c <= -1 || _moduleCount <= col + c) continue;

          if ( (0 <= r && r <= 6 && (c == 0 || c == 6) )
              || (0 <= c && c <= 6 && (r == 0 || r == 6) )
              || (2 <= r && r <= 4 && 2 <= c && c <= 4) ) {
            _modules[row + r][col + c] = true;
          } else {
            _modules[row + r][col + c] = false;
          }
        }
      }
    };

    var getBestMaskPattern = function() {

      var minLostPoint = 0;
      var pattern = 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < 8; i += 1) {

        makeImpl(true, i);

        var lostPoint = QRUtil.getLostPoint(_this);

        if (i == 0 || minLostPoint > lostPoint) {
          minLostPoint = lostPoint;
          pattern = i;
        }
      }

      return pattern;
    };

    var setupTimingPattern = function() {

      for (var r = 8; r < _moduleCount - 8; r += 1) {
        if (_modules[r][6] != null) {
          continue;
        }
        _modules[r][6] = (r % 2 == 0);
      }

      for (var c = 8; c < _moduleCount - 8; c += 1) {
        if (_modules[6][c] != null) {
          continue;
        }
        _modules[6][c] = (c % 2 == 0);
      }
    };

    var setupPositionAdjustPattern = function() {

      var pos = QRUtil.getPatternPosition(_typeNumber);

      for (var i = 0; i < pos.length; i += 1) {

        for (var j = 0; j < pos.length; j += 1) {

          var row = pos[i];
          var col = pos[j];

          if (_modules[row][col] != null) {
            continue;
          }

          for (var r = -2; r <= 2; r += 1) {

            for (var c = -2; c <= 2; c += 1) {

              if (r == -2 || r == 2 || c == -2 || c == 2
                  || (r == 0 && c == 0) ) {
                _modules[row + r][col + c] = true;
              } else {
                _modules[row + r][col + c] = false;
              }
            }
          }
        }
      }
    };

    var setupTypeNumber = function(test) {

      var bits = QRUtil.getBCHTypeNumber(_typeNumber);

      for (var i = 0; i < 18; i += 1) {
        var mod = (!test && ( (bits >> i) & 1) == 1);
        _modules[Math.floor(i / 3)][i % 3 + _moduleCount - 8 - 3] = mod;
      }

      for (var i = 0; i < 18; i += 1) {
        var mod = (!test && ( (bits >> i) & 1) == 1);
        _modules[i % 3 + _moduleCount - 8 - 3][Math.floor(i / 3)] = mod;
      }
    };

    var setupTypeInfo = function(test, maskPattern) {

      var data = (_errorCorrectionLevel << 3) | maskPattern;
      var bits = QRUtil.getBCHTypeInfo(data);

      // vertical
      for (var i = 0; i < 15; i += 1) {

        var mod = (!test && ( (bits >> i) & 1) == 1);

        if (i < 6) {
          _modules[i][8] = mod;
        } else if (i < 8) {
          _modules[i + 1][8] = mod;
        } else {
          _modules[_moduleCount - 15 + i][8] = mod;
        }
      }

      // horizontal
      for (var i = 0; i < 15; i += 1) {

        var mod = (!test && ( (bits >> i) & 1) == 1);

        if (i < 8) {
          _modules[8][_moduleCount - i - 1] = mod;
        } else if (i < 9) {
          _modules[8][15 - i - 1 + 1] = mod;
        } else {
          _modules[8][15 - i - 1] = mod;
        }
      }

      // fixed module
      _modules[_moduleCount - 8][8] = (!test);
    };

    var mapData = function(data, maskPattern) {

      var inc = -1;
      var row = _moduleCount - 1;
      var bitIndex = 7;
      var byteIndex = 0;
      var maskFunc = QRUtil.getMaskFunction(maskPattern);

      for (var col = _moduleCount - 1; col > 0; col -= 2) {

        if (col == 6) col -= 1;

        while (true) {

          for (var c = 0; c < 2; c += 1) {

            if (_modules[row][col - c] == null) {

              var dark = false;

              if (byteIndex < data.length) {
                dark = ( ( (data[byteIndex] >>> bitIndex) & 1) == 1);
              }

              var mask = maskFunc(row, col - c);

              if (mask) {
                dark = !dark;
              }

              _modules[row][col - c] = dark;
              bitIndex -= 1;

              if (bitIndex == -1) {
                byteIndex += 1;
                bitIndex = 7;
              }
            }
          }

          row += inc;

          if (row < 0 || _moduleCount <= row) {
            row -= inc;
            inc = -inc;
            break;
          }
        }
      }
    };

    var createBytes = function(buffer, rsBlocks) {

      var offset = 0;

      var maxDcCount = 0;
      var maxEcCount = 0;

      var dcdata = new Array(rsBlocks.length);
      var ecdata = new Array(rsBlocks.length);

      for (var r = 0; r < rsBlocks.length; r += 1) {

        var dcCount = rsBlocks[r].dataCount;
        var ecCount = rsBlocks[r].totalCount - dcCount;

        maxDcCount = Math.max(maxDcCount, dcCount);
        maxEcCount = Math.max(maxEcCount, ecCount);

        dcdata[r] = new Array(dcCount);

        for (var i = 0; i < dcdata[r].length; i += 1) {
          dcdata[r][i] = 0xff & buffer.getBuffer()[i + offset];
        }
        offset += dcCount;

        var rsPoly = QRUtil.getErrorCorrectPolynomial(ecCount);
        var rawPoly = qrPolynomial(dcdata[r], rsPoly.getLength() - 1);

        var modPoly = rawPoly.mod(rsPoly);
        ecdata[r] = new Array(rsPoly.getLength() - 1);
        for (var i = 0; i < ecdata[r].length; i += 1) {
          var modIndex = i + modPoly.getLength() - ecdata[r].length;
          ecdata[r][i] = (modIndex >= 0)? modPoly.getAt(modIndex) : 0;
        }
      }

      var totalCodeCount = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < rsBlocks.length; i += 1) {
        totalCodeCount += rsBlocks[i].totalCount;
      }

      var data = new Array(totalCodeCount);
      var index = 0;

      for (var i = 0; i < maxDcCount; i += 1) {
        for (var r = 0; r < rsBlocks.length; r += 1) {
          if (i < dcdata[r].length) {
            data[index] = dcdata[r][i];
            index += 1;
          }
        }
      }

      for (var i = 0; i < maxEcCount; i += 1) {
        for (var r = 0; r < rsBlocks.length; r += 1) {
          if (i < ecdata[r].length) {
            data[index] = ecdata[r][i];
            index += 1;
          }
        }
      }

      return data;
    };

    var createData = function(typeNumber, errorCorrectionLevel, dataList) {

      var rsBlocks = QRRSBlock.getRSBlocks(typeNumber, errorCorrectionLevel);

      var buffer = qrBitBuffer();

      for (var i = 0; i < dataList.length; i += 1) {
        var data = dataList[i];
        buffer.put(data.getMode(), 4);
        buffer.put(data.getLength(), QRUtil.getLengthInBits(data.getMode(), typeNumber) );
        data.write(buffer);
      }

      // calc num max data.
      var totalDataCount = 0;
      for (var i = 0; i < rsBlocks.length; i += 1) {
        totalDataCount += rsBlocks[i].dataCount;
      }

      if (buffer.getLengthInBits() > totalDataCount * 8) {
        throw 'code length overflow. ('
          + buffer.getLengthInBits()
          + '>'
          + totalDataCount * 8
          + ')';
      }

      // end code
      if (buffer.getLengthInBits() + 4 <= totalDataCount * 8) {
        buffer.put(0, 4);
      }

      // padding
      while (buffer.getLengthInBits() % 8 != 0) {
        buffer.putBit(false);
      }

      // padding
      while (true) {

        if (buffer.getLengthInBits() >= totalDataCount * 8) {
          break;
        }
        buffer.put(PAD0, 8);

        if (buffer.getLengthInBits() >= totalDataCount * 8) {
          break;
        }
        buffer.put(PAD1, 8);
      }

      return createBytes(buffer, rsBlocks);
    };

    _this.addData = function(data, mode) {

      mode = mode || 'Byte';

      var newData = null;

      switch(mode) {
      case 'Numeric' :
        newData = qrNumber(data);
        break;
      case 'Alphanumeric' :
        newData = qrAlphaNum(data);
        break;
      case 'Byte' :
        newData = qr8BitByte(data);
        break;
      case 'Kanji' :
        newData = qrKanji(data);
        break;
      default :
        throw 'mode:' + mode;
      }

      _dataList.push(newData);
      _dataCache = null;
    };

    _this.isDark = function(row, col) {
      if (row < 0 || _moduleCount <= row || col < 0 || _moduleCount <= col) {
        throw row + ',' + col;
      }
      return _modules[row][col];
    };

    _this.getModuleCount = function() {
      return _moduleCount;
    };

    _this.make = function() {
      if (_typeNumber < 1) {
        var typeNumber = 1;

        for (; typeNumber < 40; typeNumber++) {
          var rsBlocks = QRRSBlock.getRSBlocks(typeNumber, _errorCorrectionLevel);
          var buffer = qrBitBuffer();

          for (var i = 0; i < _dataList.length; i++) {
            var data = _dataList[i];
            buffer.put(data.getMode(), 4);
            buffer.put(data.getLength(), QRUtil.getLengthInBits(data.getMode(), typeNumber) );
            data.write(buffer);
          }

          var totalDataCount = 0;
          for (var i = 0; i < rsBlocks.length; i++) {
            totalDataCount += rsBlocks[i].dataCount;
          }

          if (buffer.getLengthInBits() <= totalDataCount * 8) {
            break;
          }
        }

        _typeNumber = typeNumber;
      }

      makeImpl(false, getBestMaskPattern() );
    };

    _this.createTableTag = function(cellSize, margin) {

      cellSize = cellSize || 2;
      margin = (typeof margin == 'undefined')? cellSize * 4 : margin;

      var qrHtml = '';

      qrHtml += '<table style="';
      qrHtml += ' border-width: 0px; border-style: none;';
      qrHtml += ' border-collapse: collapse;';
      qrHtml += ' padding: 0px; margin: ' + margin + 'px;';
      qrHtml += '">';
      qrHtml += '<tbody>';

      for (var r = 0; r < _this.getModuleCount(); r += 1) {

        qrHtml += '<tr>';

        for (var c = 0; c < _this.getModuleCount(); c += 1) {

  var QRMath = function() {

    for (var i = 8; i < 256; i += 1) {
      EXP_TABLE[i] = EXP_TABLE[i - 4]
        ^ EXP_TABLE[i - 5]
        ^ EXP_TABLE[i - 6]
        ^ EXP_TABLE[i - 8];

      LOG_TABLE[EXP_TABLE[i] ] = i;

        throw 'glog(' + n + ')';
      }

      return LOG_TABLE[n];
    };

    _this.gexp = function(n) {

      while (n < 0) {
        n += 255;
      }

      while (n >= 256) {
        n -= 255;
      }

      return EXP_TABLE[n];
    };

    return _this;
  }();

      return qrPolynomial(num, 0);

      var ratio = QRMath.glog(_this.getAt(0) ) - QRMath.glog(e.getAt(0) );

  add('河长(km)',st.length);

  add('中水水位(m)',wl.mid);

function qrFindStation(name){
  name=String(name||'').trim(); if(!name)return null;

  for(var i=0;i<localStorage.length;i++){var k=localStorage.key(i);if(k&&k.indexOf('ylt_data')===0&&keys.indexOf(k)<0)keys.push(k);}
