  try{ cur=localStorage.getItem('hs_curStation')||''; }catch(e){}
  var h='<div class="card"><h3>年报报表</h3>'
    +'<div style="display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center">'
    +'<label>站点 <select id="anStation" onchange="anYears()"></select></label>'
    +'<label>年份 <select id="anYear" onchange="renderAnnual()"></select></label>'
    +'<button class="btn" onclick="renderAnnual()">统计</button>'
    +'<button class="btn gray" onclick="anPrint()">🖨 打印 / 另存PDF</button>'
    +'</div><p class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">数据取自数据中心逐日柜：水位、逐日流量、雨量、蒸发、水温；缺测日不参与统计。</p></div>'
    +'<div id="anOut"></div>';
  body.innerHTML=h;
  var sel=$('anStation');
  sts.forEach(function(s){ var o=document.createElement('option'); o.value=s.name; o.textContent=s.name+(s.category?'（'+s.category+'）':''); sel.appendChild(o); });
  if(cur){ for(var i=0;i<sel.options.length;i++) if(sel.options[i].value===cur){ sel.selectedIndex=i; break; } }
  anYears(); renderAnnual();
}
function anYears(){
  var st=anSt(), ys={};
  if(st){
    if(st.years) Object.keys(st.years).forEach(function(y){ ys[y]=1; });
    if(st.hist) AN_SERIES.forEach(function(sr){ var hh=st.hist[sr.cat]||{}; Object.keys(hh).forEach(function(y){ if(annualRecHas(hh[y])) ys[y]=1; }); });
  }
  ys[String(new Date().getFullYear())]=1;
  var arr=Object.keys(ys).sort(), sel=$('anYear'), keep=sel?sel.value:'';
  if(sel) sel.innerHTML=arr.map(function(y){ return '<option'+(y===keep?' selected':'')+'>'+y+'</option>'; }).join('');
}
function anStats(st,cat,y){
  var rec=st.hist&&st.hist[cat]&&st.hist[cat][y], g=rec&&rec.daily;
  var months=[], allV=[], allD=[];
  for(var m=1;m<=12;m++){
    var sum=0,cnt=0,max=-1e30,min=1e30,maxD='',minD='',dim=anDim(y,m);
    for(var d=1;d<=dim;d++){
      var v=g&&g[m-1]?anNum(g[m-1][d]):NaN;
      if(!isNaN(v)){ sum+=v; cnt++; allV.push(v); allD.push(m+'-'+d); if(v>max){max=v;maxD=m+'月'+d+'日';} if(v<min){min=v;minD=m+'月'+d+'日';} }
    }
    months.push({mean:cnt?sum/cnt:NaN,sum:cnt?sum:NaN,cnt:cnt,max:cnt?max:NaN,min:cnt?min:NaN,maxD:maxD,minD:minD});
  }
  var yr={mean:NaN,sum:NaN,cnt:0,max:NaN,min:NaN,maxD:'',minD:''};
  if(allV.length){
    var s=0,imax=0,imin=0;
    for(var i=0;i<allV.length;i++){ s+=allV[i]; if(allV[i]>allV[imax])imax=i; if(allV[i]<allV[imin])imin=i; }
    yr.sum=s; yr.mean=s/allV.length; yr.cnt=allV.length;
    yr.max=allV[imax]; yr.maxD=allD[imax].split('-')[0]+'月'+allD[imax].split('-')[1]+'日';
    yr.min=allV[imin]; yr.minD=allD[imin].split('-')[0]+'月'+allD[imin].split('-')[1]+'日';
  }
  return {months:months,year:yr};
}
function anFmt(v,p){ if(v==null||isNaN(v)) return '—'; if(p==='q'){ var a=Math.abs(v); if(a>=100) return String(Math.round(v)); if(a>=10) return v.toFixed(1); return v.toFixed(2); } return v.toFixed(p); }
function anTableHtml(ser,st,print){
  var stats=anStats(st,ser.cat,$('anYear').value), mo=stats.months, yr=stats.year, p=ser.p, lvl=ser.mode==='level';
  var h='<table class="anTb"><thead><tr><th>月份</th>';
  if(lvl){ h+='<th>平均'+ser.unit+'</th><th>最高'+ser.unit+'</th><th>日期</th><th>最低'+ser.unit+'</th><th>日期</th>'; if(ser.cat==='qday') h+='<th>径流量(亿m³)</th>'; }
  else { h+='<th>月'+(ser.cat==='rain'?'降水':'蒸发')+'量('+ser.unit+')</th><th>最大日'+ser.unit+'</th><th>日期</th><th>统计天数</th>'; }
  h+='</tr></thead><tbody>';
  function runoff(sumv){ return sumv==null||isNaN(sumv)?'—':(sumv*86400/1e8).toFixed(4); }
  for(var m=0;m<12;m++){
    var r=mo[m];
    h+='<tr><td>'+(m+1)+'</td>';
    if(lvl){ h+='<td>'+anFmt(r.mean,p)+'</td><td>'+anFmt(r.max,p)+'</td><td>'+(r.maxD||'—')+'</td><td>'+anFmt(r.min,p)+'</td><td>'+(r.minD||'—')+'</td>'; if(ser.cat==='qday') h+='<td>'+runoff(r.sum)+'</td>'; }
    else { h+='<td>'+anFmt(r.sum,p)+'</td><td>'+anFmt(r.max,p)+'</td><td>'+(r.maxD||'—')+'</td><td>'+r.cnt+'</td>'; }
    h+='</tr>';
  }
  h+='<tr style="font-weight:800;background:#eef2f7"><td>全年</td>';
  if(lvl){ h+='<td>'+anFmt(yr.mean,p)+'</td><td>'+anFmt(yr.max,p)+'</td><td>'+(yr.maxD||'—')+'</td><td>'+anFmt(yr.min,p)+'</td><td>'+(yr.minD||'—')+'</td>'; if(ser.cat==='qday') h+='<td>'+runoff(yr.sum)+'</td>'; }
  else { h+='<td>'+anFmt(yr.sum,p)+'</td><td>'+anFmt(yr.max,p)+'</td><td>'+(yr.maxD||'—')+'</td><td>'+yr.cnt+'</td>'; }
  h+='</tr></tbody></table>';
  return {h:h,has:yr.cnt>0};
}
window._anLastHtml='';
function renderAnnual(){
  var st=anSt(), out=$('anOut'); if(!st||!out) return;
  var year=$('anYear').value, blocks=[], any=false;
  AN_SERIES.forEach(function(ser){
    var t=anTableHtml(ser,st,false);
    if(t.has){ any=true; blocks.push('<div class="card"><h3>'+ser.name+'月年统计表 <span class="mut">（单位见列名）</span></h3>'+t.h+'</div>'); }
  });
  if(!any){ out.innerHTML='<div class="card"><div class="empty">'+esc(st.name)+'站 '+year+' 年暂无逐日资料。请先在「日常观测」录入，或在「数据中心」导入逐日数据。</div></div>'; window._anLastHtml=''; return; }
  out.innerHTML=blocks.join('');
  window._anLastHtml='<h1 style="text-align:center;font-size:20px;margin:4px 0 2px">'+esc(st.name)+'站 '+year+' 年水文气象要素年报表</h1>'
    +'<p style="text-align:center;color:#555;font-size:12px;margin:0 0 10px">依据数据中心逐日资料统计　缺测日不参与</p>'
    +AN_SERIES.map(function(ser){ var t=anTableHtml(ser,st,true); return t.has?'<h3 style="font-size:14px;margin:10px 0 4px">'+ser.name+'月年统计表</h3>'+t.h:''; }).join('')
    +'<p style="margin-top:18px;font-size:13px">编制：____________　　校核：____________　　审查：____________　　编制日期：'+new Date().toLocaleDateString()+'</p>';
}
function anPrint(){
  if(!window._anLastHtml){ toast('暂无可打印的年报数据'); return; }
  var w=window.open('','_blank');
  w.document.write('<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><title>年报表</title><style>'
    +'@page{size:A4 portrait;margin:14mm} body{font-family:SimSun,serif;color:#000;font-size:12px}'
    +'table.anTb{border-collapse:collapse;width:100%;margin-bottom:10px}'
    +'.anTb th,.anTb td{border:1px solid #000;padding:3px 4px;text-align:center;font-size:11px}'
    +'.anTb th{background:#f0f0f0} h3{font-family:"Microsoft YaHei"}</style></head><body>'
    +window._anLastHtml+'</body></html>');
  w.document.close();
  setTimeout(function(){ try{ w.focus(); w.print(); }catch(e){} },350);
}

function openQrTab(){
  recordUse(viewOrgId(),'业务功能','站点二维码');
  setTab('tabBiz');
  nav('站点二维码', openBizTab);
  _curPane='qr';
  setPane('paneMine');
  renderMineTopbar('站点二维码');
  var body = $('mineBody');
  body.style.padding='';
  var sts = qrStations();
  var h='<div class="card"><h3>站点二维码</h3><p class="mut">为单个站点生成基本信息二维码；外部扫码（微信等）可直接识别，也可用本系统摄像头扫码读取。</p></div>';
  h+='<div class="card"><div class="row"><label>选择站点</label><select id="qrStation">';
  if (!sts.length) h+='<option value="">暂无站点</option>';
  sts.forEach(function(s){ h+='<option value="'+esc(s.name)+'">'+esc(s.name)+'（'+(s.category||'')+'）</option>'; });
  h+='</select></div>';
  h+='<div style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">';
  h+='<button class="btn" onclick="qrGen()">生成单站二维码</button>';
  h+='<button class="btn" onclick="qrGenAll()">生成全部站点小码</button>';
  h+='<button class="btn gray" onclick="qrScan()">扫码读取站点</button>';
  h+='</div></div>';
  h+='<div class="card" id="qrOut"><div class="empty">选择站点后点“生成单站二维码”，或点“生成全部站点小码”一屏查看/打印各站；微信扫码直接看信息，本系统扫码自动切换到该站。</div></div>';
  body.innerHTML=h;
}
function qrGen(){
  var sel=document.getElementById('qrStation'); if(!sel||!sel.value){ toast('请选择站点'); return; }
  var sts=qrStations(); var st=null;
  for(var i=0;i<sts.length;i++){ if(sts[i].name===sel.value){ st=sts[i]; break; } }
  if(!st){ toast('未找到站点'); return; }
  var content=stQrText(st);
  var q=null;
  try{ q=qrSvgOf(content,210,'M'); }catch(e){ toast('二维码组件加载失败'); return; }
  var pairs=stQrPairs(st);
  var info=pairs.map(function(a){return a[0]+'：'+a[1];}).join('\n');
  var out=document.getElementById('qrOut');
  out.innerHTML='<div style="display:flex;gap:18px;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:center">'
    +'<div style="text-align:center;width:230px;flex-shrink:0"><h3>'+esc(st.name)+'</h3>'
    +'<div style="width:210px;height:210px;margin:0 auto">'+q.svg+'</div>'
    +'<div class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">微信等扫码查看信息；本系统扫码自动切站</div></div>'
    +'<pre style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:13px;color:#222;text-align:left;flex:1;min-width:220px;max-width:420px;margin:0;background:#f7f9fc;border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px">'+esc(info)+'</pre>'
    +'</div>';
}
function qrGenAll(){
  var sts=qrStations();
  var out=document.getElementById('qrOut');
  if(!sts.length){ out.innerHTML='<div class="empty">暂无站点</div>'; return; }
  var cells=sts.map(function(st){
    var q=null;
    try{ q=qrSvgOf(stQrText(st),168,'L'); }catch(e){ return ''; }
    var n=(stQrPairs(st).length);
    return '<div style="border:1px solid #e2e8f0;border-radius:8px;padding:8px 6px;text-align:center;width:184px;break-inside:avoid">'
      +'<div style="font-size:13px;font-weight:600;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis">'+esc(st.name)+'</div>'
      +'<div style="width:168px;height:168px;margin:4px auto">'+q.svg+'</div>'
      +'<div class="mut" style="font-size:11px">'+(st.category||'')+' · '+n+'项信息</div></div>';
  }).join('');
  out.innerHTML='<h3 style="margin:0 0 8px">全部站点小码（共 '+sts.length+' 站，微信/本系统均可扫码）</h3>'
    +'<div style="display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px">'+cells+'</div>';
}
function qrScan(){
  if(!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia){ alert('当前环境不支持摄像头扫码（请使用 https 或本机安全环境，并允许摄像头权限）'); return; }
  var ov=document.createElement('div');
  ov.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.85);z-index:99999;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
  ov.innerHTML='<div style="color:#fff;font-size:14px;margin-bottom:10px">对准站点二维码（自动识别）</div>'
    +'<video id="qrVideo" playsinline style="width:min(90vw,420px);height:auto;border-radius:10px;background:#000"></video>'
    +'<div id="qrScanMsg" style="color:#ffd;font-size:13px;margin-top:10px">正在启动摄像头…</div>'
    +'<button onclick="window.__qrStop&&window.__qrStop();this.closest(\'div[style*=\"position:fixed\"]\').remove()" style="margin-top:12px;padding:8px 18px;border:none;border-radius:8px;background:#fff;color:#000;font-size:14px">关闭扫码</button>';
  document.body.appendChild(ov);
  var video=document.getElementById('qrVideo');
  navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({video:{facingMode:'environment'}}).then(function(stream){
    video.srcObject=stream;
    var msg=document.getElementById('qrScanMsg');
    window.__qrStop=function(){ try{ stream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); }); }catch(e){} if(window.__qrTimer)clearTimeout(window.__qrTimer); };
    function tick(){
      if(video.readyState>=2){
        var cw=video.videoWidth||320, ch=video.videoHeight||240;
        var cv=document.createElement('canvas'); cv.width=cw; cv.height=ch;
        var cx=cv.getContext('2d'); cx.drawImage(video,0,0,cw,ch);
        var img=cx.getImageData(0,0,cw,ch);
        var code=null;
        try{ code=jsQR(img.data,img.width,img.height); }catch(e){}
        if(code && code.data){
          window.__qrStop();
          msg.textContent='识别成功';
          var data=String(code.data||'');
          var name='', st=null;
          if(data.indexOf('YBTST:')===0){ name=data.split('\n')[0].slice(6).trim(); st=qrFindStation(name); }
          else if(data.indexOf('STATION:')===0){ try{ var o=JSON.parse(data.slice(8)); name=o.name||''; st=qrFindStation(name)||o; }catch(e){} }
          var switched=false;
          if(name&&st){ try{ pickStationByName(name); switched=true; }catch(e){} }
          var info = st ? stQrText(st).replace(/^YBTST:[^\n]*\n/,'') : data;
          var box=document.createElement('div');
          box.style.cssText='position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(0,0,0,.7);z-index:99999;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;';
          box.innerHTML='<div style="background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:20px;max-width:90vw;max-height:90vh;overflow:auto">'
            +'<h3>'+(name?esc(name):'站点基本信息')+'</h3>'
            +(switched?'<div style="color:#1565C0;margin:4px 0 8px">✅ 已切换当前站点为「'+esc(name)+'」，可直接开展业务</div>':(name?'<div style="color:#b45309;margin:4px 0 8px">本机数据中未找到该站，仅展示扫码信息</div>':''))
            +'<pre style="white-space:pre-wrap;font-size:13px;color:#222;text-align:left">'+esc(info)+'</pre>'
            +'<button onclick="this.closest(\'div[style*=\"position:fixed\"]\').remove()" style="margin-top:10px;padding:8px 16px;border:none;border-radius:8px;background:#1565C0;color:#fff">关闭</button></div>';
          document.body.appendChild(box);
          ov.remove();
          return;
        }
      }
      window.__qrTimer=setTimeout(tick,120);
    }
    tick();
  }).catch(function(err){ var m=document.getElementById('qrScanMsg'); if(m) m.textContent='摄像头启动失败：'+(err&&err.message||err); });
}

/* =====================================================================
 * 站点模拟数据：为新成立站点一键生成各功能模拟数据，导出→修改→导入，
 * 并可一键清除模拟数据。
 * ===================================================================== */
function simTabData(){
  var o = orgById(viewOrgId());
  var key = o ? ('ylt_data_' + o.name) : 'ylt_data';
  try { var d = JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(key)); if(d && Array.isArray(d.stations)) return d; } catch(e){}
  return { stations: [] };
}
function simSaveData(d){
  var o = orgById(viewOrgId());
  var key = o ? ('ylt_data_' + o.name) : 'ylt_data';
  localStorage.setItem(key, JSON.stringify(d));
}
function simGet(){
  var sel = document.getElementById('simStation'); if(!sel || !sel.value) return null;
  var d = simTabData();
  for(var i=0;i<d.stations.length;i++) if(d.stations[i].name === sel.value) return { d:d, st:d.stations[i], i:i };
  return null;
}
function simSeed(name){ var h=0; for(var i=0;i<name.length;i++){ h=(h*31 + name.charCodeAt(i))>>>0; } return h||1; }
function simRng(seed){ var a=seed; return function(){ a=(a*1664525+1013904223)>>>0; return a/4294967296; }; }
function simPad(n){ return String(n).length<2 ? '0'+String(n) : String(n); }
function simDateOffset(days){ var now=new Date(); var dt=new Date(now.getTime()-days*86400000); return dt.getFullYear()+'-'+simPad(dt.getMonth()+1)+'-'+simPad(dt.getDate()); }
function openSimTab(){
  recordUse(viewOrgId(),'业务功能','模拟数据');
  setTab('tabBiz');
  nav('模拟数据', openBizTab);
  _curPane='sim';
  setPane('paneMine');
  renderMineTopbar('模拟数据');
  var body = $('mineBody');
  body.style.padding='';
  var sts = simTabData().stations;
  var h='<div class="card"><h3>站点模拟数据</h3><p class="mut">为新成立站点一键生成各功能模拟数据（可导出修改后导入）；也可一键清除模拟数据，恢复空站。</p></div>';
  h+='<div class="card"><div class="row"><label>选择站点</label><select id="simStation">';
  if(!sts.length) h+='<option value="">暂无站点</option>';
  sts.forEach(function(s){ h+='<option value="'+esc(s.name)+'">'+esc(s.name)+'（'+(s.category||'')+'）</option>'; });
  h+='</select></div>';
  h+='<div style="margin-top:10px;display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap">';
  h+='<button class="btn" onclick="simGen()">生成模拟数据</button>';
  h+='<button class="btn" onclick="simExport()">导出（下载JSON）</button>';
  h+='<button class="btn gray" onclick="simImport()">导入（选择JSON）</button>';
  h+='<button class="btn del" onclick="simClear()">清除模拟数据</button>';
  h+='</div>';
  h+='<input type="file" id="simFile" accept=".json,application/json" style="display:none" onchange="simImportFile(this)">';
  h+='</div>';
  h+='<div class="card" id="simOut"><div class="empty">选择站点后生成 / 导出 / 导入 / 清除模拟数据。</div></div>';
  body.innerHTML=h;
}
function simTypicalWl(cat){
  if(cat==='中小河水文站'||cat==='中小河水位站') return { high:52.50, mid:51.00, low:50.20 };
  if(cat==='防汛专用站') return { high:86.30, mid:84.50, low:82.80 };
  if(cat==='管理机构') return { high:0, mid:0, low:0 };
  return { high:22.80, mid:21.50, low:20.60 };
}
function simGen(){
  var g = simGet(); if(!g){ toast('请选择站点'); return; }
  var st = g.st, seed = simSeed(st.name), r = simRng(seed);
  // 已有水位/测流数据则提示
  var hasHist = st.hist && st.hist.levels && Object.keys(st.hist.levels).length;
  var hasFlow = st.tools && st.tools.flows && st.tools.flows.length;
  if(hasHist || hasFlow){
    if(!confirm('该站点已有部分数据（水位/测流等）。生成模拟数据将覆盖这些内容，是否继续？')) return;
  }
  var cat = st.category || '基本站';
  var tw = simTypicalWl(cat);
  var wlHigh = parseFloat(st.wl&&st.wl.high) || tw.high;
  var wlMid  = parseFloat(st.wl&&st.wl.mid)  || tw.mid;
  var wlLow  = parseFloat(st.wl&&st.wl.low)  || tw.low;
  if(!parseFloat(st.wl&&st.wl.high)){ if(!st.wl) st.wl={}; st.wl.high=wlHigh.toFixed(2); st.wl.mid=wlMid.toFixed(2); st.wl.low=wlLow.toFixed(2); }
  // 水准点
  st.benchmarks = [
    { name:'基1', elev:(wlHigh + 5 + r()*3).toFixed(3), location:'站' },
    { name:'基2', elev:(wlHigh + 2 + r()*2).toFixed(3), location:'上游' },
    { name:'基3', elev:(wlHigh - 1 + r()*2).toFixed(3), location:'下游' },
    { name:'固',  elev:(wlHigh + 4 + r()*2).toFixed(3), location:'固定点' }
  ];
  // 水尺
  st.gauges = [];
  for(var i=0;i<5;i++){ st.gauges.push({ name:'P'+(i+1), elev:(wlMid + (i-2)*1.4 + r()).toFixed(3), location:(i%2?'上水':'下水') }); }
  // 水位（近30天逐日）
  st.hist = st.hist || {};
  var levels = {};
  for(var k=29;k>=0;k--){ var ds=simDateOffset(k); levels[ds]=(wlMid + (r()*2-1)*0.9).toFixed(2); }
  st.hist.levels = levels;
  // 雨量（近30天）
  var rain = {};
  for(var j=29;j>=0;j--){ var dr=simDateOffset(j); rain[dr] = (r()<0.55 ? '0' : (r()*55).toFixed(1)); }
  st.hist.rain = rain;
  // 断面（近一次）
  var sec = [];
  for(var s2=0;s2<8;s2++){ var d2=s2*10; sec.push({ dist:d2, hb:(wlLow - 3 + r()*4).toFixed(2) }); }
  st.hist.sections = sec;
  // 水情记录
  var wtr = [{ date:simDateOffset(1), level:(wlMid+r()*1.2).toFixed(2), desc:'正常' }];
  st.hist.water = wtr;
  // 流量测验记录
  st.tools = st.tools || {};
  var flows = [];
  for(var f=0;f<3;f++){ flows.push({ date:simDateOffset(f*9), stage:(wlMid + r()*1.5).toFixed(2), flow:(wlMid*12*r() + 15).toFixed(2), method:'流速仪法' }); }
  st.tools.flows = flows;
  st.tools.calcs = [];
  st.tools.adcp = [];
  // 测站基本要求
  st.base = { range:(wlLow.toFixed(2)+' - '+wlHigh.toFixed(2)), need:'本站按要求定期开展测流与整编工作。', z:'20.0', chkQ:'#N/A' };
  // 设备
  if(!st.equipment || !Object.keys(st.equipment).length){
    st.equipment = {
      RTU:[{ name:'RT800', factory:'全水', contact:'', doc:'', note:'遥测终端机' }],
      雨量计:[{ name:'JDZ05', factory:'南水', contact:'', doc:'', note:'' }],
      水准仪:[{ name:'NA2', factory:'徕卡', contact:'', doc:'', note:'' }]
    };
  }
  // 站点基本信息（extraFields）
  var orgN = (orgById(viewOrgId())||{}).name || '';
  if(!st.extraFields || !st.extraFields.length){
    st.extraFields = [
      { label:'管理机构', value:orgN },
      { label:'测站编码', value:st.code||'' },
      { label:'设立时间', value:'待补充' },
      { label:'负责科室', value:'监测科' },
      { label:'站址', value:'待补充' }
    ];
  }
  if(!st.description) st.description = st.name + '水文测站，隶属' + (orgN||'本局') + '，承担水位、雨量、流量等水文要素监测任务。';
  if(!st.projects || !st.projects.length) st.projects = ['水位','雨量','流量'];
  simSaveData(g.d);
  var out = document.getElementById('simOut');
  out.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#2E7D32;font-weight:700">已为「'+esc(st.name)+'」生成模拟数据</div>'
    + '<div class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">覆盖：站点基本信息、水准点、水尺、水位（近30天逐日）、雨量（近30天）、断面、水情记录、流量测验、设备、测站要求等。可点击「导出」下载后修改，再「导入」覆盖。导入后请在业务-站点管理中重新进入以查看最新数据。</div>';
  toast('模拟数据已生成');
}
function simExport(){
  var g = simGet(); if(!g){ toast('请选择站点'); return; }
  var blob = new Blob([JSON.stringify(g.st, null, 2)], { type:'application/json' });
  var a = document.createElement('a');
  a.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob); a.download = g.st.name + '_基础数据.json'; a.click();
  setTimeout(function(){ URL.revokeObjectURL(a.href); }, 800);
  toast('已导出 '+g.st.name+' 基础数据');
}
function simImport(){ var f=document.getElementById('simFile'); if(f) f.click(); }
function simImportFile(inp){
  var f = inp.files[0]; if(!f) return;
  var rd = new FileReader();
  rd.onload = function(){
    try{
      var data = JSON.parse(rd.result);
      var g = simGet(); if(!g){ toast('请先选择站点'); return; }
      var st = g.st;
      var keep = { id:st.id, name:st.name, lng:st.lng, lat:st.lat, category:st.category };
      var merged = Object.assign({}, st, data, keep);
      if(data && typeof data==='object'){ if(data.hist) merged.hist = Object.assign({}, st.hist, data.hist); if(data.tools) merged.tools = Object.assign({}, st.tools, data.tools); }
      g.d.stations[g.i] = merged;
      simSaveData(g.d);
      var out = document.getElementById('simOut');
      out.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#2E7D32;font-weight:700">已导入「'+esc(merged.name)+'」基础数据</div><div class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">如需在业务-站点管理中查看最新数据，请重新进入该页面。</div>';
      toast('导入成功');
    }catch(e){ alert('导入失败：所选文件不是有效的 JSON'); }
  };
  rd.readAsText(f);
  inp.value = '';
}
function simClear(){
  var g = simGet(); if(!g){ toast('请选择站点'); return; }
  var st = g.st;
  if(!confirm('确定清除「'+st.name+'」的全部模拟数据？将清空水位/雨量/断面/测流等模拟记录（保留站点基本名称与坐标）。')) return;
  st.hist = { levels:{}, gauges:{}, sections:{}, rain:{}, water:{} };
  if(st.tools){ st.tools.flows = []; st.tools.calcs = []; st.tools.adcp = []; st.tools.standards = []; st.tools.contact = []; }
  st.base = { range:'', need:'', z:'', chkQ:'' };
  simSaveData(g.d);
  var out = document.getElementById('simOut');
  out.innerHTML = '<div style="color:#C62828;font-weight:700">已清除「'+esc(st.name)+'」的模拟数据</div><div class="mut" style="margin-top:6px">该站点已恢复为空站，可重新生成或导入基础数据。</div>';
  toast('已清除模拟数据');
}

/* =====================================================================
 * 天地图实时地图：向 ybt 内核地图页运行时注入"天地图"按钮。
 * 联网时加载真实天地图（含行政边界/干支流底图 + 站点标注），
 * 离线时保留本地 SVG 兜底。
 * ===================================================================== */
var TDT_PATCH = "(function(){\n" +
"  function _tdtInit(){\n" +
"    if(document.getElementById('tdtBtn')) return;\n" +
"    if(!document.getElementById('mapBox')) return;\n" +
"    var wrap=null;\n" +
"    var bts=document.querySelectorAll('button');\n" +
"    for(var i=0;i<bts.length;i++){\n" +
"      if(bts[i].textContent.indexOf('全图')>=0){ wrap=bts[i].parentNode; break; }\n" +
"      if(bts[i].textContent.indexOf('放大')>=0){ wrap=bts[i].parentNode; }\n" +
"    }\n" +
"    if(!wrap) return;\n" +
"    var b=document.createElement('button');\n" +
"    b.id='tdtBtn'; b.className='btn tiny blue'; b.textContent='天地图';\n" +
"    b.style.marginLeft='6px';\n" +
"    b.onclick=function(){ _tdtOpen(); };\n" +
"    wrap.appendChild(b);\n" +
"  }\n" +
"  function _tdtOpen(){\n" +
"    var T=(window.parent&&parent.T)?parent.T:window.T;\n" +
"    if(!T){ alert('天地图组件未加载，请联网后重试'); return; }\n" +
"    var box=document.getElementById('mapBox'); if(!box) return;\n" +
"    var dv=document.getElementById('tdtDiv');\n" +
"    var btn=document.getElementById('tdtBtn');\n" +
"    if(dv){ dv.remove(); if(btn)btn.textContent='天地图'; return; }\n" +
"    var cx=113.62, cy=28.15;\n" +
"    try{ var bc=(window.BUREAU_CENTER||{})[_yltBureau]; if(bc&&bc[0]){ cx=bc[0]; cy=bc[1]; } }catch(e){}\n" +
"    var div=document.createElement('div');\n" +
"    div.id='tdtDiv'; div.style.cssText='width:100%;height:520px;border:1px solid #ccc;background:#eef;margin-top:6px;';\n" +
"    box.appendChild(div);\n" +
"    var map=new T.Map(div);\n" +
"    map.centerAndZoom(new T.LngLat(cx,cy), 11);\n" +
"    try{ map.addControl(new T.Control.Zoom()); }catch(e){}\n" +
"    var sts=(Store.data().stations||[]).filter(function(s){return s.lng&&s.lat;});\n" +
"    sts.forEach(function(s){\n" +
"      try{ var mk=new T.Marker(new T.LngLat(parseFloat(s.lng),parseFloat(s.lat)),{title:s.name}); map.addOverLay(mk); }catch(e){}\n" +
"    });\n" +
"    if(btn)btn.textContent='返回本地图';\n" +
"    try{ if(sts.length&&map.setViewport){ map.setViewport(sts.map(function(s){return new T.LngLat(parseFloat(s.lng),parseFloat(s.lat));})); } }catch(e){}\n" +
"  }\n" +
"  setInterval(_tdtInit, 900);\n" +
"})();\n";

/* 定时把补丁注入到 ybt 内核 iframe */
setInterval(function(){
  try{
    var fr=document.getElementById('ybtFrame');
    if(!fr||!fr.contentWindow||!fr.contentDocument) return;
    if(fr.contentWindow.__tdtPatched) return;
    var d=fr.contentDocument;
    var sc=d.createElement('script');
    sc.textContent = TDT_PATCH;
    (d.head||d.body).appendChild(sc);
    fr.contentWindow.__tdtPatched=true;
  }catch(e){}
}, 1000);

/* =====================================================================
 * 基础数据 + 站点基本信息库（外壳层，独立于业务内核）
 * 新机构一键导入基础数据激活；站点基本信息可一键导入导出；
 * 单站可生成二维码，本软件可扫码获取站基本信息。
 * ===================================================================== */
function baseStKey() { return 'hydro_base_stations_' + viewOrgId(); }
function baseSt() {
  try { return JSON.parse(localStorage.getItem(baseStKey())) || []; } catch(e) { return []; }
}
function saveBaseSt(list) { localStorage.setItem(baseStKey(), JSON.stringify(list)); }

/* 站点基本信息字段（充实但精简） */
var STATION_FIELDS = [
  ['name','站名'],['code','站码'],['cat','类别'],['region','行政区域'],['river','所在河流'],
  ['lon','经度'],['lat','纬度'],['alt','海拔(m)'],['items','测验项目'],['year','建站年份'],
  ['org','主管单位'],['contact','联系负责人'],['phone','联系电话'],['remark','备注']
];
var STATION_CATS = ['基本站','中小河站','防汛专用站','大江大河站','雨量站','水位站','水文站','辅助站'];

/* 新机构一键导入基础数据（激活各项功能） */
var BASE_DAILY_TPL = null; // 办公由内核自动初始化，这里主要激活站点与业务
function importBaseData(force) {
  var u = currentUser();
  var o = orgById(viewOrgId());
  if (!o) return;
  if (!force && baseSt().length) { if (!confirm('本机构已存在站点基本信息，仍要重新导入基础数据（覆盖）吗？')) return; }
  // 办公模板（激活办公各模块）
  var dkey = hydroKey(o);
  var cur = readLocal(dkey);
  if (!cur || cur === 'null') {
    var d = { people: [], entries: {}, records: [], meals: {}, tasks: [], attn: {}, opinions: [], notices: [], seq: 1, me: null };
    writeLocal(dkey, JSON.stringify(d));
  }
  // 站点基本信息模板（一批通用示例，供机构改为自己的站点）
  var tpl = [
    { name:'示例·基本站A', code:o.name.slice(0,2)+'01', cat:'基本站', region:'', river:'', lon:'', lat:'', alt:'', items:'降水、水位、流量', year:'', org:o.name, contact:'', phone:'', remark:'一键导入的示例站，请修改为本站资料' }
  ];
  writeLocal(baseStKey(), JSON.stringify(tpl));
  toast('已导入基础数据，各功能已激活');
}

/* =====================================================================
 * 站点基本信息管理（我的页入口）
 * ===================================================================== */
function renderStationBasePage() {
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u) return;
  showPage('orgPage');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var list = baseSt();
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>站点基本信息（' + list.length + '）</h3>'
    + '<p class="mut">站点基本信息充实但不复杂，可一键导入导出；在单站设置里可生成该站二维码，用本软件扫码即可获取站基本信息。</p>'
    + '<div style="margin:6px 0"><button class="btn" onclick="stationAdd()">+ 新增站点</button></div>'
    + '<div id="stationList"></div></div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>数据</h3>'
    + '<div style="margin:6px 0"><button class="btn" onclick="exportStations()">导出站点基本信息</button></div>'
    + '<div style="margin:6px 0"><button class="btn gray" onclick="document.getElementById(\'stImp\').click()">导入站点基本信息</button>'
    + '<input type="file" id="stImp" accept=".json" style="display:none" onchange="importStations(this)"></div>'
    + '<div style="margin:6px 0"><button class="btn" onclick="importBaseData(false)">一键导入基础数据</button></div>'
    + '</div>';
  h += '<div class="card"><h3>扫码</h3>'
    + '<p class="mut">扫描本站单站二维码，获取站点基本信息。</p>'
    + '<div style="margin:6px 0"><button class="btn" onclick="scanQR()">📷 扫码</button></div>'
    + '</div>';
  h += '<div style="margin-top:10px"><button class="btn gray" onclick="enterMain()">返回主界面</button></div>';
  body.innerHTML = h;
  renderStationList();
}
function renderStationList() {
  var el = $('stationList');
  var list = baseSt();
  if (!list.length) { el.innerHTML = '<div class="empty">暂无站点，请点击新增或一键导入基础数据</div>'; return; }
  var h = '';
  list.forEach(function(s, idx){
    h += '<div style="background:var(--bg-input);border-radius:8px;padding:10px;margin-bottom:8px;font-size:13px;">'
      + '<b>' + esc(s.name||'') + '</b> <span style="color:var(--t3);font-size:11px">' + esc(s.code||'') + '</span>'
      + '<div style="display:flex;gap:6px;margin-top:6px;flex-wrap:wrap;">'
      + '<button class="btn" onclick="stationEdit(' + idx + ')">编辑</button>'
      + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="stationQR(' + idx + ')">二维码</button>'
      + '<button class="btn del" onclick="stationDel(' + idx + ')">删除</button></div></div>';
  });
  el.innerHTML = h;
}
function stationAdd() { stationEdit(-1); }
function stationEdit(idx) {
  var list = baseSt();
  var s = idx >= 0 ? list[idx] : {};
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  var h = '<div class="card"><h3>' + (idx>=0?'编辑':'新增') + '站点</h3>';
  STATION_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){
    if (f[0]==='cat') {
      h += '<div class="row"><label>' + f[1] + '</label><select id="sf_cat">' + STATION_CATS.map(function(c){ return '<option' + (s.cat===c?' selected':'') + '>' + c + '</option>'; }).join('') + '</select></div>';
    } else {
      h += '<div class="row"><label>' + f[1] + '</label><input id="sf_' + f[0] + '" value="' + esc(s[f[0]]||'') + '" placeholder="' + f[1] + '"></div>';
    }
  });
  h += '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:6px;"><button class="btn" onclick="stationSave(' + idx + ')">保存</button>'
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="renderStationBasePage()">取消</button></div></div>';
  body.innerHTML = h;
}
function stationSave(idx) {
  var s = {};
  STATION_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ s[f[0]] = f[0]==='cat' ? $('sf_cat').value : ($('sf_'+f[0]).value.trim()); });
  if (!s.name) { alert('请填写站名'); return; }
  var list = baseSt();
  if (idx >= 0) list[idx] = s; else list.push(s);
  saveBaseSt(list);
  renderStationBasePage();
  toast('已保存站点');
}
function stationDel(idx) {
  if (!confirm('删除该站点基本信息？')) return;
  var list = baseSt();
  list.splice(idx, 1);
  saveBaseSt(list);
  renderStationBasePage();
}
function exportStations() {
  var pack = { type:'hydro_station_base', version:1, orgName:orgById(viewOrgId()).name, exportedAt:new Date().toISOString(), list: baseSt() };
  downloadJSON('站点基本信息_' + orgById(viewOrgId()).name + '_' + dateStr() + '.json', pack);
  toast('已导出站点基本信息');
}
function importStations(inp) {
  var f = inp.files[0]; if (!f) return;
  var r = new FileReader();
  r.onload = function(e){
    try {
      var d = JSON.parse(e.target.result);
      var list = (d && d.type==='hydro_station_base') ? (d.list||[]) : d;
      if (!Array.isArray(list)) throw new Error('格式不正确');
      if (!confirm('导入 ' + list.length + ' 条站点基本信息（覆盖本机构现有站点）？')) return;
      saveBaseSt(list);
      renderStationBasePage();
      toast('已导入 ' + list.length + ' 条站点');
    } catch(err) { alert('导入失败：' + err.message); }
  };
  r.readAsText(f);
  inp.value = '';
}

/* =====================================================================
 * 单站二维码：内嵌标准 QR 编码器（版本1，byte 模式，纠错L/M）
 * 内容：YBT#站码（短，本软件扫码后按站码查站基本信息）
 * ===================================================================== */
function stationQR(idx) {
  var list = baseSt();
  var s = list[idx];
  if (!s) return;
  var parts = ['YBT#' + (s.code || '')];
  if (s.name) parts.push(s.name);
  if (s.region) parts.push('位置:' + s.region);
  if (s.river) parts.push('河流:' + s.river);
  if (s.cat) parts.push('类型:' + s.cat);
  if (s.phone) parts.push('电话:' + s.phone);
  var content = parts.join('|');
  var tmp = '', acc = 0;
  for (var i = 0; i < content.length; i++) {
    var b = unescape(encodeURIComponent(content[i])).length;
    if (acc + b > 52) break;
    tmp += content[i]; acc += b;
  }
  content = tmp;
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="card" style="text-align:center;"><h3>' + esc(s.name) + ' · 单站二维码</h3>'
    + '<div style="margin:10px auto;" id="qrBox"></div>'
    + '<p class="mut">' + esc(content) + '</p>'
    + '<p class="mut">外部扫码可直接识别本站信息；本软件扫码或输入站码即可获取该站基本信息。</p>'
    + '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px;"><button class="btn gray" onclick="renderStationBasePage()">返回</button></div></div>';
  try {
    var qr = qrEncode(content);
    var c = document.createElement('canvas');
    var s2 = qr.size + 8;
    c.width = s2 * 8; c.height = s2 * 8;
    var ctx = c.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#fff'; ctx.fillRect(0, 0, c.width, c.height);
    ctx.fillStyle = '#000';
    var m = qr.matrix;
    for (var r = 0; r < qr.size; r++) for (var cc = 0; cc < qr.size; cc++) {
      if (m[r][cc]) ctx.fillRect((cc+4)*8, (r+4)*8, 8, 8);
    }
    var box = $('qrBox'); box.innerHTML = ''; box.appendChild(c);
  } catch(err) { $('qrBox').innerHTML = '<span style="color:var(--c-red)">二维码生成失败：' + esc(err.message) + '</span>'; }
}

/* ---- 精简 QR 编码器（版本1，byte 模式，纠错 L） ---- */
/* GF(256) Reed-Solomon 纠错表（版本1-L：26 码字，19 数据，7 纠错） */
var QR_GF_EXP = [], QR_GF_LOG = [];
(function(){
  var x = 1;
  for (var i = 0; i < 255; i++) { QR_GF_EXP[i] = x; QR_GF_LOG[x] = i; x <<= 1; if (x & 0x100) x ^= 0x11d; }
})();
function qrGmul(a, b) { if (!a || !b) return 0; return QR_GF_EXP[(QR_GF_LOG[a] + QR_GF_LOG[b]) % 255]; }
function qrPolyMul(p, q) {
  var r = new Array(p.length + q.length - 1).fill(0);
  for (var i = 0; i < p.length; i++) for (var j = 0; j < q.length; j++) r[i+j] ^= qrGmul(p[i], q[j]);
  return r;
}
function qrRsGen(n) {
  var g = [1];
  for (var i = 0; i < n; i++) g = qrPolyMul(g, [1, QR_GF_EXP[i]]);
  return g;
}
function qrEncode(data) {
  // 版本1，纠错 L：21x21，26 码字，数据 19，纠错 7
  var VER = 3, EC = 17, DATA = 53, SIZE = 29;
  var raw = [];
  raw.push(4); // byte 模式
  raw.push(data.length); // 8bit 计数（版本1-9 用 8bit）
  for (var i = 0; i < data.length; i++) raw.push(data.charCodeAt(i));
  var cap = DATA * 8;
  var buf = [];
  for (var j = 0; j < raw.length; j++) {
    var v = raw[j];
    for (var b = 7; b >= 0; b--) buf.push((v >> b) & 1);
  }
  var bitLen = buf.length;
  var totalBits = cap;
  for (var k = bitLen; k < totalBits; k++) buf.push(0);
  // 填充字节（版本1-L 交替 0xEC/0x11）
  var cur = 0, padSeq = [0xEC, 0x11];
  var pos = 0;
  while (pos < totalBits) {
    var pd = padSeq[cur % 2]; cur++;
    for (var b2 = 7; b2 >= 0; b2--) { if (pos < totalBits) { buf[pos] = (pd >> b2) & 1; pos++; } }
    if (pos % 8 === 0 && pos >= totalBits) break;
    // 确保从完整字节边界继续
  }
  // 转码字
  var codewords = [];
  for (var n = 0; n < buf.length; n += 8) {
    var byte = 0;
    for (var bb = 0; bb < 8; bb++) byte = (byte << 1) | buf[n+bb];
    codewords.push(byte);
  }
  while (codewords.length < DATA) codewords.push(0);
  // 计算纠错码字
  var g = qrRsGen(EC);
  var msg = codewords.slice();
  var work = msg.slice();
  for (var w = 0; w < DATA; w++) {
    var coef = work[0];
    if (coef) { for (var u = 0; u < g.length; u++) work[u] ^= qrGmul(g[u], coef); }
    work.shift(); work.push(0);
  }
  var ecc = work.slice(0, EC);
  var all = codewords.concat(ecc);
  return buildMatrix(all, SIZE);
}
/* 放置数据位到矩阵（版本1，掩码0） */
function buildMatrix(codewords, size) {
  var m = [];
  for (var i = 0; i < size; i++) m.push(new Array(size).fill(0));
  // 定位图形（3 角）+ 分隔
  function putFinder(r0, c0) {
    for (var dr = -1; dr <= 7; dr++) for (var dc = -1; dc <= 7; dc++) {
      var r = r0 + dr, c = c0 + dc;
      if (r < 0 || c < 0 || r >= size || c >= size) continue;
      var isIn = (dr >= 0 && dr <= 6 && dc >= 0 && dc <= 6) && (dr === 0 || dr === 6 || dc === 0 || dc === 6 || (dr >= 2 && dr <= 4 && dc >= 2 && dc <= 4));
      m[r][c] = isIn ? 1 : 0;
    }
  }
  putFinder(0, 0); putFinder(0, size - 7); putFinder(size - 7, 0);
  // 时序图形
  for (var t = 8; t < size - 8; t++) { m[6][t] = (t % 2 === 0) ? 1 : 0; m[t][6] = (t % 2 === 0) ? 1 : 0; }
  // 数据位（之字形，跳过功能区）
  var bits = [];
  codewords.forEach(function(cw){ for (var b = 7; b >= 0; b--) bits.push((cw >> b) & 1); });
  var bitIdx = 0;
  var col = size - 1;
  var upward = true;
  while (col > 0) {
    if (col === 6) col--;
    for (var c2 = 0; c2 < 2; c2++) {
      var c = col - c2;
      var rowStart = upward ? size - 1 : 0;
      var rowEnd = upward ? -1 : size;
      var step = upward ? -1 : 1;
      for (var r = rowStart; r !== rowEnd; r += step) {
        if (r === 6) continue; // 时序行
        if (m[r][c] === 0 || isReserved(r, c, size)) { if (bitIdx < bits.length) m[r][c] = bits[bitIdx++]; }
      }
    }
    col -= 2; upward = !upward;
  }
  // 填充剩余
  while (bitIdx < bits.length) { // 不应发生
    for (var rr = 0; rr < size && bitIdx < bits.length; rr++) for (var cc2 = 0; cc2 < size && bitIdx < bits.length; cc2++) if (m[rr][cc2] === 0) m[rr][cc2] = bits[bitIdx++];
  }
  return { size: size, matrix: m };
}
function isReserved(r, c, size) {
  // 定位图形及分隔（简化：三个 8x8 角）
  if (r < 8 && c < 8) return true;
  if (r < 8 && c >= size - 8) return true;
  if (r >= size - 8 && c < 8) return true;
  return false;
}

/* =====================================================================
 * 扫码（相机取景 + 识别）
 * ===================================================================== */
var qrStream = null;
function scanQR() {
  var u = currentUser();
  if (!u) return;
  showPage('orgPage');
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  body.innerHTML = '<div class="card" style="text-align:center;"><h3>扫码</h3>'
    + '<video id="qrVideo" style="width:100%;max-width:360px;border-radius:8px;background:#000;" autoplay playsinline></video>'
    + '<p class="mut" id="qrResult">正在调用摄像头…</p>'
    + '<div style="display:flex;gap:8px;justify-content:center;margin-top:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;">'
    + '<button class="btn" onclick="qrCapture()">拍照识别</button>'
    + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="qrStop()">关闭</button></div></div>';
  qrStop();
  if (!navigator.mediaDevices || !navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia) {
    $('qrResult').textContent = '当前环境不支持摄像头，请用手机扫码或输入站码查询。';
    return;
  }
  navigator.mediaDevices.getUserMedia({ video: { facingMode: 'environment' } })
    .then(function(stream){
      qrStream = stream;
      var v = $('qrVideo');
      v.srcObject = stream;
      v.play().catch(function(){});
      $('qrResult').textContent = '请将单站二维码对准镜头，点击“拍照识别”。';
    })
    .catch(function(){ $('qrResult').textContent = '无法开启摄像头（需授予权限），可改用“站码查询”获取站信息。'; });
}
function qrStop() { if (qrStream) { qrStream.getTracks().forEach(function(t){ t.stop(); }); qrStream = null; } }
function qrCapture() {
  var v = $('qrVideo');
  if (!v || !v.videoWidth) { $('qrResult').textContent = '摄像头未就绪'; return; }
  var cv = document.createElement('canvas');
  cv.width = v.videoWidth; cv.height = v.videoHeight;
  var ctx = cv.getContext('2d');
  ctx.drawImage(v, 0, 0, cv.width, cv.height);
  var pix = ctx.getImageData(0, 0, cv.width, cv.height).data;
  // 精简识别：本软件二维码内容格式 YBT#站码，先尝试用简化方式定位/读码
  // （完整 QR 解码依赖更重的库，此处提供站码兜底）
  $('qrResult').textContent = '已拍摄画面。完整自动识别需二维码解码库（后续增强），请输站码查询：';
  $('qrResult').innerHTML = '已拍摄画面。<br>请在下方输入站码查询站信息：'
    + '<br><input id="qrCodeIn" style="margin-top:6px;padding:6px;width:160px;" placeholder="站码">'
    + ' <button class="btn" onclick="qrByCode()">查询</button>';
}
function qrByCode() {
  var code = $('qrCodeIn').value.trim();
  if (!code) return;
  var list = baseSt();
  var hit = list.filter(function(s){ return (s.code||'') === code || s.name === code; })[0];
  var body = $('orgPageBody');
  if (hit) {
    var h = '<div class="card"><h3>' + esc(hit.name) + ' · 站基本信息</h3>';
    STATION_FIELDS.forEach(function(f){ h += '<div class="row"><label>' + f[1] + '</label><span>' + esc(hit[f[0]]||'—') + '</span></div>'; });
    h += '<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn gray" onclick="scanQR()">继续扫码</button> '
       + '<button class="btn gray" onclick="renderStationBasePage()">返回</button></div></div>';
    body.innerHTML = h;
  } else {
    body.innerHTML = '<div class="card" style="text-align:center;"><h3>未找到站点</h3><p class="mut">未找到站码/站名为 “' + esc(code) + '” 的站点。</p>'
      + '<div style="margin-top:8px"><button class="btn gray" onclick="scanQR()">返回扫码</button></div></div>';
  }
}

/* ===== 云端数据同步层（Supabase 多人共享）=====
 * 策略：启动拉取云端 → 写 localStorage（保持应用内部逻辑不变）；
 *       数据保存后推送到云端；定时兜底推送。
 * 共享范围：账号机构(hydro_sys_v2)、办公(hydro_v19_*)、业务(ylt_data)、使用统计(hydro_usage)
 */
(function(){
  var SB_URL = 'https://jfytjinancgfhoqounts.supabase.co';
  var SB_KEY = 'sb_publishable_28TRzJLxWVGyEzdE00Lt5g_5O-mVSj2';
  var SYNC_EXACT = ['hydro_sys_v2','ylt_data','hydro_usage'];
  var SYNC_PREFIX = ['hydro_v19_'];
  var SYNC_INTERVAL = 8000; // 定时推送间隔 ms

  function hdr(extra){
    var h = {
      'apikey': SB_KEY,
      'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + SB_KEY,
      'Content-Type': 'application/json'
    };
    if (extra) for (var k in extra) h[k] = extra[k];
    return h;
  }

  var _sbFail = 0, _sbPause = 0;
  function sbFetch(url, opt){
    var ctrl = new AbortController();
    var timer = setTimeout(function(){ ctrl.abort(); }, 6000);
    var o = opt || {};
    o.signal = ctrl.signal;
    return fetch(url, o).then(function(r){ clearTimeout(timer); return r; }, function(e){ clearTimeout(timer); throw e; });
  }

  function isShareKey(k){
    if (SYNC_EXACT.indexOf(k) >= 0) return true;
    for (var i = 0; i < SYNC_PREFIX.length; i++) if (k.indexOf(SYNC_PREFIX[i]) === 0) return true;
    return false;
  }

  // 拉取云端快照时，合并本地新增的用户（如刚注册的 pending 账号、管理员新建的账号），避免覆盖丢失；
  // 若本地新增账号的 id 与云端已有账号冲突，则为其重新分配新 id；并按“部门+姓名”对待办去重，避免重复申请
  function mergeSysUsers(localStr, cloud) {
    try {
      var loc = JSON.parse(localStr || 'null');
      if (!loc || !loc.users || !cloud || !cloud.users) return cloud;
      var ids = {}, keyed = {}, nameActive = {};
      cloud.users.forEach(function(x){ if (x) { ids[x.id] = 1; if (x.status === 'pending') keyed[x.orgId + ':' + x.name] = 1; else if (x.status === 'active') nameActive[x.name] = 1; } });
      var maxId = 0;
      cloud.users.forEach(function(x){ if (x && x.id > maxId) maxId = x.id; });
      loc.users.forEach(function(u){
        if (!u || !u.id) return;
        var k = u.orgId + ':' + u.name;
        if (u.status === 'pending' && keyed[k]) return;   // 已有同名同部门的待办，不重复
        if (u.status !== 'pending' && nameActive[u.name]) return;  // 同名在册账号已存在，不重复（防止同一职工重复挂多个机构）
        if (ids[u.id]) {
          if (u.status !== 'pending') return;             // id 冲突且非待办，以云端为准
          maxId++; u.id = maxId;                          // id 冲突的待办重新分配
        }
        ids[u.id] = 1;
        if (u.status === 'pending') keyed[k] = 1; else if (u.status === 'active') nameActive[u.name] = 1;
        cloud.users.push(u);
      });
      if ((cloud.seq || 0) < maxId + 1) cloud.seq = maxId + 1;
      cloud.users.sort(function(a,b){ return a.id - b.id; });
    } catch(e){}
    return cloud;
  }
    // 安全推送：拉取云端当前数据，合并本地新增用户后写回（不覆盖云端真实用户）
  function pushSysSafe(){
    if (typeof CloudSync === 'undefined' || !CloudSync.get || !CloudSync.set) return;
    CloudSync.get(SYS_KEY).then(function(cloud){
      try {
        var base = (cloud && cloud.users) ? cloud : { users: [], seq: 1 };
        var merged = mergeSysUsers(JSON.stringify(sys), base);
        if (typeof stripOrgNameJunk === 'function') merged = stripOrgNameJunk(merged);
        var maxId = 0;
        (merged.users||[]).forEach(function(x){ if (x && x.id > maxId) maxId = x.id; });
        if (!merged.seq || merged.seq < maxId + 1) merged.seq = maxId + 1;
        CloudSync.set(SYS_KEY, merged);
        window.sys = merged;  // 本地与云端保持一致
        saveSys();
      } catch(e){}
    });
  }
    var CloudSync = {
    url: SB_URL, key: SB_KEY,
    get: function(key){
      return sbFetch(SB_URL + '/rest/v1/app_kv?key=eq.' + encodeURIComponent(key) + '&select=data', { headers: hdr() })
        .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
        .then(function(arr){ return (arr && arr.length) ? arr[0].data : null; })
        .catch(function(){ return null; });
    },
    set: function(key, data){
      var body = { key: key, data: data, updated_at: new Date().toISOString() };
      return sbFetch(SB_URL + '/rest/v1/app_kv?on_conflict=key', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: hdr({ 'Prefer': 'resolution=merge-duplicates,return=minimal' }),
        body: JSON.stringify(body)
      }).catch(function(){ _sbFail++; if(_sbFail>=3){ _sbFail=0; _sbPause=Date.now()+60000; } });
    },
    // 从云端拉取所有共享数据到 localStorage
    pull: function(){
      return sbFetch(SB_URL + '/rest/v1/app_kv?select=key,data', { headers: hdr() })
        .then(function(r){ return r.json(); })
        .then(function(rows){
          if (!rows || !rows.length) return;
          rows.forEach(function(row){
            if (row && row.key && row.data !== null && isShareKey(row.key)) {
              if (row.key === 'ylt_data' && localStorage.getItem('ylt_data')) return;
              var data = row.data;
              if (row.key === SYS_KEY && typeof mergeSysUsers === 'function') {
                data = mergeSysUsers(localStorage.getItem(SYS_KEY), data);
              }
              if (row.key === SYS_KEY && typeof stripOrgNameJunk === 'function') {
                data = stripOrgNameJunk(data);
              }
              try { localStorage.setItem(row.key, JSON.stringify(data)); } catch(e){}
            }
          });
        })
        .catch(function(){ /* 网络失败则用本地 */ });
    },
    // 把本地共享数据推送到云端
    push: function(){
      if(Date.now()<_sbPause) return;
      var keys = [];
      for (var i = 0; i < localStorage.length; i++) {
        var k = localStorage.key(i);
        if (isShareKey(k)) keys.push(k);
      }
      SYNC_EXACT.forEach(function(k){ try { if (localStorage.getItem(k)) keys.push(k); } catch(e){} });
      // 去重
      keys = keys.filter(function(v,i,self){ return self.indexOf(v) === i; });
      keys.forEach(function(k){
        try { var v = localStorage.getItem(k); if (v) CloudSync.set(k, JSON.parse(v)); } catch(e){}
      });
    },
    pushKey: function(key){
      try { var v = localStorage.getItem(key); if (v) CloudSync.set(key, JSON.parse(v)); } catch(e){}
    }
  };
  window.CloudSync = CloudSync;

  // 启动：拉取云端最新数据，然后重载 sys 并刷新界面
  function boot(){
    var loading = document.getElementById('loading');
    CloudSync.pull().then(function(){
      try { if (typeof loadSys === 'function') window.sys = loadSys(); } catch(e){}
      try { if (typeof migrateAdminNames === 'function') migrateAdminNames(); } catch(e){}
      // 刷新界面：若在登录页或主界面
      try {
        if (typeof renderLoginPage === 'function') {
          var lp = document.getElementById('loginPage');
          if (lp && lp.style.display !== 'none') renderLoginPage();
        }
        var cur = null;
        try { cur = currentUser(); } catch(e){}
        if (cur) {
          var un = document.getElementById('mainUserName');
          if (un) {
            var rl = cur.role;
            var rn = (rl==='super')?'研发':(rl==='provinceAdmin')?'省管':(rl==='bureauAdmin')?'地市总管理员':(rl==='countyAdmin')?'县局总管理员':(rl==='admin')?'管理员':'职工';
            var _las3 = (rl==='user' && typeof linkedAdminsOf==='function') ? linkedAdminsOf(cur.id) : [];
            if (_las3.length) {
              var _lb3 = _las3.map(function(la){ return '<button onclick="enterLinkedAdmin('+la.id+')" style="background:rgba(255,255,255,.25);border:none;color:#fff;border-radius:4px;padding:2px 10px;font-size:12px;cursor:pointer;margin-left:6px">'+linkedEntryLabel(la)+'</button>'; }).join('');
              un.innerHTML = '<span>'+esc(cur.name)+'</span>' + _lb3;
            } else {
              un.textContent = cur.name + '（' + rn + '）';
            }
          }
        }
      } catch(e){}
      if (loading) loading.style.display = 'none';
    });
  }

  // 包装 saveSys：保存后立即推送账号机构数据
  var _origSaveSys = window.saveSys;
  window.saveSys = function(){
    try { if (_origSaveSys) _origSaveSys(); else localStorage.setItem('hydro_sys_v2', JSON.stringify(window.sys||{})); } catch(e){}
    try { CloudSync.pushKey('hydro_sys_v2'); } catch(e){}
  };

  // 定时兜底推送
  setInterval(function(){ try { CloudSync.push(); } catch(e){} }, SYNC_INTERVAL);

  // 启动拉取（DOM 就绪后）
  if (document.readyState === 'loading') document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', boot);
  else boot();
})();

migrateAdminNames();
function dedupeAdmin(){var ch=false,keep={};sys.users.forEach(function(u){if(u.role==='bureauAdmin'||u.role==='countyAdmin'||u.role==='provinceAdmin'){var k=u.orgId+':'+u.role;var org=orgById(u.orgId);if(!keep[k]||(org&&org.adminId===u.id))keep[k]=u;}});sys.users=sys.users.filter(function(u){if(u.role==='bureauAdmin'||u.role==='countyAdmin'||u.role==='provinceAdmin'){var k=u.orgId+':'+u.role;if(keep[k].id!==u.id){ch=true;return false;}}return true;});if(ch)saveSys();}
dedupeAdmin();
